Join our Acceleration Center India and help shape the future of business for our diverse client portfolio across geographies and jurisdictions. You’ll work at the heart of global teams across Advisory, Assurance, Tax and Business Services—solving real client challenges through connected collaboration. We’ll help you grow your skills so you can go further. With hands-on learning, cutting-edge tools and an inclusive culture, this is your opportunity to do inspiring work that makes a difference—every day.
  
  
As a Senior Associate in IT Infra/Cloud operations, you will play a pivotal role in managing and optimizing cloud infrastructure within our Technology Consulting practice. You will be responsible for supporting client operations, confirming seamless cloud service delivery, and leveraging your skills to address complex infrastructure challenges. As a Senior Associate, you will focus on building meaningful client connections and developing a deeper understanding of the business context. You will guide and mentor others, navigate complex situations, and grow your personal brand while enhancing your technical skills.

* Collaborating with teams to develop and execute cloud compliance and security protocols

What Sets You Apart
  
  

* Utilizing Amazon Web Services (AWS) and Google Cloud Platform

* Implementing Cloud-Based Service Management and Cloud Compliance
* Leveraging Dynatrace APM and Splunk for performance monitoring
* Embracing change and fostering intellectual curiosity in technology

9131cd8a.title: ServiceNow Functional Architect
9131cd8a.description:
ServiceNow Functional Architect is responsible for defining the functional architecture, process design, capability roadmap, and value realization of the ServiceNow platform across a complex global enterprise. The role translates business and technology priorities into scalable, standardized, and supportable ServiceNow solutions spanning IT Service Management, Security Operations, Asset Management, and Strategic Portfolio Management.

The architect serves as a strategic partner to global business leaders, IT operations, cybersecurity, asset management, portfolio management, enterprise architecture, data teams, and implementation partners. The role leads requirements discovery, operating model design, cross-module integration, process harmonization, solution governance, and adoption while ensuring alignment with enterprise architecture, security, privacy, data, and regulatory requirements.

Automation and artificial intelligence are critical elements of this position. The successful candidate will identify, prioritize, and architect high-value opportunities using workflow automation, orchestration, virtual agents, predictive intelligence, generative AI, AI agents, and decision support. The role will establish guardrails for responsible AI, measurable value, human oversight, data quality, and sustainable operational ownership.

**Responsibilities:**

* Define and maintain the functional architecture, capability roadmap, and governance framework for the ServiceNow platform.
* Lead requirements gathering, process design, capability mapping, fit-gap assessments, and solution architecture activities across ServiceNow modules.
* Architect and optimize solutions across IT Service Management (ITSM), Security Operations, Asset Management (HAM/SAM), and Strategic Portfolio Management (SPM).
* Design scalable enterprise workflows, service models, and operating processes that align with business objectives and platform best practices.
* Identify and deliver automation, orchestration, and AI-enabled solutions using Virtual Agents, Predictive Intelligence, Generative AI, and intelligent workflows.
* Establish architecture standards, process frameworks, governance controls, and design patterns to ensure secure, scalable, and maintainable solutions.
* Partner with technical architects, developers, and integration teams to deliver solutions aligned with enterprise architecture, security, privacy, and compliance requirements.
* Provide architecture oversight for platform upgrades, enhancements, integrations, digital transformation initiatives, and complex enterprise programs.
* Design and govern CMDB, Common Service Data Model (CSDM), service mapping, and data management practices across the platform.
* Collaborate with Cybersecurity teams to support Vulnerability Management, platform security, API governance, and risk-management initiatives.
* Lead ServiceNow Asset Management strategies, including Hardware Asset Management (HAM) and Software Asset Management Professional (SAMP) capabilities.
* Support Strategic Portfolio Management (SPM) processes, including demand management, project governance, application portfolio management, and Agile delivery.
* Facilitate architecture reviews, stakeholder workshops, and governance forums to drive platform standardization and business alignment.
* Develop platform adoption metrics, executive dashboards, and value-realization reporting to measure business outcomes and continuous improvement.
* Mentor business analysts, product owners, administrators, and delivery teams on ServiceNow best practices, automation, AI adoption, and platform governance.

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related discipline.
* 8+ years of experience in enterprise technology, platform consulting, service management, business process design, or functional architecture.
* 5+ years of hands-on ServiceNow functional architecture or solution design experience in large enterprise environments.
* Demonstrated experience architecting solutions across ITSM and at least two of the following areas: Security Operations, IT Asset Management, or Strategic Portfolio Management.
* Strong knowledge of ServiceNow ITSM capabilities including Incident, Request, Change, Problem, Knowledge, Service Catalog, CMDB, and Service Operations Workspace.
* Experience designing enterprise workflows, governance processes, operating models, integrations, and service management solutions.
* Strong understanding of workflow automation, AI-enabled service management, Virtual Agents, Predictive Intelligence, and Generative AI capabilities.
* Experience with CMDB, Common Service Data Model (CSDM), Service Mapping, and enterprise data governance practices.
* Strong knowledge of ITIL, Agile delivery methodologies, enterprise architecture principles, and platform governance.
* Excellent communication, stakeholder management, facilitation, leadership, and problem-solving skills.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA).
* ServiceNow Certified Implementation Specialist (CIS) in ITSM, ITAM, SPM, Vulnerability Response, or related modules.
* ServiceNow Certified Application Developer (CAD), Certified Technical Architect (CTA), or Certified Master Architect (CMA).
* ITIL 4 Foundation or higher certification.
* Experience with Hardware Asset Management (HAM), Software Asset Management Professional (SAMP), Strategic Portfolio Management (SPM), Security Operations, and Vulnerability Management.
* Experience implementing enterprise automation strategies, AI governance frameworks, and intelligent workflow solutions.
* Experience supporting large-scale digital transformation, platform modernization, mergers and acquisitions, or global ServiceNow deployments.
* Experience working within global engineering, technology, consulting, professional services, or multi-vendor environments.

**Belong. Connect. Grow. with KBR!**

**About Anoud Technologies**

Anoud Technologies builds scalable, high-quality Insurance product solutions, partnering closely with global stakeholders and delivery teams.

**The Role**

Anoud is hiring an Operations Delivery Manager to own end-to-end delivery of our Insurance product implementation for onshore/global clients, working out of our Chennai offshore team. This is an application implementation delivery role – the person will lead product configuration, rollout, and go-live delivery for insurance clients, not infrastructure or platform operations. Strong stakeholder management is core to this role, as the person will be the primary bridge between onshore business/client stakeholders and the offshore implementation team.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Insurance Product Implementation & Delivery Management**

* Own end-to-end delivery of Insurance product implementations – configuration, testing, UAT, and go-live
* Ensure implementation delivery consistently meets agreed SLAs, OLAs, KPIs, and client expectations
* Establish clear ownership, accountability, and governance across implementation and engineering teams
* Monitor delivery performance, identify implementation risks, and initiate corrective actions
* Drive delivery maturity through standardization, automation, process improvement, and implementation best practices
* Ensure business-critical product rollouts have appropriate coverage, documented procedures, and escalation mechanisms
* Maintain a strong focus on delivery quality, client satisfaction, and product reliability
* Provide regular management reporting covering implementation health, risks, issues, and improvement initiatives

**2. Stakeholder Management (Core Strength Required)**

* Act as the primary offshore point of contact for onshore/global client stakeholders and leadership
* Lead client and internal governance calls, presenting delivery status, risks, and outcomes with clarity and confidence
* Build and maintain trusted, long-term relationships with client stakeholders across business and technology
* Own escalations end-to-end – fast resolution, transparent and proactive communication
* Manage expectations across multiple stakeholder groups (client, onshore leadership, offshore delivery team) simultaneously

**3. Team & People Management**

* Manage and grow team leads and implementation/delivery managers
* Own capacity planning and resource allocation across implementation projects
* Build a culture of ownership and accountability; support career growth and succession planning

**4. AI-Enabled Delivery**

* Actively use AI tools in day-to-day delivery work – reporting, status updates, documentation, risk analysis, and productivity tasks
* Champion the adoption of AI-assisted workflows within the delivery team to improve speed and quality
* Comfortable evaluating and recommending AI tools that can streamline implementation and operational processes

**5. Reporting**

* Own weekly/monthly implementation reporting: SLA adherence, delivery timelines, quality, risk status, and client feedback

**Required Experience**

* 12–16 years in IT Delivery Management, Implementation Management, or Insurance Technology Delivery
* 6–8 years specifically managing offshore delivery/implementation teams reporting into onshore/global stakeholders
* Mandatory: Experience delivering Insurance product implementations (policy admin, claims, underwriting, or related insurance platforms)
* Proven, demonstrable strength in stakeholder management – client-facing experience is essential, not just internal team coordination
* Comfortable using AI tools daily as part of delivery workflow (reporting, documentation, analysis)
* Demonstrated ownership of delivery governance and KPI reporting

**Required Skills**

Insurance Product Implementation • Application Delivery Management • Stakeholder & Client Management • SLA/OLA Management • Delivery Governance • Team Leadership • Capacity Planning • Risk & Escalation Management • Process Improvement • AI-Assisted Delivery Practices

**Preferred Certifications**

* PMP (Project Management Professional) – Preferred for strong project, delivery, planning, risk, budget, and stakeholder management capabilities
* ITIL 4 Foundation / Managing Professional – Preferred for service management, incident, problem, change, and governance experience
* PRINCE2 Practitioner – Preferred for structured project governance and delivery controls
* Agile / Scrum certification – Desirable for Agile, DevOps, and product-oriented delivery environments

dd10e595.description:
**Overview**

Would you like to help shape a secure, resilient, and scalable operating model for a mission-critical Azure managed environment?

The Azure Managed Environment team is seeking a Technical Program Manager to lead secure, resilient, and scalable platform operations. The successful candidate will drive tenant and subscription administration, platform configuration, governance, security controls, cost optimization, patching, and user support while strengthening internal expertise, operational efficiency, and continuous improvement.

In this role, the candidate will partner across engineering, security, governance, operations, and business teams to improve service reliability, accelerate decision-making, and establish repeatable processes and controls. The ideal candidate combines strong technical program management with Azure platform knowledge, operational discipline, and an automation-first mindset.

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

 **Responsibilities**

* Drive Azure platform operations: Coordinate tenant and subscription administration, platform configuration, patching, user support, and operational escalation across the managed environment.
* Establish operational governance: Define clear ownership, service processes, controls, decision forums, metrics, and reporting that improve accountability and execution.
* Strengthen security and compliance: Partner with security engineering to operationalize baseline controls, reduce privileged access, protect sensitive data and intellectual property, and maintain evidence of control effectiveness.
* Manage cross-functional programs: Align engineering, security, finance, support, and business stakeholders around priorities, dependencies, risks, milestones, and measurable outcomes.
* Improve reliability and resilience: Identify operational risks, close process gaps, strengthen escalation paths, and build durable capabilities.
* Optimize Azure cost and capacity: Establish visibility and governance for consumption, cost drivers, optimization opportunities, and resource planning.
* Accelerate automation and continuous improvement: Use telemetry, automation, AI-enabled engineering, and standardized workflows to reduce manual effort and increase execution speed.
* Support control implementation: Coordinate intake, impact assessment, architecture alignment, implementation planning, and operational readiness for new security and platform controls.
* Communicate with leaders: Provide clear, decision-ready updates on service health, risk posture, delivery status, dependencies, and investment priorities.

  
**Qualifications**

**Required Qualifications**

* 1+ year(s) of experience managing cross-functional and/or cross-team projects.
* Bachelor's Degree AND 2+ years experience in engineering, product/technical program management, data analysis, or product development OR equivalent experience.
* Experience managing complex technical programs involving cloud platforms, infrastructure, security, operations, or enterprise services.
* Working knowledge of Microsoft Azure, including tenant and subscription management, governance, platform operations, and service lifecycle concepts.
* Experience defining operating models, governance mechanisms, milestones, dependencies, risks, metrics, and executive reporting.
* Demonstrated ability to coordinate across engineering, security, support, finance, vendors, and business stakeholders without direct authority.
* Experience improving operational processes, service reliability, escalation management, and control execution in a complex environment.
* Experience leading AI-powered transformation initiatives, including the implementation of agentic workflows, automation, and data-driven solutions at enterprise scale.
Familiarity with AI governance, risk management, and responsible AI practices, with the ability to translate emerging AI capabilities into measurable business value.

**Preferred Qualifications**  

* 4+ years of experience managing cross-functional and/or cross-team projects.
* 1+ year(s) of experience reading and/or writing code (e.g., sample documentation, product demos).
* Bachelor's Degree AND 4+ years of experience in engineering, product/technical program management, data analysis, or product development OR equivalent experience.
* Experience with Azure security controls, cloud governance, cost management, patching, identity, or privileged-access risk.
* Experience partnering with internal engineering and operations teams to manage critical processes and oversee the delivery of managed services.

0d62aae7.description:
**Description**
How does Amazon deliver millions of packages faster than customers expect, across the globe, every single day?
  
  
If that question excites you, keep reading. We're looking for a Senior Technical Program Manager to lead the strategy and execution of programs across Last Mile Delivery. This is a high-visibility, high-impact role where your work will shape the delivery experience for hundreds of millions of customers worldwide.
  
  
At Amazon, we're working to be the most Customer-centric company on earth. One customer experience that we’re constantly looking to take to a new level is how we fulfill and deliver their orders. Our Last Mile organization is at the forefront of this mission: pioneering new products and services, partnering with Delivery Service Partners and Amazon Flex, and building a world-class operation that spans North America, Europe, and Asia Pacific. Speed is one of the most customer-visible and strategically important pillars of this work, and you'll be at the center of it.
  
  
As part of Amazon Delivery's PRISM (Central TPM) organization, you will own the end-to-end program strategy for last mile initiatives, driving cross-functional alignment across business, product, and engineering teams to launch and scale programs that move the needle on delivery. You will partner with senior leaders across multiple organizations to define priorities, remove blockers, and deliver results.
  
  
The ideal candidate thrives in ambiguity, brings strong business and technical judgment, and has a track record of delivering complex programs. You are a crisp communicator who can influence at the VP level and translate business goals into actionable roadmaps. If you want to solve one of the most challenging problems in logistics, making delivery faster for every customer, everywhere, this is your role.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Serve as the single-threaded leader owning complex programs across multiple VP organizations
* Identify business and technical requirements with science, operations, product, and engineering stakeholders, translating them into specifications, scoped deliverables, and program roadmap from design through launch
* Lead design and implementation efforts across cross-functional teams, making trade-offs to optimize time-to-market
* Own stakeholder communication through all stages of the product lifecycle, clearly articulating goals, roles, and desired outcomes
* Drive high-level strategic initiatives while being willing to roll up your sleeves and get the job done

The right candidate will have a strong program management background, demonstrated experience leading large to extra-large projects, and a well-rounded technical foundation. You must thrive in an entrepreneurial environment and not be hindered by ambiguity or competing priorities.
  
  
A day in the life
  
  
Your day starts by connecting the dots across teams, aligning product, engineering, and operations leaders on what matters most for our customer and business. You will run strategic reviews, unblock cross-functional dependencies, and make trade-off decisions that keep programs on track. Some days you are deep in data, shaping the roadmap; other days you are in a room full of senior leaders driving alignment on the next big bet. No two days look the same, but every day you are directly influencing how fast customers get their packages.
  
  
**About The Team**
PRISM is Amazon Delivery's central Technical Program Management organization. We drive programs that span Last Mile and partner organizations including Robotics, Pharmacy, Prime Air, and more. The problems we solve sit at the intersection of customer experience, technology, and operations at massive scale. If you want to work on programs that shape how Amazon delivers to customers globally, this is the team to be on.

* 7+ years of technical product or program management experience
* 4+ years of project management disciplines including scope, schedule, budget, quality, along with risk and critical path management experience
* 3+ years of technical program management working directly with software engineering teams experience
* Experience managing programs across cross functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules
* Experience building and evaluating system-level technical design

**Overview**
Would you like to help shape a secure, resilient, and scalable operating model for a mission-critical Azure managed environment?
  
  
The Azure Managed Environment team is seeking a Technical Program Manager to lead secure, resilient, and scalable platform operations. The successful candidate will drive tenant and subscription administration, platform configuration, governance, security controls, cost optimization, patching, and user support while strengthening internal expertise, operational efficiency, and continuous improvement.
  
  
In this role, the candidate will partner across engineering, security, governance, operations, and business teams to improve service reliability, accelerate decision-making, and establish repeatable processes and controls. The ideal candidate combines strong technical program management with Azure platform knowledge, operational discipline, and an automation-first mindset.
  
  
Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Drive Azure platform operations: Coordinate tenant and subscription administration, platform configuration, patching, user support, and operational escalation across the managed environment.
* Establish operational governance: Define clear ownership, service processes, controls, decision forums, metrics, and reporting that improve accountability and execution.
* Strengthen security and compliance: Partner with security engineering to operationalize baseline controls, reduce privileged access, protect sensitive data and intellectual property, and maintain evidence of control effectiveness.
* Manage cross-functional programs: Align engineering, security, finance, support, and business stakeholders around priorities, dependencies, risks, milestones, and measurable outcomes.
* Improve reliability and resilience: Identify operational risks, close process gaps, strengthen escalation paths, and build durable capabilities.
* Optimize Azure cost and capacity: Establish visibility and governance for consumption, cost drivers, optimization opportunities, and resource planning.
* Accelerate automation and continuous improvement: Use telemetry, automation, AI-enabled engineering, and standardized workflows to reduce manual effort and increase execution speed.
* Support control implementation: Coordinate intake, impact assessment, architecture alignment, implementation planning, and operational readiness for new security and platform controls.
* Communicate with leaders: Provide clear, decision-ready updates on service health, risk posture, delivery status, dependencies, and investment priorities.

**Qualifications**
**Required Qualifications**

* 1+ year(s) of experience managing cross-functional and/or cross-team projects.
* Bachelor's Degree AND 2+ years experience in engineering, product/technical program management, data analysis, or product development OR equivalent experience.
* Experience managing complex technical programs involving cloud platforms, infrastructure, security, operations, or enterprise services.
* Working knowledge of Microsoft Azure, including tenant and subscription management, governance, platform operations, and service lifecycle concepts.
* Experience defining operating models, governance mechanisms, milestones, dependencies, risks, metrics, and executive reporting.
* Demonstrated ability to coordinate across engineering, security, support, finance, vendors, and business stakeholders without direct authority.
* Experience improving operational processes, service reliability, escalation management, and control execution in a complex environment.
* Experience leading AI-powered transformation initiatives, including the implementation of agentic workflows, automation, and data-driven solutions at enterprise scale.
* Familiarity with AI governance, risk management, and responsible AI practices, with the ability to translate emerging AI capabilities into measurable business value.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 4+ years of experience managing cross-functional and/or cross-team projects.
* 1+ year(s) of experience reading and/or writing code (e.g., sample documentation, product demos).
* Bachelor's Degree AND 4+ years of experience in engineering, product/technical program management, data analysis, or product development OR equivalent experience.
* Experience with Azure security controls, cloud governance, cost management, patching, identity, or privileged-access risk.
* Experience partnering with internal engineering and operations teams to manage critical processes and oversee the delivery of managed services.
* Experience applying automation, telemetry, dashboards, or AI-enabled workflows to improve operational efficiency and control effectiveness.
* Familiarity with secure control-intake processes, impact assessments, architecture reviews, implementation planning, and operational readiness.
* Technical background in software engineering, cloud engineering, systems operations, or security engineering.

Continuous Improvement

**Required Qualifications**

Why Join Us
  
  
You will play a key role in delivering strategic technology and customer initiatives that drive business value and innovation. **The Team**
------------

Deloitte’s Technology & Transformation practice helps financial institutions modernize their technology platforms and deliver scalable, high-performance solutions. Our Banking & Capital Markets practice focuses on developing and enhancing enterprise applications that support banking operations, regulatory reporting, and compliance requirements. By leveraging Java technologies and regulatory solutions such as Axiom, we help clients streamline financial processes, strengthen reporting capabilities, and address evolving business and regulatory needs.

* Experience in the Banking & Capital Markets domain, preferably involving regulatory reporting.

1f718883.title: Lead Engineer – 1 - Platforms & Solutions
1f718883.description:
Overview:

We are currently looking for a Global IT Infrastructure & Operations Analyst to join our team in Europe. The Global IT Infrastructure & Operations accountabilities include:

* Provide global infrastructure technologies and end-user services focused on availability, quality, cost, and reduced time-to-delivery.
* Define and govern integrated service management practices across global and sector IT services and products.
* Optimize global IT assets and services.
* Manage and provide Software Licenses.
* Provide analytics and derive insights that drive continuous service improvements.
* Prevent business disruption via integrated monitoring and automation.

This role supports the IT Infrastructure & Operations Asset Management Team in Europe.

The primary objective of IT Asset Management is to enable the IT organization to provide effective service to its customers at a justifiable cost through asset lifecycle management. IT Asset Management creates this lifecycle by integrating the key activities of asset management into a unified discipline, focused on the hardware and software that make up our infrastructure and applications. Key activities are: procurement, financial management, contract management, supplier selection, warehousing, maintenance and warranty management, and retirement.

  
Responsibilities:

* Control the lifecycle management of the IT assets in Europe
* Support regional, sector and global demands for IT assets.
* Execute Asset Management internal controls in Europe sector.
* Support Internal reconciliations, local and global IT audits of software applications.
* Implement Continual Service Improvement (CSI) the processes needed to manage all existing and future IT Asset lifecycle.
* Maintain the accuracy and completeness of inventory of hardware and software & track the current usage. Resolving gaps identified in Weekly Key Quality Indicators (KQI).
* Assist IT Purchasing Managers in procuring Hardware & Software and work with Europe sector users to understand IT Asset needs, identify appropriate solutions and help source cost effective vendors.
* Proactively identify purchasing, leasing, maintenance, and usage trends and identify and needed corrections to minimize costs.
* Interacts with other IT and business team management to drive the IT Asset Management team vision on optimizing assets and costs.
* Periodically build and communicate scorecards related to assets management lifecycle to understand asset lifecycle status, process variances, and cost drivers

Qualifications:

* University / College Degree in Social Sciences, Business Management, Computer Science, Master of Information Science, or related field, or related professional experience
* Experience in Hardware & Software Asset Management (Compliance, licenses Software Terms and Conditions) a plus.
* Experience using myIT Services is required.
* Data Management skills to develop insights and analytics to guide key decisions is a plus.
* ITIL certification is preferable
* Knowledge on local regulations and governmental requirements, reporting capabilities is required
* Effective written and verbal English communication skills is a must
* Experience in Program, Project, Service Management
* Strong vendor management, communications, influencing and partnering skills
* General Technical knowledge and background to understand and apply technology relating to Hardware Infrastructure (PCs, Servers, Network Equipment, Printers, etc.)
* Ability to work with senior IT and Business management Teams.
* Must be extremely organized and pay attention to detail.
* Detail oriented with strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

9b33c205.description:
**Job Title:** AWS Agentic AI Architect

**Job Code:** TRX-26044

**Location:** Hyderabad Preferred (PAN India - Hybrid: 3 Days Office / 2 Days Remote)

**Job Type:** Full-time, Permanent

**Number of Openings:** 3

**Salary:** Up to ₹21,00,000 per year

**Schedule:** Day/Mid Shift (12:00 PM – 9:30 PM IST)

About the Role

We are seeking an experienced **AWS Agentic AI Architect** to design and implement enterprise-grade Agentic AI solutions utilizing Amazon Bedrock, AWS AgentCore, Knowledge Bases, and RAG architectures. In this role, you will lead solution architecture, intelligent agent development, cloud integration, AI security, and performance optimization across scalable AWS environments.

Key Responsibilities

* Design and implement enterprise Agentic AI solutions using **Amazon Bedrock Foundation Models, Agents, Guardrails, and Knowledge Bases**.
* Develop intelligent agents using **AWS AgentCore**, focusing on orchestration, planning, memory, and tool integration.
* Build robust **RAG-based applications** using vector databases and integrate AI agents with enterprise APIs, databases, and business systems.
* Architect scalable, secure, and cost-optimized cloud-native AI solutions using core AWS infrastructure services.
* Implement AI governance, security, compliance, and responsible AI practices across enterprise implementations.
* Define solution architecture, conduct technical feasibility assessments, and lead architecture discussions with key stakeholders.

Basic Qualifications

* **Experience:** 6+ years of relevant experience in cloud computing, AI architecture, or enterprise solution development.
* **Core Agentic AI Stack:** Hands-on experience designing and implementing Agentic AI solutions on AWS, with deep expertise in **Amazon Bedrock (Agents, Guardrails, Knowledge Bases)**.
* **Frameworks & Orchestration:** Direct knowledge of **AWS AgentCore**, agent orchestration, planning, memory, and tool integration.
* **RAG & Vector Search:** Proven experience building enterprise Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) applications using vector databases.
* **AWS Cloud Native Stack:** Strong experience with AWS Lambda, API Gateway, S3, DynamoDB, OpenSearch, ECS/EKS, IAM, and Step Functions.
* **Mandatory Certification:** Active AWS Certification (AWS Certified Solutions Architect, AWS Certified AI Practitioner, or AWS Certified Machine Learning – Specialty).

Preferred Qualifications

* Exposure to multi-agent frameworks such as **LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen, or Semantic Kernel**.
* Experience with enterprise vector databases like Amazon OpenSearch, Pinecone, or Weaviate.
* Familiarity with LLM fine-tuning, prompt tuning, model evaluation, AI observability, and MLOps/CI-CD pipelines.
* Knowledge of multi-cloud AI platforms (Azure OpenAI, Google Vertex AI).

Work Location & Shift Details

* **Work Mode:** Hybrid (3 days work from office in Hyderabad preferred, open to PAN India candidates).
* **Shift Hours:** 12:00 PM – 9:30 PM IST.

Pay: Up to ₹2,100,000.00 per year

Application Question(s):

* How many years of experience do you have in Cloud, AI Architecture, or Solution Development?
* Do you have hands-on experience building Agentic AI applications using Amazon Bedrock, Bedrock Agents, and Guardrails?
* Which active AWS certifications do you hold? (e.g., Solutions Architect, AI Practitioner, Machine Learning Specialty)
* What is your experience with AWS AgentCore, RAG architectures, and Vector Databases?
* What is your current CTC, expected CTC, official notice period, and preferred work location?

c9077a01.title: Identity Architect
c9077a01.description:
**About Astellas**

Astellas is a global life sciences company committed to turning innovative science into VALUE for patients. We provide transformative therapies in disease areas that include oncology, ophthalmology, urology, immunology and women's health. Through our research and development programs, we are pioneering new healthcare solutions for diseases with high unmet medical need. Learn more at Astellas.com .

**Are you driven to make a real difference in the lives of patients?**

We're seeking passionate individuals who thrive in dynamic environments, embrace new ideas, and aren't afraid to take intelligent risks. People who act with unwavering integrity and are deeply committed to making a tangible impact.

  

**Purpose and Scope:**  
  
As an Identity Engineer, you will be responsible for designing, administering, supporting, and modernizing enterprise Public Key Infrastructure (PKI) services, including Certificate Authorities (CA), certificate lifecycle management, and cryptographic key management solutions. The role focuses on enhancing security, automating certificate operations, ensuring compliance, and delivering scalable certificate-based authentication and encryption services across on-premises, hybrid, and cloud environments.

**Responsibilities and Accountabilities:**

* Administer, maintain, and support enterprise Public Key Infrastructure (PKI) environments, including Microsoft Certificate Services (AD CS), Certificate Authorities (CA), Registration Authorities (RA), Online Responders, and certificate lifecycle management platforms.
* Manage certificate issuance, renewal, revocation, validation, and recovery processes for users, servers, applications, devices, and non-human identities.
* Design, implement, and maintain PKI architectures, certificate templates, certificate policies, trust hierarchies, and cryptographic standards aligned with business and security requirements.
* Support enterprise certificate lifecycle management solutions, automating certificate enrolment, renewal, discovery, inventory management, and compliance monitoring.
* Administer and maintain Hardware Security Modules (HSMs), cryptographic key management systems, key backup procedures, and secure key storage practices.
* Support digital certificate deployments across servers, applications, web services, databases, network devices, cloud services, VPNs, and authentication platforms.
* Implement and maintain certificate-based authentication solutions, including Smart Cards, FIDO, device certificates, Wi-Fi authentication, VPN authentication, and mutual TLS (mTLS).
* Monitor PKI infrastructure health, certificate expiration risks, cryptographic compliance, and security vulnerabilities to ensure continuous service availability.
* Perform PKI assessments, health checks, audits, security reviews, remediation activities, and modernization initiatives aligned with industry best practices.
* Support cloud-based PKI solutions, including Microsoft Cloud PKI, Azure Key Vault, and integrations with Microsoft Entra ID, Intune, and security platforms.
* Develop and maintain automation solutions using PowerShell and related scripting technologies to simplify certificate lifecycle management and operational activities.
* Maintain PKI documentation, operational procedures, governance standards, audit evidence, and compliance requirements supporting regulatory and security obligations.

  

**Required Qualifications:**

8 to 12+ years of hands-on experience managing enterprise Public Key Infrastructure (PKI) environments and certificate lifecycle management solutions.  

Strong practical experience with Microsoft Active Directory Certificate Services (AD CS), Certificate Authorities (CA), certificate templates, certificate enrollment, and certificate lifecycle processes.  
Demonstrated hands-on expertise in:  
* Public Key Infrastructure (PKI) design and administration.  

  Certificate Authorities, Certificate Revocation Lists (CRLs), Online Certificate Status Protocol (OCSP), and certificate trust chains.  
  Cryptographic concepts including public/private keys, digital signatures, encryption, hashing algorithms, and key management.  
  Hardware Security Modules (HSMs), Azure Key Vault, and cryptographic key protection mechanisms.  
  Certificate-based authentication, TLS/SSL, mutual TLS (mTLS), code signing, and secure communications.
Experience implementing certificate lifecycle management solutions and certificate automation across enterprise environments.  
Experience supporting cloud and hybrid PKI environments integrated with Microsoft Entra ID, Intune, Azure services, and enterprise security platforms.  
Strong knowledge of certificate governance, compliance requirements, cryptographic standards, and security best practices.  
Experience with PowerShell scripting and automation for PKI administration, certificate management, and reporting.  
Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and problem-solving skills within complex enterprise environments.  
* Effective verbal and written communication skills, capable of working with technical and non-technical stakeholders .
  

Preferred Qualifications:

Experience with DigiCert, Keyfactor, AppViewX, Venafi, Microsoft Cloud PKI, or similar certificate lifecycle management platforms.  

Experience with Microsoft Intune certificate deployment (SCEP/PKCS), Azure Key Vault, HSM technologies, cryptographic key management, and enterprise PKI governance.  
Experience implementing certificate automation, non-human identity (NHI) management, machine identity security, and PKI modernization initiatives.  
Knowledge of Zero Trust, modern identity security, certificate-based authentication, quantum-safe cryptography trends, and cloud security architectures.  
* Microsoft certifications such as SC-300, AZ-500, AZ-104, or relevant PKI/security certifications; healthcare or other regulated industry experience is a plus.
  

**Working Environment:**

At Astellas we recognize the importance of work/life balance, and we are proud to offer a hybrid working solution allowing time to connect with colleagues at the office with the flexibility to also work from home. We believe this will optimize the most productive work environment for all employees to succeed and deliver. Hybrid work from certain locations may be permitted in accordance with Astellas’ Responsible Flexibility

  

**What awaits you at Astellas?**

* Global collaboration: Become part of a connected global business of like-minded life science leaders, all dedicated to improving patients' lives worldwide.
* Real-world patient impact: Contribute to transformative therapies that reach patients around the world, knowing your work makes a difference every day.
* Relentless Innovation: Join a company at the forefront of scientific breakthroughs, where you'll have the opportunity to shape the future of healthcare.
* A Culture of Growth: Chart your own course within a supportive environment that values your contributions, champions your development, and empowers you to pursue your passions.
  

**Our Organizational Values and Behaviors**

Values: Innovation, Integrity and Impact sit at the heart of what we do.

Behaviors: We come together as ‘One Astellas’, working with courage and a sense of urgency. We are outcome focused and consistently take accountability for our personal contribution.

We enable healthcare organizations to be future ready and our customer obsession is our driving force. We ensure that our customers achieve what they truly want. We are bold in our actions, nimble in our decision-making, and industrious in the way we work.

**Job Description**

We are looking for a highly skilled and forward-thinking AI Solutions Architect to lead the design, development, and deployment of enterprise-grade AI solutions powered by Large Language Models (LLMs), Agentic AI, and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG). This role demands hands on expertise in designing scalable AI architectures, integrating cutting-edge tools, and ensuring safety, observability, and performance at scale. This role also requires collaboration with engineering leads to drive AI innovation/ discussion, drive technical decisions, ensure delivery ownerships and include Gen AI capabilities in the existing product roadmaps/ frameworks.

The ideal candidate brings strong experience in Software engineering, AI/ML systems, system/ solution engineering, distributed architecture, and platform design, along with recent hands-on work in Generative AI, multi-agent systems, LAG/RAG pipelines, and AI governance. You should be equally comfortable reviewing legacy software architectures, mentoring engineers, working with cross-functional stakeholders, and driving production readiness of AI systems.

Key Responsibilities :-

AI Platform Architecture: Design and own the end-to-end architecture for enterprise AI systems spanning LLM orchestration, multi-agent workflows, RAG pipelines, vector databases, LLM gateways, and API layers. Define reference architectures, design patterns (ReAct, Plan-and-Execute, Tool-Use), and enforce architectural standards through Architecture Decision Records (ADRs).

Agentic AI & Multi-Agent Systems: Architect and implement production multi-agent systems with specialized agents (content generation, compliance auditing, data retrieval, orchestration), inter-agent communication protocols, tool/function calling frameworks, plugin registries, and memory management (conversation buffers, working memory, long-term vector stores). Design human-in-the-loop checkpoints, fallback chains, and graceful degradation patterns.

Production RAG Systems: Design production-grade RAG pipelines including document ingestion (PDF, DOCX, HTML with tables, images, multi-column layouts), chunking strategies (recursive, semantic, document-structure-aware, parent-child), hybrid retrieval (semantic + BM25 + metadata filtering), re-ranking, query analysis/rewriting, citation enforcement, and hallucination detection.

LLM Strategy & Model Routing: Define multi-provider LLM strategies across Claude (Anthropic), GPT-4o (OpenAI), Gemini (Google), and open-source models (Llama, Mistral). Architect intelligent model routing that optimizes for cost, latency, and capability. Evaluate and recommend models for specific use cases based on capability fit, context window, compliance, and deployment constraints.

LLMOps & AgentOps: Build CI/CD pipelines for AI systems prompt versioning and regression testing, automated evaluation suites (RAGAS, LLM-as-Judge), model A/B testing, and staged rollouts. Design observability infrastructure with full execution tracing, token tracking, cost attribution, latency SLAs, and quality dashboards using AgentOps, LangSmith, Langfuse or OpenTelemetry.

Evaluation & Quality Assurance: Design multi-layered evaluation frameworks combining automated metrics (RAGAS, BLEU, ROUGE), LLM-as-Judge pipelines with bias mitigation, embedding-based similarity, and domain-expert human review. Build and maintain golden test datasets (500+ curated QA pairs). Define monitoring for retrieval health, hallucination rates, empty retrieval rates, and user satisfaction.

Explainable AI (XAI): Implement explainability at multiple levels input attribution (RAG citations with chunk-level source mapping), reasoning traces (structured Chain-of-Thought with audit trails), confidence calibration, uncertainty quantification, and contrastive explanations. Produce model cards, data sheets, and system documentation for regulatory compliance.

Responsible AI & Governance: Establish and lead the Responsible AI program including guardrail architecture (input/processing/output guardrails with declarative configuration), bias detection and fairness evaluation pipelines, red-teaming exercises (prompt injection, data poisoning, adversarial attacks), AI security measures, PII redaction, privacy-by-design, and regulatory compliance (EU AI Act, NIST AI RMF, FDA AI/ML guidance, GDPR/CCPA).

Strategic Leadership: Collaborate with Engineering, Product, Business, Legal, and Compliance stakeholders to translate requirements into AI roadmaps. Mentor a team of 20+ engineers through design reviews, technical coaching, and career development. Drive build-vs-buy-vs-open-source decisions and present technical strategy to executive leadership.

Technical Skills :-

Languages & Frameworks: Expert Python; proficient JavaScript/TypeScript. FastAPI, Flask, or Django for backend APIs. ReactJS or Streamlit for AI interfaces.

LLM & Agent Frameworks: Microsoft Agent framework, AutoGen, LangGraph, LangChain, CrewAI, Strands Agents, Semantic Kernel. Deep knowledge of ReAct, Plan-and-Execute, and Tool-Use orchestration patterns.

Cloud & Infrastructure: AWS (Bedrock, SageMaker, Lambda, S3, DynamoDB) and/or Azure (Azure OpenAI, AI Studio, Cognitive Services). Multi-cloud experience preferred.

Vector Databases: Pinecone, Weaviate, Qdrant, pgvector, ChromaDB, or Milvus in production environments.

Document Processing: Azure Document Intelligence, PyMuPDF, Unstructured.io, LlamaParse. Experience with tables, images, and complex PDF/DOCX extraction.

Data & Storage: MongoDB, PostgreSQL, Redis, Elasticsearch. Data modeling for AI-driven applications.

Observability & MLOps: AgentOps, LangSmith, Arize Phoenix, OpenTelemetry, Weights & Biases. CI/CD for AI (GitHub Actions, Jenkins).

LLM Gateway: LiteLLM, Portkey, or custom gateway development for multi-model routing, rate limiting, and cost tracking

Key Competencies :-

Strong architectural thinking with the ability to balance scalability, simplicity, cost, speed, and risk.

Strong people leadership and mentoring capability.

Ability to drive delivery while maintaining technical quality.

Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

Strong problem-solving and decision-making ability in ambiguous environments.

High ownership mindset with focus on business impact and production outcomes.

Commitment to responsible, secure, and ethical AI adoption.

Education :-

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science/ Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, or a related quantitative field.

Ph.D./ Publications or contributions to AI projects/ international journals is a plus

**Qualifications**

AI - Data Science BE/ Btech/ BCA/ Mtech / MBA )

**Additional Information**

This position is required to be filled urgently for Content Supply BU. Would request for quick action.

**Description**
Technical Architect successfully designs and manages the delivery of complex Salesforce solutions for our customers. These technologies include—but are not necessarily limited to Salesforce products and APIs, Apex/Visualforce, Lightning, mobile development technologies, and integration/ETL technologies.
  
  
You are both a big picture thinker and in-depth problem solver, your knowledge and skills are both broad and deep. You take pride in designing systems that stand up to high volumes and won't fail at critical points. You have a good mix of technical and enterprise skills when it comes to architecting a solution, including knowing how to leverage AI development tools like Claude and GitHub Copilot to optimize code quality and accelerate design cycles. The solutions you design are built for the long-term and will scale with the customer's growth plans seamlessly. You have proven experience integrating systems via API's as well as a strong development background.
  
  
**What You'll Actually Be Doing**

* Collaborate with client stakeholders to define requirements, deliverables, and set and manage expectations
* Translate business requirements into well-architected solutions that best leverage the Salesforce platform, including identifying opportunities to embed autonomous AI capabilities using Agentforce
* Drive Enterprise AI Architecture by designing and integrating scalable predictive and generative AI solutions within custom Salesforce environments, optimizing performance, resource consumption, and platform governor limits
* Lead technical design sessions; architect and document technical solutions aligned with client business objectives; identify gaps between client's current and desired end states, using advanced LLMs like Claude to review architectural assumptions and simulate system edge cases
* Provide oversight and governance of Salesforce projects, championing an AI-First Delivery & Engineering methodology by utilizing advanced AI tools, developer assistants (e.g., Cursor, Claude), and agentic evaluation frameworks to accelerate implementation
* Follow and help define coding standards. Lead code reviews during projects to ensure quality and appropriate design patterns are followed, utilizing AI coding assistants to help enforce standards and optimize code performance
* Manage the technical delivery of custom development, integrations, and data migration elements of a Salesforce implementation, championing the team's use of tools like GitHub Copilot to accelerate the generation of Apex classes, mock data, and REST integrations
* Focus on Performance Evaluation & ROI by collaborating with customers to develop evaluation frameworks to measure AI performance and business value for their specific use cases
* Maintain a target billable utilization aligned to the role
* Ability to understand a project and deep dive to debug issues, leveraging AI diagnostics to interpret system logs and isolate performance bottlenecks quickly
* From time-to-time, the TA may be expected to partake in other pre-sales activities such as discovery and technical deep-dive sessions, Proof-Of-Concept (POC) development with prospects using AI tools to build prototypes rapidly
* Liaise with Salesforce product teams to support client implementations
* Travels to client sites for projects, estimated 50-75%

**You're Our Person If...**

* Degree or equivalent proven experience required. Experience will be evaluated based on the core proficiencies for the role (e.g. extracurricular leadership roles, military experience, volunteer roles, work experience, etc.)
* 9-14 years CRM experience with a minimum of 6 years on the Salesforce platform
* Expert level understanding of the Salesforce product suite, including Sales, Service, Community, Marketing, and Community Clouds, as well as an understanding of Agentforce architecture
* Understanding of systems architecture and ability to design scalable performance-driven solutions, including using AI platforms to evaluate architectural scaling and load limits
* Understanding of key design patterns and large data volume limitations and best practices, with experience using AI tools to model data distribution and analyze potential data skew risks
* Understanding of data sharing and visibility considerations and how these play into platform architecture
* Familiarity with platform authentication patterns (SAML, SSO, OAuth) and how to configure them securely
* Knowledge of data integration tools and experience integrating Salesforce with different business systems (ETL, CPQ, marketing automation, reporting, etc.), utilizing AI platforms to parse third-party REST API documentation and map complex data schemas
* Strong understanding of environment management, release management, code versioning best practices, and deployment methodologies
* Experience with platform security capabilities (TLS, SSL)
* Practical fluency using AI coding assistants and modern development ecosystems (e.g., Copilot, Cursor, Claude) to accelerate delivery, document technical architecture, and maintain a high standard of code quality
* Expert level experience defining the system architecture landscape, identifying gaps between current and desired end-states, and delivering a comprehensive solution that will enable achievement of the desired business outcomes
* Strong background in design/development of large web-based systems, or complete software product lifecycle exposure
* Active Salesforce certifications or ability to achieve relevant certifications upon hire.

7a004abc.description:
**Your Job**

The Koch Technology team is seeking an SAP Delivery Manager - EWM and Supply Chain to provide people, functional and delivery leadership across SAP Extended Warehouse Management and adjacent supply-chain capabilities. In this role, you will partner with global business and technology leaders to strengthen critical warehouse, manufacturing and planning operations, while developing talent and advancing scalable enterprise solutions.

**Our Team**

The SAP Delivery Manager, eWM & Supply Chain will report to the SAP Delivery Leader of Koch Technology and will be part of an international team that designs, develops, and delivers enterprise solutions for Koch Industries. The role will provide people, functional, and delivery leadership across SAP Extended Warehouse Management and adjacent Supply Chain capabilities, including Production Planning, Quality Management, and Integrated Business Planning.

**What You Will Do**

* Lead and develop the SAP EWM and Supply Chain team by creating meaningful ownership, building capabilities and encouraging knowledge sharing and continuous improvement
* Partner with warehouse, manufacturing, planning, quality and logistics stakeholders to identify opportunities and translate business needs into technology-enabled outcomes
* Establish delivery priorities, capability roadmaps and improvement initiatives across warehouse execution, manufacturing and supply-chain planning
* Lead the delivery of SAP EWM and Supply Chain support, enhancements, releases, upgrades, projects and transformation initiatives
* Drive cross-functional solution design across SAP EWM, PP, QM, IBP, TM, MM/PTP and connected manufacturing, integration, data and reporting platforms
* Improve operational resilience through effective service management, root-cause analysis, problem prevention and support for business-critical warehouse and planning processes
* Lead delivery readiness for testing, deployment, cutover, hypercare and stabilisation while supporting business continuity and controlled change
* Advance process simplification, standardisation, automation, analytics and practical adoption of SAP innovations and AI-enabled capabilities
* Collaborate across architecture, development, integration, data, security, infrastructure and external delivery teams to deliver scalable and supportable solutions

**Who You Are (Basic Qualifications)**

**Leadership & Business Partnership**

* Proven experience leading SAP eWM or Supply Chain teams within a global delivery model.
* Demonstrated success partnering with Warehouse, Manufacturing, Planning, Quality, Logistics, and business stakeholders to translate business needs into technology solutions.
* Strong stakeholder management, communication, and influencing skills across organizational levels and geographies.
* Ability to lead organizational change, drive adoption, and develop a business-partner mindset within delivery and support teams.
* Experience mentoring SAP professionals and building a culture of accountability, knowledge sharing, innovation, and continuous improvement.

**SAP EWM & Supply Chain Expertise**

* Strong expertise in SAP eWM and broad understanding of end-to-end Supply Chain processes.
* Deep functional knowledge of SAP eWM, including inbound and outbound processing, warehouse structure, putaway and stock removal, handling units, physical inventory, RF processes, replenishment, production integration, and warehouse monitoring.
* Strong knowledge of integrations between eWM and S/4HANA processes, including MM, SD, PP, QM, TM, Asset Care/MRO, manufacturing execution, and automation solutions.
* Working knowledge across one or more adjacent capabilities: SAP PP/PP-DS, SAP QM, SAP IBP, or SAP TM.
* Understanding of planning and manufacturing processes such as demand and supply planning, S&OP, production planning, scheduling, MRP, capacity planning, quality inspection, and inventory optimization.
* Experience with S/4HANA implementation, rollout, upgrade, or transformation programs.
* Exposure to warehouse automation, material-flow integration, dock or yard processes, and high-availability warehouse operations is highly desirable.

**Delivery & Operational Excellence**

* Experience managing global production support, enhancements, and projects, including incident, problem, change, release, and SLA management.
* Proven ability to lead end-to-end delivery from demand shaping and solution design through testing, deployment, stabilization, and value realization.
* Track record of driving operational stability, preventive problem management, process standardization, and continuous improvement.
* Ability to balance operational responsibilities with strategic initiatives and transformation programs.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, prioritization, and risk-management capabilities in business-critical environments

**What Will Put You Ahead**

* Experience leading an SAP S/4HANA EWM transformation, rollout, upgrade or decentralised EWM initiative
* Experience with one or more adjacent capabilities, including SAP PP/PP-DS, QM, IBP or TM
* Experience connecting planning, manufacturing, quality, warehouse execution and logistics capabilities into end-to-end supply-chain solutions
* Experience with warehouse automation, material-handling systems, RF technologies, dock scheduling, yard management or equipment integration
* Exposure to SAP BTP, Fiori, analytics, process mining, AI-enabled operations, and workflow automation.
* Experience leading distributed teams and supporting organisational design, capability building or succession planning
* SAP certification in EWM, S/4HANA Supply Chain, IBP, PP, QM or a related discipline
* Prior experience in a player-coach leadership role.

At Koch companies, we are entrepreneurs. This means we openly challenge the status quo, find new ways to create value and get rewarded for our individual contributions. At Koch, employees are empowered to do what they do best to make life better. Learn how our business philosophy helps employees unleash their potential while creating value for themselves and the company.

Additionally, everyone has individual work and personal needs. We seek to enable the best work environment that helps you and the business work together to produce superior results.

e122a62b.title: Lead Technical Program Manager
e122a62b.description:
**Our Purpose**
*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*
****Title And Summary****
Lead Technical Program Manager
  
  
An AI‑First Technical Program Manager who organizes and accelerates delivery across agent‑amplified pods, using the written specification as the single source of truth and DORA/Core4 metrics as the primary delivery signal. Operates as a connective role in a shared pool — reaching into every pod to keep the program's coordination, risk, and dependency view current without orchestrating day‑to‑day — while preserving every SOX/PCI control gate. Manifest definitions, release integration, scope, and dependencies are tracked with data so all outputs are production‑ready at launch.
  
  
Organizes and accelerates related technology projects across multiple pods, aligning dependent organizations; identifies and removes blockers and always finds the path forward.
  
  
Charts the pod‑to‑pod relay (which pod builds each Epic stage), aggregates cross‑Big‑Rock risks and dependencies into a single view, and drives execution through the monthly Epic cycle anchored to the user guides.
  
  
Serves as the source of truth for status; generates the Monthly Technical Review (MTR), RAID Log, and DORA rollup directly from the session record using M365 Copilot, so the ledger stays current without hand‑keeping.
  
  
Measurably improves, streamlines, and eliminates excess process and ceremony — naming the reader of every artifact before it is kept and retiring legacy ceremonies deliberately.
  
  
Keeps abreast of the evolving AI‑engineering landscape; understands the practical read of what AI can and cannot do — that AI amplifies engineering judgment and leaves that judgment with the human — and asks the right questions to evaluate scalability, latency, security, performance, and data integrity.
  
  
Works with ambiguity and limited guidance, comfortable with the indeterminism of agent‑driven delivery, kept honest by the monthly user guides and real‑customer feedback.
  
  
Transforms raw thoughts into clear, concise communication and can communicate with confidence 3+ levels up; fluent in prompt patterns and agent‑session discipline to produce review‑ready output on the first pass.
  
  
Understands the needs of engineers and BizOps/SRE teams, including the verification tax and the build‑and‑review, follow‑the‑sun pairing that manages it.
  
  
Reviews metrics and proactively seeks improved data and mechanisms for visibility, keeping the program aligned to objectives while preserving all control gates — AIFE removes coordination overhead, not controls.
  
  
Plays an active role in mentoring, recruiting, and growing agent fluency and the Expert‑Generalist skill ladder across pods.
  
  
Experiences
  
  
Anticipate bottlenecks and factor in contingency for unplanned delays, including transition risk from Scrum to the pod model.
  
  
Define success metrics where they are missing, defaulting to the four DORA/Core4 metrics: Deployment Frequency, Lead Time for Changes, Change Failure Rate, and Failed Deployment Recovery Time.
  
  
Recognize discordant views and resolve them through constructive dialog; act as the program's anti‑confirmation‑bias check.
  
  
Continuously assess development processes, test plans, and operations to improve concurrent delivery, including tests‑first/spec‑driven parallelism and same‑session documentation currency.
  
  
Streamline or eliminate excess process wherever the same efforts or issues repeat year‑over‑year.
  
  
Expert with scrum delivery and its evolution into the AIFE monthly Epic and pod‑relay operating model, including the shift from story points to spec‑projected slices.
  
  
AI‑First Tooling & Skills
  
  
M365 Copilot fluency: Excel (RAID Log, dependency matrix, DORA dashboards), Word (MTR generation, handoff notes), Loop/OneNote (async session logs).
  
  
Spec‑as‑ledger discipline: treat the specification as reviewed engineering work; let agents project epic/feature/story records on demand rather than hand‑slicing or pointing.
  
  
Relay and shared‑pool operating model: chart pod relays, manage follow‑the‑sun handoffs, and steer by feedback at Epic boundaries.
  
  
Agent accountability and audit‑safety: ensure a named human directs and reviews every agent output, with session logs and control‑role sign‑offs keeping who‑built/who‑approved auditable.
  
  
**Corporate Security Responsibility**
All Activities Involving Access To Mastercard Assets, Information, And Networks Comes With An Inherent Risk To The Organization And, Therefore, It Is Expected That Every Person Working For, Or On Behalf Of, Mastercard Is Responsible For Information Security And Must:
  
  

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

ab5faa02.title: Solutions Manager
ab5faa02.description:
Solutions Manager

Bhubaneshwar, Odisha

**Job Summary**
---------------

We are seeking a highly technical, rigorous Commissioning Lead to direct and execute end-to-end Level 1 through Level 5 commissioning (Cx) processes for our ultra-high-density AI data center portfolio.

You will be responsible for validating that all electrical power trains, heavy mechanical systems, and complex direct-to-chip liquid cooling networks perform flawlessly under full operational and fault loads. This role ensures our facilities are fully certified and ready to support 100 kW to 150 kW+ per rack GPU deployments without downtime risks.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

1. High-Density Liquid Cooling & MEP Commissioning (L1–L5)

Level 1 to Level 3 Validation: Oversee factory acceptance testing (FAT), equipment receipt inspection, static installation checks, and pre-functional component testing for CDUs, chillers, dry coolers, UPS systems, and generators.

Level 4 Functional Performance Testing (FPT): Lead functional testing of primary and secondary liquid cooling loops, flow rate balancing, pressure differential controls, dynamic fluid quality testing, and electrical load transfers.

Level 5 Integrated Systems Testing (IST): Design and execute full-scale failure mode scenarios, synthetic heat load bank testing at 100 kW–150 kW+ per rack, utility power loss simulations, and emergency cooling switchovers.

2. AI Workload & Thermal Validation

Hydronic & Fluid Quality Certification: Validate pipe flushing, hydro-testing, deionized water chemical treatment, micro-filtration, and automatic leak detection shutdown sequences prior to GPU cluster deployment.

Thermal & Power Density Verification: Verify that environmental controls, coolant distribution units (CDUs), and heat rejection systems maintain required thermal envelopes under maximum synthetic GPU compute loads.

3. Commissioning Governance & Stakeholder Management

Cx Scripts & Protocols: Author, review, and approve custom Level 1–5 commissioning scripts, IST test procedures, matrix load plans, and operating manuals (MOPs/SOPs/EOPs).

Third-Party & Vendor Coordination: Direct third-party commissioning agents (CxA), OEM field engineers, MEP execution leads, and hyperscale client technical representatives.

Issues Tracking & Handover: Manage the Cx issue log (punch list), drive root-cause failure analysis, enforce vendor remediation, and formally sign off on facility operational readiness.

### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in a technical field, or equivalent practical experience.

**About the job**
-----------------

A problem isn’t truly solved until it’s solved for all. That’s why Googlers build products that help create opportunities for everyone, whether down the street or across the globe. As a Technical Program Manager at Google, you’ll use your technical expertise to lead complex, multi-disciplinary projects from start to finish. You’ll work with stakeholders to plan requirements, identify risks, manage project schedules, and communicate clearly with cross-functional partners across the company. You're equally comfortable explaining your team's analyses and recommendations to executives as you are discussing the technical tradeoffs in product development with engineers.

The Geo team is focused on building the most accurate, comprehensive, and useful maps for our users, through products like Maps, Earth, Street View, Google Maps Platform, and more. Every month, more than a billion people rely on Maps services to explore the world and navigate their daily lives.  
  
The Geo team also enables developers to use the power of Google Maps platforms to enhance their apps and websites. As they plot a course for the future of mapping, they are solving complex computer science problems, designing beautiful and intuitive product experiences, and improving our understanding of the real world.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Architect and build operational solutions using Generative AI to enhance moderation, scalability and efficiency. Design and set up assertion based expert workflows for newer FMR vectors.
* Serve as the primary point of contact (POC) for global regulatory workflows, ensuring compliance with mandates like the DSA and CMA.
* Oversee end-to-end project lifecycles from concept to launch, coordinating closely with cross-functional Engineering and Product teams.
* Monitor program metrics and risks, communicating progress and performance effectively to senior leadership.
* Establish and manage in-house and outsourced project execution teams while leveraging internal Google products and tools to drive automation and enhance operational efficiency.

a5c92938.description:
Position Summary

The Manager, Cloud Infrastructure Support is responsible for leading a team of Cloud Administrators and Cloud Engineers delivering Day 2 managed services across public cloud platforms. This role provides operational leadership, workforce management, customer escalation support, performance coaching, and continuous improvement initiatives to ensure exceptional service delivery, customer satisfaction, and operational efficiency. The manager is accountable for team health, business performance, strategic execution, and alignment with Cloud Infrastructure Support (CIS) objectives.

  

Key Responsibilities

Operational Leadership

* Lead a team of Cloud Administrators and Cloud Engineers providing 24x7 public cloud support services.

* Ensure adherence to service level objectives (SLOs), service level agreements (SLAs), quality standards, and operational processes.

* Monitor ticket queues, workload distribution, support coverage, backlog health, and customer impact.

* Drive rapid response and resolution of customer escalations, major incidents, and business-critical events.

Coordinate with Incident Management teams, platform vendors, and cross-functional teams during high-severity incidents.  

  

People Leadership

* Recruit, onboard, develop, and retain high-performing technical talent.

* Conduct regular one-on-one meetings, coaching sessions, goal reviews, and performance discussions.

* Mentor team members on technical, operational, and customer-facing competencies.

* Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, customer obsession, and continuous learning.

Support employee career growth and succession planning.  

  

Service Delivery & Customer Success

* Ensure exceptional customer experiences through proactive operations and effective issue resolution.

* Partner with customer-facing stakeholders to support strategic accounts and address service concerns.

* Review customer trends, service metrics, and feedback to identify improvement opportunities.

* Support onboarding readiness and ongoing service operations for managed cloud customers.

Continuous Improvement & Business Scaling

* Drive automation, operational excellence, and process improvement initiatives.

* Identify recurring operational challenges and lead actions to reduce toil and improve scalability.

* Promote the development of runbooks, knowledge articles, and operational documentation.

Support initiatives that improve efficiency, customer outcomes, and business growth.  

  

Business Management

* Participate in leadership reviews of KPIs, CSAT, SLA attainment, ticket solve layer, capacity planning, onboarding performance, churn risk, and strategic goals.

* Provide regular operational reporting, including weekly Progress, Plans, and Problems (PPP) updates.

Contribute to strategic planning, workforce planning, organizational initiatives, and cross-functional collaboration efforts.  



Required Qualifications

* Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent experience.
* 15+ years of total Experience with 5+ years of experience in cloud infrastructure, systems administration, managed services, or technical support environments.
* 2+ years of people leadership experience managing technical teams.

* Working knowledge of AWS, Microsoft Azure, and/or Google Cloud Platform.

* Experience managing customer escalations and service delivery operations.

* Strong analytical, communication, coaching, and stakeholder management skills.

Fluent English communication skills; Spanish proficiency required.  

  

Preferred Qualifications

* Public cloud certifications (AWS, Azure, GCP).

* Experience in managed services, SRE, DevOps, or modern operational support models.

* Experience leading distributed and geographically diverse teams.

* Demonstrated success driving automation and operational improvement programs.

  

**About Rackspace Technology**

Rackspace Technology is the trusted operator of the full enterprise AI stack, from governed private cloud to AI inference and agents in production. From edge to core to cloud, we operate the infrastructure, data layer, and software integration to deliver business outcomes with the predictable cost, reliability, security, and compliance that regulated and mission-critical environments demand. We support customers in more than 120 countries with AI capabilities spanning private cloud, public cloud, applications, data and cyber resilience.

  

**More on Rackspace Technology**

Though we’re all different, Rackers thrive through our connection to a central goal: to be a valued member of a winning team on an inspiring mission. We bring our whole selves to work every day. And we embrace the notion that unique perspectives fuel innovation and enable us to best serve our customers and communities around the globe. We welcome you to apply today and want you to know that we are committed to offering equal employment opportunity without regard to age, color, disability, gender reassignment or identity or expression, genetic information, marital or civil partner status, pregnancy or maternity status, military or veteran status, nationality, ethnic or national origin, race, religion or belief, sexual orientation, or any legally protected characteristic. 5372995d.description:
**Become our next FutureStarter**
---------------------------------

Are you ready to make an impact? ZF is looking for talented individuals to join our team. As a FutureStarter, you’ll have the opportunity to shape the future of mobility. Join us and be part of something extraordinary!

**Senior Solution Architect**
=============================

Country/Region: IN
