Hyderabad, TG, IN, 500032

Req ID 91772 | Hyderabad, India, ZF India Pvt. Ltd.

  

**Job Description**
-------------------

**About the Team**

Our team builds enterprise-grade AI platforms and solutions across Agentic AI, Generative AI for the software development lifecycle, systems engineering, automated testing, MLOps, computer vision, and engineering data intelligence.

We are looking for architects who can translate complex automotive and engineering challenges into scalable AI, cloud, and software architecture, and help take solutions from research and proof of concept to production across global engineering teams.

  

**What you can look forward to as Solution Architect: AI/ML (m/f/d)**

* **End-to-end ownership:** You'll own the technical architecture of enterprise Generative AI and Agentic AI solutions, from framing the business problem through to secure, observable and cost-efficient production systems.
* **Real-world impact:** You'll turn LLM capabilities into reliable, auditable solutions that hold up against complex enterprise data, strict security and compliance requirements, tight latency and cost budgets, and unpredictable model behavior. This role goes well beyond proof of concept.
* **Architecture leadership:** You'll set the reference architecture, platform patterns and guardrails that multiple engineering teams build on.
* **Strategic decisions:** You'll lead decisions on what to build versus buy, which models to use, and whether to customize models through fine-tuning, weighing quality, cost, scalability and vendor independence.
* **Cutting-edge technology:** You'll design multi-agent systems on leading frameworks and cloud platforms, such as LangGraph, AWS Bedrock and Azure AI Foundry.
* **Visibility and influence:** You'll be the trusted technical authority for business leaders, security teams and enterprise architecture boards.
  

**Your Profile as Solution Architect: AI/ML (m/f/d)**

* A bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, Engineering, AI or a related field.
* 10+ years in software, data or ML engineering, including at least 3 years as a solution or lead architect.
* **Production GenAI delivery:** You have delivered at least 2–3 LLM / Generative AI solutions into production, not only proofs of concept, and owned the architecture and non-functional requirements end to end.
* **Agentic AI:** You have built hands-on agentic systems hands-on, with tool use, state management and human-in-the-loop controls. You've used code-first frameworks such as LangGraph / LangChain or managed platforms such as AWS Bedrock Agents or Azure AI Foundry Agent Service.
* **LLM and model expertise:** You have a strong grasp of LLM fundamentals (transformers, embeddings, context windows). You have hands-on experience customising models through fine-tuning (e.g., LoRA / QLoRA) and evaluating them, and you can choose sensibly between prompting, RAG and training.
* **Engineering and cloud:** You are an expert in Python and API engineering (FastAPI, async, event-driven design). You have strong architecture experience on at least one hyperscaler (AWS, Azure or GCP), including networking, identity and security.
* **RAG, quality and security:** You have practical experience with vector databases, hybrid search and retrieval evaluation. You've implemented LLM evaluation, tracing and observability in production, and you're well-grounded in AI security (prompt-injection defence, data protection).

**Why you should choose ZF in India**

* **Innovative Environment**: ZF is at the forefront of technological advancements, offering a dynamic and innovative work environment that encourages creativity and growth.
* **Diverse and Inclusive Culture**: ZF fosters a diverse and inclusive workplace where all employees are valued and respected, promoting a culture of collaboration and mutual support.
* **Career Development**: ZF is committed to the professional growth of its employees, offering extensive training programs, career development opportunities, and a clear path for advancement.
* **Global Presence**: As a part of a global leader in driveline and chassis technology, ZF provides opportunities to work on international projects and collaborate with teams worldwide.
* **Sustainability Focus**: ZF is dedicated to sustainability and environmental responsibility, actively working towards creating eco-friendly solutions and reducing its carbon footprint.
  

Be part of our ZF team as Senior Solution Architect and apply now!

CAI is a global services firm with over 9,000 associates worldwide and a yearly revenue of $1.3 billion+. We have over 40 years of excellence in uniting talent and technology to power the possible for our clients, colleagues, and communities. As a privately held company, we have the freedom and focus to do what is right—whatever it takes. Our tailor-made solutions create lasting results across the public and commercial sectors, and we are trailblazers in bringing neurodiversity to the enterprise.

**Job Summary**

We are looking for a motivated AI Architect ready to take us to the next level! If you have lead the design, strategy, and implementation of cutting-edge AI/ML platforms and solutions and are looking for your next career move, apply now.

**Job Description**

We are looking for an **AI Architect** to lead the design, strategy, and implementation of cutting-edge AI/ML platforms and solutions. This position will be **full-time** and **remote**.

**What You’ll Do**

* Conduct architecture reviews, design reviews, and guide implementation decisions for high-impact GenAI projects
* Collaborate with product managers, business stakeholders, and executive leadership to align technical architecture with business objectives
* Mentor architects and senior engineers on cloud-native design, AI/ML best practices, and enterprise integration patterns
* Design MLOps pipelines for AI model deployment, versioning, monitoring, and A/B testing
* Architect enterprise integrations with APIs, message brokers (Kafka, RabbitMQ), and legacy systems using event-driven patterns
* Define observability and monitoring strategies using Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, and CloudWatch

Required:

* Deep expertise in cloud-native architectures (AWS/Azure), microservices, API design, and distributed systems
* Strong knowledge of GenAI technologies (LLMs, RAG systems, vector databases, prompt engineering, agentic frameworks)

* Expert-level knowledge of backend frameworks (FastAPI, Node.js, Django), frontend frameworks (React, Angular), and database systems (SQL, NoSQL, vector databases)

* Proven ability to lead cross-functional teams, influence technical decisions, and drive architectural alignment
* Excellent communication skills with ability to present complex architectures to executive leadership and non-technical stakeholders
* Experience managing vendor relationships, technology partnerships, and third-party integrations
* Strong decision-making abilities based on data-driven insights, trade-off analysis, and business impact

  

Preferred:

**The Data Engineer / Data Scientist, Assistant Vice President, will provide technical and strategic leadership for enterprise cybersecurity data, analytics, and AI capabilities. This role will drive the architecture and delivery of scalable data platforms, advanced analytics, machine learning, graph analytics, NLP, and Generative AI solutions that convert complex security telemetry into actionable intelligence. The AVP will partner with cybersecurity, engineering, architecture, governance, and risk stakeholders to enhance threat detection, risk prioritization, operational efficiency, and executive decision-making while establishing scalable engineering and data science practices across the organization**


  
  

**What you will be responsible for**
====================================

* Design and deliver scalable **data pipelines, Lakehouse architectures, data models, and analytics-ready datasets** using Python, SQL, PySpark, Databricks, and cloud technologies.

* Build reusable frameworks for data ingestion, transformation, aggregation, data quality, reconciliation, orchestration, lineage, and observability.

* Develop statistical, machine-learning, and AI models to identify **patterns, anomalies, relationships, threats, and risk signals** across cybersecurity datasets.

* Apply **ML, graph analytics, NLP, and Generative AI** to improve threat detection, vulnerability prioritization, incident enrichment, cyber-risk scoring, and security posture insights.

* Develop AI solutions leveraging **LLMs, embeddings, semantic/vector search, RAG, and intelligent workflows** to summarize, classify, correlate, and enrich cybersecurity information.

* Operationalize data science and AI solutions through **feature pipelines, MLOps, CI/CD, automated testing, model monitoring, and production workflows** .

* Establish strong engineering and responsible AI practices covering **performance, scalability, resiliency, explainability, security, privacy, lineage, governance, and auditability** .

* Partner with cybersecurity, data and platform engineering, architecture, governance, risk, and product teams to translate complex security challenges into scalable **data and AI solutions** .

* Evaluate emerging **data engineering, ML, GenAI, graph, cloud, SIEM/SOAR, and cybersecurity technologies** and drive their practical adoption.

  

**What we value**
=================

These skills will help you succeed in this role:

* Strong technical expertise across **Data Engineering, Data Science, Machine Learning, and AI/GenAI.**

* Ability to lead complex technical initiatives, influence architecture and engineering decisions, and communicate effectively with **technical teams and senior stakeholders** .

* Strong focus on **automation, reusable engineering patterns, operational excellence, governance, and measurable business outcomes.**

**Education & Qualifications**
==============================

**Minimum Qualifications**
--------------------------

* 15 to 20 years of professional experience across **data engineering, data science, analytics, cloud, machine learning, AI, or related technology disciplines.**

* Experience applying data engineering, analytics, ML, or AI techniques to **cybersecurity, risk, fraud, identity, infrastructure, or other large-scale enterprise datasets.**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering, Cybersecurity, Information Systems, or equivalent experience.

* Strong hands-on experience **with Python, SQL, PySpark, Databricks, ETL/ELT, distributed processing, and large-scale data engineering.**

* Experience with **Lakehouse/data platform architecture, data pipelines, modeling, data quality, monitoring, lineage, and performance optimization** .

* Working knowledge of **AWS or comparable cloud data and analytics environments** .

* Experience operationalizing analytical and ML solutions using **CI/CD, version control, testing, monitoring, and MLOps practices** .

* Experience with **Power BI or equivalent visualization technologies.**

* Strong written, verbal, analytical, and stakeholder communication skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

* Master's degree or advanced coursework in Data Science, Computer Science, AI/ML, Statistics, Applied Mathematics, Cybersecurity, or related disciplines.

* Experience with **Databricks/Delta Lake and Medallion architecture patterns** .

* Experience with **LLMs, RAG, embeddings, vector search, prompt engineering, NLP, knowledge graphs, entity resolution, or AI-assisted workflows** .

* Experience working with cybersecurity datasets such as **endpoint telemetry, authentication events, cloud security logs, vulnerability data, asset inventories, network events, incidents, SIEM data, and threat intelligence.**

* Experience in **financial services, regulated industries, or enterprise environments** with strong security, privacy, governance, and audit requirements.

* Relevant **Security+, CySA+, GIAC, CISSP, AWS, Databricks, Data Engineering, ML/AI, or cybersecurity certifications** are advantageous.

  
  

**Technical Skills**
====================

**Skill Area**

**Expected Capabilities**

Python, SQL, PySpark, Databricks, ETL/ELT, Lakehouse, Delta Lake, data modeling, orchestration, data quality, lineage and observability

1e6f25c9.description:
**This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Cloud Operations Architect based in India.**
Join a global cloud operations team dedicated to simplifying cloud infrastructure and helping businesses operate more efficiently. As a Cloud Operations Architect, you will address complex cloud and compute challenges, ensuring customer environments remain reliable, secure, and scalable. You will translate customer requirements into effective cloud solutions while improving operational workflows and support practices. Working closely with engineering, product, sales, and operations teams, you will help identify infrastructure gaps and strengthen service stability. You will also provide technical guidance to frontline support teams and share knowledge through training, technical presentations, and documentation. This remote opportunity is ideal for a cloud professional who enjoys troubleshooting, customer collaboration, and advancing operational excellence across modern cloud environments.
  
  
Accountabilities
  
  

* Align customer requirements with appropriate cloud solutions, infrastructure capabilities, and operational management practices.
* Proactively investigate, troubleshoot, and resolve complex cloud and compute issues across customer environments.
* Support and manage cloud infrastructure and workloads, helping maintain reliability, performance, security, and scalability.
* Develop and improve operational support processes, workflows, and service cadences as part of a global cloud operations team.

**Requirements**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field.
* At least 4 years of experience supporting and orchestrating public cloud environments, serverless platforms, and microservices.
* Strong understanding of cloud computing concepts and practical troubleshooting across virtual machines, Kubernetes, networking, security, storage, and databases.
* Solid networking knowledge, including DNS, TCP/IP, VPNs, content delivery networks (CDNs), and load balancing.
* Familiarity with monitoring and observability tools such as Prometheus and Grafana.
* Understanding of DevOps practices and continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) workflows.
* Familiarity with infrastructure automation and configuration management tools such as Terraform, Ansible, Chef, and Puppet.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to diagnose complex infrastructure and cloud service issues.
* Excellent communication skills and the ability to explain technical concepts clearly to customers and internal teams.

622ae612.description:
**Our Purpose**

*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*

**Title and Summary**

Lead Technical Program ManagerAn AI‑First Technical Program Manager who organizes and accelerates delivery across agent‑amplified pods, using the written specification as the single source of truth and DORA/Core4 metrics as the primary delivery signal. Operates as a connective role in a shared pool — reaching into every pod to keep the program's coordination, risk, and dependency view current without orchestrating day‑to‑day — while preserving every SOX/PCI control gate. Manifest definitions, release integration, scope, and dependencies are tracked with data so all outputs are production‑ready at launch.  
  
Responsibilities  
  
Organizes and accelerates related technology projects across multiple pods, aligning dependent organizations; identifies and removes blockers and always finds the path forward.  
Charts the pod‑to‑pod relay (which pod builds each Epic stage), aggregates cross‑Big‑Rock risks and dependencies into a single view, and drives execution through the monthly Epic cycle anchored to the user guides.  
Serves as the source of truth for status; generates the Monthly Technical Review (MTR), RAID Log, and DORA rollup directly from the session record using M365 Copilot, so the ledger stays current without hand‑keeping.  
Measurably improves, streamlines, and eliminates excess process and ceremony — naming the reader of every artifact before it is kept and retiring legacy ceremonies deliberately.  
Keeps abreast of the evolving AI‑engineering landscape; understands the practical read of what AI can and cannot do — that AI amplifies engineering judgment and leaves that judgment with the human — and asks the right questions to evaluate scalability, latency, security, performance, and data integrity.  
Works with ambiguity and limited guidance, comfortable with the indeterminism of agent‑driven delivery, kept honest by the monthly user guides and real‑customer feedback.  
Transforms raw thoughts into clear, concise communication and can communicate with confidence 3+ levels up; fluent in prompt patterns and agent‑session discipline to produce review‑ready output on the first pass.  
Understands the needs of engineers and BizOps/SRE teams, including the verification tax and the build‑and‑review, follow‑the‑sun pairing that manages it.  
Reviews metrics and proactively seeks improved data and mechanisms for visibility, keeping the program aligned to objectives while preserving all control gates — AIFE removes coordination overhead, not controls.  
Plays an active role in mentoring, recruiting, and growing agent fluency and the Expert‑Generalist skill ladder across pods.  
  
Experiences  
  
Anticipate bottlenecks and factor in contingency for unplanned delays, including transition risk from Scrum to the pod model.  
Define success metrics where they are missing, defaulting to the four DORA/Core4 metrics: Deployment Frequency, Lead Time for Changes, Change Failure Rate, and Failed Deployment Recovery Time.  
Recognize discordant views and resolve them through constructive dialog; act as the program's anti‑confirmation‑bias check.  
Continuously assess development processes, test plans, and operations to improve concurrent delivery, including tests‑first/spec‑driven parallelism and same‑session documentation currency.  
Streamline or eliminate excess process wherever the same efforts or issues repeat year‑over‑year.  
Expert with scrum delivery and its evolution into the AIFE monthly Epic and pod‑relay operating model, including the shift from story points to spec‑projected slices.  
  
AI‑First Tooling & Skills  
  
M365 Copilot fluency: Excel (RAID Log, dependency matrix, DORA dashboards), Word (MTR generation, handoff notes), Loop/OneNote (async session logs).  
Spec‑as‑ledger discipline: treat the specification as reviewed engineering work; let agents project epic/feature/story records on demand rather than hand‑slicing or pointing.  
Relay and shared‑pool operating model: chart pod relays, manage follow‑the‑sun handoffs, and steer by feedback at Epic boundaries.  
Agent accountability and audit‑safety: ensure a named human directs and reviews every agent output, with session logs and control‑role sign‑offs keeping who‑built/who‑approved auditable.

**Corporate Security Responsibility**

All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

39cf54b0.description:
**About Globeia**

Globeia is a bootstrapped global identity verification and document services company, serving clients across multiple countries. We are building a technology platform that turns a manual, paperwork-heavy industry into a software-driven experience. Our Gurugram office is the global hub where tech, design, QA and operations sit together.

**About the Role**

Our CEO is based in Washington DC. Our build team is in Gurugram. We need one person on the ground in Gurugram who owns delivery: someone who knows what every team is working on, what is due when, what is slipping, and why.

This is a program management role, not a product management role. You will not decide what we build. You will make sure that what we have committed to build ships on time, and that tech, design, QA and operations are working in step rather than waiting on each other.

**What You Will Do**

* Own delivery timelines across tech, design, QA and operations, with the product roadmap as your first priority.
* Turn the roadmap into clear plans with milestones, owners and dates, and keep those plans current.
* Run the delivery rhythm: sprint planning, standups, reviews and cross-team check-ins.
* Spot dependencies and blockers early, and resolve them before they cost us a deadline.
* Pressure-test estimates from engineering and design so the dates we commit to are realistic.
* Give the CEO a clear, honest weekly picture of what shipped, what is at risk and what needs a decision.
* Act as the bridge between the CEO and the Gurugram teams, so priorities are understood and nothing is lost across time zones.
* Build the tracking systems, dashboards and processes that keep the office running efficiently as we grow.
* Hold teams accountable to their commitments, and raise problems early rather than late.

**What We Are Looking For**

* 4 to 8 years of experience, with at least 2 years in technical program management, engineering project management or delivery management at a software company.
* A technical background: a degree in engineering or computer science, or earlier hands-on experience as a developer or QA engineer. You don't need to write code, but you do need to understand how software gets built.
* A track record of shipping products on schedule across engineering, design and QA.
* Strong working knowledge of agile delivery and tools such as Jira, Linear or ClickUp.
* Clear, direct written and verbal communication. You can summarize a messy situation in five lines.
* Comfort holding senior people accountable, including people who do not report to you.
* Experience working with a remote founder or leadership team across time zones is a strong plus.
* Startup experience is preferred. We are bootstrapped, we move fast, and there is no layer of management to hide behind.

**Why Join Us**

* You report directly to the founder and CEO.
* You are the person responsible for delivery in our largest office, with real authority to match.
* You will help build a product from scratch.
* There is room to grow into a senior leadership role as the company scales.

**Location and Hours**

This is a full time, on-site role in Gurugram. Some overlap with US Eastern time is expected for regular syncs with the CEO.

You will build and ship production iOS apps for a large Indian banking client, where security, performance and release discipline matter more than in a typical consumer app. You will own features end-to-end in Swift UI, data flow, networking, persistence and App Store release — and be a core part of GeekyAnts' native iOS practice. This is a native-first role, but we are building a mobile team that can flex. Over time you may work on React Native or Flutter projects alongside Swift, with support from our existing teams in both. Candidates who want to stay purely in one stack forever will not be the right fit.

**What you will do:**

* Design, build and maintain iOS features in Swift using UIKit and SwiftUI, following MVVM and clean architecture principles
* Implement secure networking (URLSession, SSL pinning, Codable) and data persistence (Core Data, Realm, SwiftData, UserDefaults) for a banking-grade app
* Write concurrent, responsive code using GCD, OperationQueue, async/await and Combine
* Own quality: unit tests with XCTest, profiling with Instruments, crash triage and fixes
* Handle code signing, provisioning, App Store Connect submissions and release management
* Review code, mentor SE1–SE3 engineers and raise the bar on iOS standards across the team
* Work with the client's product, backend and security teams; translate requirements into technical designs and estimates
* Contribute to presales solutioning (architecture inputs, effort estimates) when needed
* Be open to picking up React Native or Flutter work when project demand shifts

**Must-have skills:**

* 4+ years of hands-on iOS development with at least 2 apps shipped to the App Store.
* Swift & Xcode- Strong Swift (protocols, generics, optionals, value vs reference types), Xcode project structure, UIViewController lifecycle, working knowledge of Objective-C for legacy code
* UI — UIKit- Storyboards, Auto Layout, UITableView, UICollectionView, custom views, navigation and modal flows
* UI — SwiftUI- Views, modifiers, stacks, NavigationStack, TabView, List, Form, sheets and modals; can mix SwiftUI with UIKit
* Concurrency- GCD, OperationQueue, async/await, Task, structured concurrency, thread-safety and main-thread discipline
* State & architecture- @State, @Binding, @ObservedObject, @EnvironmentObject, MVVM, dependency injection (Needle, Swinject or similar)
* Reactive & networking- Combine (publishers, operators, cancellables), URLSession, Codable, SSL/certificate pinning, API error handling
* Persistence- UserDefaults, Core Data; exposure to Realm and SwiftData
* Quality & debugging- Xcode debugger, Instruments (Time Profiler, Leaks, Allocations), crash log symbolication, XCTest unit and UI tests
* Release- Code signing, provisioning profiles, App Store Connect, TestFlight, phased releases

**Good to have:**

* Working exposure to React Native or Flutter, or a demonstrated willingness to learn one
* BFSI / fintech experience: PCI-DSS or RBI-aware development, Keychain, jailbreak and tamper detection, secure storage, biometric auth
* CI/CD for iOS (Fastlane, Xcode Cloud, GitHub Actions, Jenkins)
* Modular architecture (Swift Package Manager, feature modules), Clean Architecture or VIPER
* Accessibility (VoiceOver, Dynamic Type) and localisation
* Experience working in a client-facing or consulting setup

**Who you are:**

* You care about how the app behaves on a slow network and an old iPhone, not just on the simulator
* You can explain a technical trade-off to a non-technical client stakeholder without hiding behind jargon
* You are comfortable owning a feature from estimate to App Store release, not only the coding part
* You are curious about the wider mobile ecosystem and willing to work across stacks when the business needs it
* You give and take code review feedback well and help junior engineers grow

* B.E./B.Tech in Computer Science or IT is preferred.
* Candidates with a relevant MCA or equivalent qualification may also be considered.

The role will own technical direction, delivery governance and capability scaling for Python-led backend platforms and production-grade agentic solutions, leveraging frameworks such as Microsoft Agent Framework, LangGraph, OpenAI Agents SDK, Semantic Kernel, AutoGen, CrewAI or equivalent orchestration patterns to deliver secure, scalable and commercial client outcomes.

The role will contribute to building reusable AI and agentic engineering patterns that support industry experiences across sectors such as Life Sciences, Banking and Capital Markets, Consumer Products and Retail, Industrial Products and Energy. It is suited for a leader who wants to shape platform-first AI delivery, industrialise agentic solutions and help scale EYs next generation of client-facing AI capabilities.

The successful candidate will operate at the intersection of architecture, programme delivery, people leadership and stakeholder management. This role requires the ability to shape platform strategy, lead managers and senior engineers, influence client and internal leadership, and establish reusable engineering practices that can be scaled across programmes.

Your Key Responsibilities

* Own the backend platform engineering strategy across multiple workstreams, teams or programmes, with clear alignment to business objectives and client outcomes.
* Define and govern architecture principles for Python-led backend platforms, Go services, API ecosystems, integration layers, data movement and cloud-native deployment models.
* Lead technical governance forums, architecture reviews, release readiness checkpoints, dependency management and risk review mechanisms.
* Partner with senior stakeholders, programme leaders, product owners and architects to convert strategic priorities into executable engineering roadmaps.
* Build and scale high-performing engineering teams by defining role clarity, capability needs, staffing plans, mentoring models and quality expectations.
* Drive consistent engineering standards across secure coding, automated testing, CI/CD, observability, documentation, operational resilience and production support readiness.
* Identify platform investment areas, reusable assets, accelerators and automation opportunities that improve delivery velocity and reduce programme risk.
* Manage technical escalations, unblock cross-team dependencies and ensure complex delivery issues are resolved with clear ownership and decision-making.
* Guide managers, architects and senior developers through design trade-offs, delivery planning, quality gates and stakeholder communication.
* Promote AI-assisted engineering, agentic application architecture and agent-led delivery practices where they improve productivity, code quality, testing coverage, engineering knowledge reuse and enterprise automation outcomes.
* Define reference architectures for agentic applications using frameworks such as Microsoft Agent Framework, LangGraph, OpenAI Agents SDK, Semantic Kernel, AutoGen, CrewAI or similar orchestration patterns, including tool calling, memory, guardrails, human-in-the-loop workflows, observability and enterprise integration.
* Lead the design and delivery of agentic workflow patterns that combine reasoning, planning, tool execution, retrieval, memory and business-rule orchestration for enterprise-grade use cases.
* Establish engineering guardrails for responsible AI, model selection, prompt patterns, evaluation metrics, hallucination controls, auditability, data privacy and secure enterprise integration.
* Drive reusable agentic accelerators, templates and platform services that improve developer productivity, standardise delivery and enable repeatable client solutions across sectors.
* Collaborate with cloud, data, security, UX and domain teams to industrialise AI agents into production-ready platforms with clear operating models, monitoring, fallback paths and human oversight.

Skills and attributes for success Must-have technical and leadership skills

* Strong background in backend engineering leadership with proven experience across Python, Java and polyglot microservices ecosystems.
* Ability to lead architecture strategy for secure, scalable, observable and cloud-ready enterprise platforms.

3bd26ee1.description:

We are currently looking for a Global IT Infrastructure Operations Analyst to join our team in Europe. The Global IT Infrastructure Operations accountabilities include:

* Manage and provide Software Licenses.

This role supports the IT Infrastructure Operations Asset Management Team in Europe.

The primary objective of IT Asset Management is to enable the IT organization to provide effective service to its customers at a justifiable cost through asset lifecycle management. IT Asset Management creates this lifecycle by integrating the key activities of asset management into a unified discipline, focused on the hardware and software that make up our infrastructure and applications. Key activities are: procurement, financial management, contract management, supplier selection, warehousing, maintenance and warranty management, and retirement.

  
**Responsibilities**

* Support regional, sector and global demands for IT assets.
* Execute Asset Management internal controls in Europe sector.
* Support Internal reconciliations, local and global IT audits of software applications.
* Implement Continual Service Improvement (CSI) the processes needed to manage all existing and future IT Asset lifecycle.
* Maintain the accuracy and completeness of inventory of hardware and software track the current usage. Resolving gaps identified in Weekly Key Quality Indicators (KQI).
* Assist IT Purchasing Managers in procuring Hardware Software and work with Europe sector users to understand IT Asset needs, identify appropriate solutions and help source cost effective vendors.
* Proactively identify purchasing, leasing, maintenance, and usage trends and identify and needed corrections to minimize costs.
* Interacts with other IT and business team management to drive the IT Asset Management team vision on optimizing assets and costs.
* Periodically build and communicate scorecards related to assets management lifecycle to understand asset lifecycle status, process variances, and cost drivers

  
**Qualifications**

* Experience using myIT Services is required.

* Ability to work with senior IT and Business management Teams.
* Must be extremely organized and pay attention to detail.
* Detail oriented with strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

944bcf1e.title: AI Tech solution Architect
944bcf1e.description:
**Overview**  
  

We are looking for a Product Architect for our Image recognition solution, responsible for the end-to-end technical architecture of the product. You will bridge product strategy and engineering execution, defining how the product scales across markets, integrates with enterprise systems, and evolves with AI/CV innovation. This role works in close partnership with the Global Lead, mobile/SDK engineering team, Backend engineering, data science teams, and ST leadership. You will own architecture decisions across mobile, backend, cloud infrastructure, ML inference, and data pipelines ensuring the platform meets global security, compliance, and performance standards while remaining agile enough to support continuous market deployments.

  
**Responsibilities**  
  

**Platform Architecture Design**

* Define and maintain the end-to-end technical architecture for the IR product across mobile, API, ML pipeline, and cloud layers
* Design scalable, multi-region cloud infrastructure on Azure (API Management, Blob Storage, Azure Functions, Cosmos DB, KubeRay/Ray Serve)
* Lead architecture decisions for mobile app features, edge/cloud validation modes, and offline-first mobile scenarios
* Ensure architecture supports high-volume concurrent field usage for global markets
* Define data contracts, API schemas, and integration patterns between mobile app, SDK, backend services, and Salesforce apps

**AI/CV Integration Innovation**

* Architect the ML inference pipeline for computer vision models including SKU detection, planogram compliance, and share-of-shelf measurement
* Design model deployment and versioning strategies using KubeRay/Ray Serve or equivalent orchestration platforms
* Collaborate with data science teams to establish model accuracy baselines, A/B testing frameworks, and continuous learning pipelines
* Evaluate and integrate emerging AI capabilities including LLMs, VLMs, and agentic AI into the IR Product platform roadmap

**Mobile Integration Architecture**

* Define iOS and Android architecture standards for geo-fencing, image capture, local caching, and sync behaviour
* Establish mobile contractor technical standards, code review frameworks, and platform-specific constraints documentation
* Design Salesforce integration patterns for field rep workflows, task assignments, and audit result reporting
* Architect authentication, session management, and device-level security controls for global field deployments

**Infrastructure, Reliability Security**

* Own infrastructure architecture for reliability, fault tolerance, and disaster recovery including GCS fault tolerance and Redis integration for KubeRay head pod stability
* Define storage architecture and lifecycle policies to address accumulation issues (zip files, image blobs, log data) at scale
* Conduct root cause analysis (RCA) for critical infrastructure incidents and produce executive-grade escalation documentation
* Ensure infrastructure architecture meets GDPR, India DPDP Act, and market-specific data privacy regulations for GPS and biometric data

**Data Governance Compliance Architecture**

* Design privacy-by-design data flows for GPS location data, field rep identifiers, and store imagery in compliance with GDPR, DPDP, and other applicable frameworks
* Define data residency, data minimisation, and retention policies across global cloud deployments
* Establish security architecture standards for mobile app communications, API authentication, and cloud storage access controls

**Stakeholder Engagement Documentation**

* Produce clear, executive-facing architecture documentation, TRDs (Technical Requirements Documents) in partnership with the Global PM
* Present architecture proposals and trade-off analyses to leadership and cross-functional stakeholders
* Mentor Engineering team on product architecture standards and best practices
* Maintain a living architecture registry covering system diagrams, ADRs (Architecture Decision Records), and integration maps

  
**Qualifications**  
  

**Experience**

* 12-15+ years in software/product architecture roles, with at least 3 years in mobile-first or AI/ML-integrated platforms
* Proven experience architecting cloud-native platforms on Azure (API Management, Functions, Blob Storage, Cosmos DB)
* Hands-on experience with ML inference infrastructure KubeRay, Ray Serve, TorchServe, or equivalent
* Strong background in mobile architecture for iOS and/or Android, including offline-first design patterns
* Experience with computer vision, image recognition, or retail execution platforms strongly preferred
* Prior exposure to FMCG, CPG, or retail technology platforms is a significant advantage

**Technical Skills**

* Cloud: Azure (primary), AWS/GCP (secondary) infrastructure design, cost optimisation
* Mobile: iOS (Swift/Objective-C), Android (Kotlin/Java), cross-platform considerations (React Native, Flutter)
* ML/AI: Model serving pipelines, MLOps practices, CV model deployment (object detection, classification)
* Integration: REST APIs, event-driven architectures (Kafka, Service Bus)
* Data: Cosmos DB, PostgreSQL, Data bricks, cloud storage lifecycle management, data governance frameworks
* DevOps: Kubernetes, Docker, CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure monitoring and alerting

**Soft Skills Behaviours**

* Exceptional ability to translate complex technical architecture into clear, business-relevant narratives for executive audiences
* Strong cross-functional collaborator equally effective with product managers, data scientists, field operations leads, and compliance teams
* Demonstrated ownership mindset proactively identifies risks, escalates with solutions, and drives resolution end-to-end
* Comfortable operating in ambiguous, multi-market environments with competing priorities
* Excellent written communication capable of producing publication-quality TRDs, PRDs, and architecture decision records

08835cc8.description:
**About the Role**

We are looking for a hands-on AI Solution Architect who can act as the technical face of Antino’s AI practice with enterprise clients and also build what is proposed.

You will lead technical discovery and pre-sales discussions, understand business challenges, design AI/GenAI/Agentic AI solutions, estimate effort, explain trade-offs and risks, and work closely with clients, sales, engineering, and data science teams.

You will build POCs, run demos, write code, define architecture, review production systems, and guide solutions from POC to production.

**Key Responsibilities**

Pre-Sales & Client Solutioning

Lead technical discovery calls, workshops, RFP/RFI responses, proposals, SOWs, estimates, and ROI discussions.

Translate business problems into practical AI/ML, GenAI, and Agentic AI solutions.

Present solutions and technical trade-offs to CXOs, architects, security, data, and engineering teams.

Build rapid POCs and demos to validate and de-risk solutions.

Solution Architecture & Delivery

Design scalable AI architectures using LLMs, RAG, AI Agents, vector databases, embeddings, prompt/context engineering, and knowledge graphs.

Select the right approach across classical ML, LLMs, fine-tuning, RAG, agents, or hybrid solutions.

Build and deploy solutions across AWS, Azure, or GCP.

Design APIs, data pipelines, model serving, enterprise integrations, and microservices.

Build production-grade agentic systems including tool calling, multi-agent workflows, memory, human-in-the-loop, and agent hand-offs.

Establish best practices for security, scalability, performance, observability, evaluation, reliability, and cost optimisation.

AI Engineering & Team Enablement

Stay hands-on with Python, FastAPI, AI frameworks, LLM platforms, and cloud technologies.

Guide engineering and data science teams from POC through production.

Implement AI evaluation, monitoring, guardrails, and LLMOps practices.

Train internal teams and create reusable reference architectures, accelerators, and playbooks.

Track emerging AI models, frameworks, protocols, and research and apply relevant innovations to Antino’s AI practice.

**Must-Have Skills & Experience**

5+ years in software engineering, data science, ML engineering, or solution architecture.

2+ years of hands-on experience designing and deploying GenAI/LLM solutions in production.

Strong experience building Agentic AI, including tool-calling agents, multi-agent systems, agentic RAG, memory, and orchestration.

Strong foundations in statistics, classical ML, deep learning, feature engineering, model evaluation, and time series.

Strong hands-on Python and API development, preferably FastAPI.

Experience with LLM platforms such as OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, Gemini, AWS Bedrock, and open-weight models such as Llama, Qwen, Mistral, or DeepSeek.

Experience with frameworks such as LangGraph, LangChain, LlamaIndex, CrewAI, OpenAI Agents SDK, Claude Agent SDK, or Google ADK.

Experience with vector/search technologies such as Pinecone, Weaviate, Milvus, Qdrant, pgvector, FAISS, Chroma, Elasticsearch/OpenSearch.

Strong knowledge of Advanced RAG, GraphRAG, hybrid search, re-ranking, query rewriting, multimodal RAG, and context engineering.

Experience with MLOps/LLMOps, Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD, model serving, monitoring, evaluation, and cost optimisation.

Strong understanding of distributed systems, microservices, databases, APIs, and secure enterprise architecture.

Strong client-facing and communication skills with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to both CXOs and engineering teams.

Advanced AI Expertise

**Strong understanding of:**

Agent Design: Tool/function calling, ReAct, planning, reflection, memory, state management, HITL, failure recovery.

Multi-Agent Systems: Supervisor, hierarchical and peer-to-peer patterns, task routing and agent hand-offs.

Agent Protocols: MCP and A2A.

RAG: Hybrid search, re-ranking, GraphRAG, knowledge graphs, agentic/multimodal RAG, permission-aware retrieval.

Model Adaptation: Reasoning, long-context and multimodal models, SLMs, LoRA/QLoRA, distillation, prompting vs RAG vs fine-tuning.

Inference: vLLM/TGI, quantisation, prompt caching, model routing, latency and token-cost optimisation.

Evaluation: Ragas, DeepEval, LangSmith, Langfuse, Arize Phoenix, golden datasets, LLM-as-a-Judge, tracing.

AI Security & Governance: Prompt injection defence, guardrails, PII protection, OWASP Top 10 for LLMs, NIST AI RMF, ISO/IEC 42001, EU AI Act, and India’s DPDP Act.

**Good to Have**

Experience in IT services/consulting with global clients across the US, UK, or Middle East.

Experience with enterprise knowledge platforms, knowledge graphs, or Company Brain-style systems.

Production experience in Voice AI, Document AI, or Computer Vision.

Experience with Databricks, Snowflake, BigQuery, or Spark.

Domain exposure to BFSI, Healthcare, Retail, Logistics, or Manufacturing.

AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud certifications.

Open-source contributions, research papers, patents, technical blogs, or conference talks.

**About Antino**

Antino is an AI-native technology consulting company helping organisations embed intelligence into the way they operate.

600+ Engineers | 50 AI Specialists | 400 Projects Delivered | 20 Countries Served

With offices across India, the US, UK, and UAE, Antino has developed Company Brain—a governed intelligence layer connecting enterprise knowledge, people, systems, and workflows to enable smarter decisions and coordinated action.

Pay: ₹3,000,000.00 - ₹5,000,000.00 per year

Work Location: In person

1d0cf13c.title: Events & Engagement Manager
1d0cf13c.description:
**About Masters' Union**

Founded in 2020, Masters Union is a new-age, industry-led university focused on business, technology, engineering, and entrepreneurship. Built around learning by doing, the institution combines academics with real-world projects, startup building, and global exposure, with the ambition of becoming one of the worlds top business schools and multidisciplinary universities over the next two decades.

  

Today, Masters’ Union has nearly 3,500 students across undergraduate, postgraduate, and executive programs, with almost half being experienced professionals. Spread across nearly 5 lakh square feet in Gurgaon and Manesar, the institution houses the PwC Center for Generative AI, a Bloomberg Lab, Gurgaon’s premier maker space, AI and robotics infrastructure, advanced bioengineering workshops, and startup incubation spaces, while also expanding into areas such as bioengineering and genetic engineering.

  

The institution is chaired by Manoj Kohli, former CEO of Bharti Airtel and former Country Head of SoftBank India. Its leadership ecosystem includes Vivek Gambhir, Pankaj Bansal, Sanjiv Bikhchandani, Amitabh Kant, and 30+ other founders, CEOs, investors, and policymakers who contribute to teaching and institution building.

  

Masters’ Union’s flagship postgraduate program has recorded the highest average salary among MBA-equivalent programs in India, with graduates placed at firms such as Bain & Company, Boston Consulting Group, Google, and Microsoft. The institution has also built one of the country’s strongest student startup ecosystems, with 10+ students pitching on Shark Tank India and 20+ students raising external funding for their ventures, alongside several successful creators and internet entrepreneurs.

  

**About the Role**

We are looking for someone who can own high-impact admissions events and student engagement experiences for Masters’ Union. This is not a basic event coordination role. We need someone who can plan, execute, travel, manage vendors, lead a team, coordinate with internal stakeholders, create event pages, manage registrations, and ensure every event directly contributes to admissions outcomes.

The ideal candidate should be operationally strong, comfortable with students and parents, good with timelines, sharp with communication, and able to manage chaos without losing control.

  

**Specifically, this role will involve**

* Planning and executing high-quality admissions events across online and offline formats.
* This includes: Startup Weekends; City meetups; Webinars; Masterclasses; Open houses; Campus visits; Applicant engagement events; Founder sessions; Alumni/student interaction sessions; Conversion-focused events for offered candidates
* Making sure every event feels well-planned, premium, sharp, and aligned with the Masters’ Union brand.
* Owning the full event cycle: Event idea Planning Website page Registrations Communication Execution Attendance Follow-up Reporting
* You will be responsible for: Creating event plans and timelines; Setting up event pages on the website; Managing registration forms
* Sending event communication through email, WhatsApp, and SMS
* Managing student confirmations and reminders
* Coordinating with speakers, faculty, alumni, and internal teams
* Handling venue, food, travel, stay, logistics, and vendor coordination
* Ensuring smooth execution on the day of the event
* Managing a Zoom webinar and a 300-person offline event.
* You will manage online & offline events
* Playing a key role in planning and executing Masters’ Union’s flagship admissions events like Startup Weekends and high-intent applicant experiences.
* This includes: Planning the event format; Coordinating with mentors, founders, faculty, alumni, and students; Managing student participation; Creating team structures and event flows; Handling on-ground execution
* Managing travel and stay for participants, wherever required
* Ensuring the event creates strong engagement and improves admissions conversion
* These events are not just brand-building activities. They are high-impact conversion levers.
* Ensuring all admissions events are correctly listed, updated, and managed on the website.
* This includes: Creating event pages; Updating event details; Managing registration links; Checking page hygiene; Coordinating with website/tech teams; Ensuring correct dates, cities, speakers, forms, and CTAs
* Working with the content and admissions teams to ensure every event has strong communication before and after the event.
* Leading the events execution team and coordinate with multiple internal teams.
* You will work closely with Admissions counsellors, Content team; Design team,Performance marketing team; Website team; Faculty Alumni; Current students; Programme teams
* You should be able to assign responsibilities, track progress, push people for closures, and ensure nothing falls through the cracks.

  

**Ideal candidate will have**

* Minimum 4 years of experience in events, admissions, outreach, student engagement, operations, marketing, or programme management
* Prior experience managing or leading a team is mandatory
* Strong experience planning and executing online and offline events
* Ability to travel for events across cities
* Good communication and stakeholder management skills
* Ability to manage vendors, venues, logistics, and internal teams
* Ability to work with WhatsApp, email, CRM, forms, and event platforms
* Experience in education, edtech, admissions, events, or student-facing roles is preferred
* Skill in assigning tasks, track progress, and ensure closures without constant follow-up
* Comfortability speaking to students, parents, speakers, vendors, and internal teams
* Leading a small team and get work done across functions

76a6f0c0.description:
### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in a technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 10 years of experience in program management.
* 7 years of experience in leadership roles managing and mentoring engineering or technical program management teams.
* Technical experience in one or more core domains: network protocols/Wi-Fi architecture, media streaming technologies, connected-home embedded systems, or consumer subscription/growth platforms.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* 10 years of experience managing cross-functional/team projects.
* Experience managing subscription platforms, billing/commerce integrations, or consumer lifecycle growth programs within hardware/IoT ecosystems.
* Experience managing multi-layered platform programs spanning hardware, operating systems, mobile app surfaces, and cloud APIs.
* Strong understanding of smart home standards and ecosystem protocols (e.g., matter, thread, wi-fi, cast).
* Outstanding executive presence, stakeholder management, and ability to navigate technical trade-offs with executive leadership.

**About the job**
-----------------

Google's projects, like our users, span the globe and require managers to keep the big picture in focus while being able to dive into the unique engineering challenges we face daily. As a Technical Program Manager at Google, you lead complex, multi-disciplinary engineering projects using your engineering expertise. You plan requirements with internal customers and usher projects through the entire project lifecycle. This includes managing project schedules, identifying risks and clearly communicating them to project stakeholders. You're equally at home explaining your team's analyses and recommendations to executives as you are discussing the technical trade-offs in product development with engineers.  
  
Using your extensive technical and leadership expertise, you manage various Engineering-specific programs and teams.

The Google Home team’s mission is to create a home that takes care of the people inside it and the world around it. We are building the helpful home of an ecosystem that learns from users, anticipates their needs, and adapts to them.

We are driving an AI-first strategy to deliver proactive, agentic experiences across our portfolio of First Party (1P) and Third Party (3P) devices. Our Bengaluru (BLR) hub is a critical global engineering center for Google Home. The Technical Program Manager (TPgM) team in BLR drives the end-to-end execution, product quality, and technical roadmap for our core vertical pillars Media, Energy, and Wifi as well as expanding into Subscriptions (Subs) and Growth initiatives that maximize customer adoption, engagement, and long-term ecosystem value globally.

The Google Home team focuses on hardware, software and services offerings for the home, ranging from thermostats to smart displays. The Home team researches, designs, and develops new technologies and hardware to make users’ homes more helpful. Our mission is the helpful home: to create a home that cares for the people inside it and the world around it.

--------------------

* Oversee technical program execution and strategic roadmaps across core home verticals Media (casting, ambient audio/video), Wifi (connectivity, mesh architecture), and Energy (smart climate orchestration) alongside Subscriptions (Subs) and Growth programs (Nest services, premium AI subscription tiers).
* Lead, mentor, and grow a high-performing team of TPgMs. Define engineering delivery structures, foster technical excellence, and balance resource allocations across core vertical infrastructure.
* Act as the program management of the BLR Hub, presenting strategy, TPgM health, and operational risks directly to executive leadership.
* Act as a local site anchor in BLR to drive close collaboration across local and global Engineering, Program Manager, UX, and Data Analytics leads.
* Establish operational governance to manage complex dependencies across home device software, cloud/billing infrastructure, and external partners.

Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. 2a7d1349.title: Global Product Owner and Delivery Lead for Printing Services
2a7d1349.description:
***Job Title:*** *Global Product Owner and Delivery Lead for Printing Services*

* *Location; Hyderabad, India*
* *Job type: Full time*

*About Sanofi*

*At Sanofi, we're chasing the miracles of science to improve people's lives. We're an AI-driven biopharma company, leveraging cutting-edge technology and data to dramatically reduce the time from molecule discovery to delivering life-changing medicines to patients. Our ambition is bold: harness artificial intelligence, advanced analytics, and modern data platforms to revolutionize how we discover, develop, manufacture, and deliver healthcare solutions globally.*

*Our Team: Global Services & Experience – Devices Management*

*The Digital Workplace Services team is at the heart of Sanofi's employee experience and productivity. We design, deliver, and operate the foundational technology services that enable seamless work experiences for over 100,000 employees across 70+ countries. Our mission is to unlock value through intelligent service delivery, user-centric design, and world-class platform management.*

*We're responsible for core services and products that sustain employee productivity and day-to-day operations, covering Office (Multi-Functional Printers) ans M&S Printing Services (such as Zebra Printers, Label Printers, and Thermal Printers), print platform management, managed service vendor governance, and the technology roadmap that powers secure and efficient printing across Sanofi's global footprint. We don't just manage printers—we architect the future of how Sanofi employees print, scan, and share documents, ensuring every device, platform, and service interaction is optimized for performance, security, cost-efficiency, and sustainability.*

*Role Overview*

*As Global Delivery Manager for Printing Services, you will be a strategic leader and hands-on operational manager responsible for evolving Sanofi's global Office Printing Services into a secure, cost-optimized, and future-ready foundation. This is not a traditional printer support role—this is a strategic operational leadership position that bridges vendor governance, product ownership, financial management, platform oversight, and cross-functional stakeholder engagement.*

*You will own the end-to-end delivery of Office Printing Services globally, drive vendor performance excellence, and champion the transformation from reactive device support to intelligent, data-driven print operations. You'll work at the intersection of managed services, device lifecycle management, print platform management, and modern security frameworks, building partnerships with the global managed service provider and internal stakeholders to deliver world-class printing experiences across all Sanofi sites.*

*This role demands a proactive problem-solver who can negotiate, architect, analyze, and lead—someone equally comfortable managing multi-million-dollar budgets, defining technology roadmaps, optimizing print costs, and collaborating with Security and Compliance teams to implement secure print practices. You will drive operational excellence while challenging the status quo and identifying opportunities for automation, cost reduction, and service innovation.*

*Main Responsibilities*

***Managed Service Vendor Governance & Contract Management***

* *Lead the global managed services contract for Office and M&S Printing Services, ensuring the vendor delivers against agreed SLAs, KPIs, and contractual commitments across all Sanofi locations*
* *Define, monitor, and enforce service level agreements (SLAs) and key performance indicators (KPIs) for the managed service provider, conducting monthly/quarterly business reviews and driving corrective actions for under performance*
* *Act as the primary escalation point for vendor performance issues, service disruptions, and contract disputes, coordinating resolution with internal stakeholders and vendor leadership*
* *Collaborate with Procurement, Legal, and Finance teams on contract renewals, amendments, pricing negotiations, and vendor performance assessments*
* *Ensure the managed service provider adheres to Sanofi's security, compliance, data protection, and operational standards for all printing services*
* *Manage vendor relationship at a strategic level, fostering partnership and continuous improvement while maintaining accountability for service delivery*

***Budget Management & Financial Governance***

* *Own and manage the global budget for Office and M&S Printing Services, including hardware, software, managed services fees, consumables, and maintenance costs*
* *Develop annual budget forecasts in collaboration with Finance, tracking actuals vs. budget monthly and providing variance analysis and corrective action plans*
* *Optimize cost efficiency through vendor negotiations, consumption analysis, and identification of cost-saving opportunities (e.g., print policy optimization, device rationalization, etc.)*
* *Approve purchase orders, invoices, and financial commitments related to printing services within delegated authority*
* *Provide regular financial reporting to Digital leadership and Finance stakeholders, including cost per page, total cost of ownership (TCO), and ROI metrics*

***Service Quality & Operational Delivery***

* *Ensure consistent, high-quality delivery of Office (Multi-Functional Printers) and M&S Printing Services (such as Zebra Printers, Label Printers, and Thermal Printers) across all Sanofi sites globally, meeting or exceeding service quality targets*
* *Monitor service performance metrics including device uptime, incident resolution time, user satisfaction (CSAT), and service request fulfillment rates*
* *Drive continuous improvement initiatives to enhance service reliability, user experience, and operational efficiency*
* *Oversee incident and problem management processes for printing services, ensuring timely resolution and root cause analysis for recurring issues*
* *Coordinate with regional Digital teams and site stakeholders to address location-specific service needs and escalations*
* *Conduct regular service quality audits and site visits (virtual or physical) to validate vendor performance and identify improvement opportunities*

***Product Ownership & Technology Roadmap***

* *Serve as the Product Owner for Office and M&S Printing Services, defining the strategic vision, product roadmap, and technology evolution aligned with Sanofi's Digital strategy*
* *Gather and prioritize requirements from business stakeholders, Digital teams, and end users to inform product development and service enhancements*
* *Define and maintain the technology roadmap for printing services, including hardware refresh cycles, software upgrades, security enhancements, and new capability introductions (e.g., mobile printing, secure print release, cloud printing)*
* *Evaluate emerging printing technologies and industry trends, making recommendations for adoption or pilot programs to enhance service value*
* *Collaborate with Enterprise Architecture, Security, and Infrastructure teams to ensure printing solutions align with Sanofi's technical standards and security policies*
* *Manage the product backlog, prioritizing initiatives based on business value, risk, cost, and strategic alignment*

***Platform Management (Outsourced)***

* *Oversee the managed service provider's delivery of platform management services, including print server infrastructure, print management software, and monitoring tools*
* *Define platform performance requirements, availability targets, and technical standards for the outsourced printing platform*
* *Ensure the vendor maintains platform security, applies patches and updates, and adheres to Sanofi's change management and incident management processes*
* *Coordinate with the vendor on platform upgrades, migrations, and technology refresh projects, ensuring minimal disruption to end users*
* *Monitor platform health, capacity, and performance metrics, escalating issues and driving resolution with the vendor*
* *Validate disaster recovery and business continuity plans for the printing platform, ensuring resilience and compliance with Sanofi's IT standards*

***Stakeholder Management & Communication***

* *Build and maintain trusted relationships with senior stakeholders across Digital, Finance, Procurement, and business functions globally*
* *Serve as the primary point of contact and subject matter expert for all Office and M&S Printing Services matters, providing consultative guidance to stakeholders*
* *Communicate service updates, planned maintenance, incidents, and roadmap changes proactively to stakeholders through regular updates and governance forums*
* *Represent Printing Services in Digital governance meetings, Digital leadership forums, and cross-functional planning sessions*
* *Manage stakeholder expectations through transparent communication, issue escalation, and post-incident reporting*
* *Act as the voice of the customer within the vendor relationship, translating business needs into service requirements and holding the vendor accountable for delivery*

***Compliance, Security & Risk Management***

* *Ensure printing services comply with Sanofi's information security policies, data protection regulations (GDPR, HIPAA, etc.), and industry standards*
* *Collaborate with Security and Compliance teams to implement secure printing practices, including user authentication, print release, and data encryption*
* *Conduct regular risk assessments for printing services, identifying and mitigating risks related to data leakage, service availability, and vendor dependency*
* *Ensure vendor compliance with Sanofi's audit requirements, providing documentation and evidence for internal and external audits*

***Service Scope Management***

* *Own and communicate the Office and M&S Printing Services scope boundary: Multi-Functional Printers (MFPs) for office environments, including print, scan, copy, and fax capabilities and M&S Printing Services (such as Zebra Printers, Label Printers, and Thermal Printers)*
* *Proactively manage scope creep risks, escalating and resolving boundary disputes with stakeholders and the vendor*

*About You*

***Required Qualifications***

* *Education: Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business Administration, Supply Chain Management, or related field*
* *Experience: Minimum 8–10 years of experience in IT service delivery, managed services, or vendor management roles*
* *Global Service Management: Minimum 3–5 years of experience managing global Digital services or infrastructure platforms*
* *Contract & Budget Management: Proven track record of managing large-scale managed service contracts, including budget accountability (multi-million dollar contracts preferred)*
* *Product Ownership: Demonstrated experience in product ownership, roadmap definition, or platform management*
* *Vendor Management: Experience managing third-party vendors or managed service providers in a global, multi-site environment*
* *Technical Skills: Strong understanding of Office Printing technologies, including Multi-Functional Printers (MFPs), M&S Printing technologies, including (such as Zebra Printers, Label Printers, and Thermal Printers), and print servers, print management software, and mobile/cloud printing solutions*
* *ITSM Knowledge: Proficiency in IT service management (ITSM) frameworks, particularly ITIL, including incident, problem, change, and service level management*
* *Financial Acumen: Strong budget management and financial analysis skills, including forecasting, variance analysis, and cost optimization*
* *Product Management: Ability to define and manage technology roadmaps, prioritize initiatives, and balance business value with technical feasibility*
* *Roadmap Definition: Ability to define and manage technology roadmaps, prioritize initiatives, and balance business value with technical feasibility*
* *Platform Management: Understanding of platform management concepts, including infrastructure, monitoring, security, and disaster recovery*
* *Agile Methodology: Experience working in Agile environments with product management principles (roadmap definition, backlog prioritization, sprint planning)*

***Preferred Qualifications***

* *Advanced Education: Master's degree in relevant field or MBA*
* *Skills: ITIL Foundation or ITIL Expert certification; Product Management or Agile Product Owner certification , or relevant printing certifications*
* *Print Domain Expertise: Specific experience in Office Printing Services, Multi-Functional Printers (MFPs), M&S Printing Services (such as Zebra Printers, Label Printers, and Thermal Printers) or print management platforms (e.g., LMS, PaperCut, Equitrac, PrinterLogic, or similar)*
* *Cloud Printing: Knowledge of cloud printing solutions and mobile printing technologies*
* *ITSM Tools: Experience with ServiceNow or similar ITSM tools*
* *Compliance: Understanding of data security and compliance requirements for printing services (GDPR, HIPAA, etc.)*
* *Agile Methodology: Agile/Scrum methodologies and product management frameworks*
* *Language: Additional local language proficiency (Telugu/Hindi) is advantageous for Hyderabad site engagement. English is mandatory.*
* *AI & Analytics: Experience with Generative AI tools, machine learning algorithms, and AI-assisted automation*

***Preferred Skills:***

* *Output management Solutions, e.g. LRS Output management and Printing solutions in office and industrial environments*
* *Experience in Agile*
* *Problem-solving and analytical thinking*
* *Collaboration and communication in international teams and with stakeholders*
* *Network and Cloud Knowledge*

***Leadership Competencies***

* *Proactive & Strategic: Self-starter who anticipates challenges, proposes solutions, and drives continuous improvement and innovation*
* *Problem-Solving & Analytical Thinking: Ability to diagnose complex operational, financial, and technical issues and architect scalable solutions*
* *Communication & Influence: Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English; ability to articulate technical and financial concepts to senior leadership and non-technical stakeholders*
* *Collaboration & Teamwork: Proven ability to work effectively in global, cross-functional teams across time zones and cultures*
* *Vendor Management Excellence: Strong negotiation skills with ability to hold vendors accountable while fostering collaborative partnerships*
* *Change Leadership: Comfortable challenging the status quo, driving transformation, and managing resistance to change*
* *Results-Oriented: Track record of delivering high-impact outcomes in fast-paced, dynamic environments with measurable KPIs*
* *Financial Discipline: Strong budget management discipline, including cost-per-page optimization, TCO analysis, and print cost reduction strategies*

*Pursue Progress, discover Extraordinary*

*Better is out there. Better medications, better outcomes, better science. But progress doesn’t happen without people – people from different backgrounds, in different locations, doing different roles, all united by one thing: a desire to make miracles happen. So, let’s be those people.*

*At Sanofi, we provide equal opportunities to all regardless of race, colour, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, or gender identity.*

*Watch our* *ALL IN video**and check out our Diversity Equity and Inclusion actions at* *sanofi.com**!*
