* Prior experience working with startups, industry associations, accelerators, or investor networks is highly beneficial.

081ec633.title: Technical Program Manager
081ec633.description:
**Overview**  

Are you excited about Artificial Intelligence (AI) and what it can do to transform our day-to-day processes and activities? Join the Trust & Integrity Protection team and help shape the future of Digital Asset compliance automation at scale.

As Microsoft deploys new AI agents and AI-enabled technology to transform Digital Asset review processes, we need dedicated ownership for the performance, quality, and continuous improvement of these capabilities.

As an AI Solution PM, Compliance Automation, you will oversee the health and effectiveness of AI agents supporting Digital Asset reviews, identify new AI automation opportunities, and create proof cases that can progress to full production deployment. You will partner with domain experts, compliance stakeholders, operations teams, engineering, and vendors to translate changing risk signals into agent improvements so review coverage continues to grow and quality continues to improve.

This role is a Technical Program Management opportunity based in Bangalore, India. The role requires strong program management fundamentals, data-driven decision making, technical judgment, stakeholder influence, and the ability to manage cross-functional work with minimal guidance across multiple features, workflows, and compliance risk areas.

Microsoft's mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees, we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day, we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

  
**Responsibilities**  

* Own program execution for AI-enabled Digital Asset review capabilities, including agent performance monitoring, issue triage, quality improvement planning, and readiness for launch and post-launch operations.
* Define and maintain success criteria, key performance indicators (KPIs), operational metrics, and telemetry needed to measure AI agent coverage, accuracy, review velocity, quality, risk reduction, and customer experience.
* Partner with risk domain experts to translate emerging risk signals, policy changes, and review findings into clear business requirements, evaluation criteria, backlog items, and prioritized improvement plans.
* Identify new AI and automation opportunities across the Digital Asset review lifecycle, develop hypotheses, evaluate feasibility and impact, and create proof cases that demonstrate readiness for production deployment.
* Coordinate cross-functional work across engineering, risk, compliance, operations, vendor teams, and business stakeholders to deliver improvements on schedule while managing dependencies, risks, tradeoffs, and stakeholder communications.
* Drive data-informed prioritization by analyzing review outcomes, agent performance trends, false positives, false negatives, escalations, feedback, and operational bottlenecks to recommend improvements that increase coverage and quality.
* Support solution design and implementation planning for multiple AI-enabled features or functional areas, ensuring requirements are clear, measurable, and aligned to privacy, security, Responsible AI, and business expectations.
* Develop and manage experimentation, testing, validation, and rollout plans for agent enhancements, including acceptance criteria, go/no-go recommendations, change management, documentation, and operational handoff.
* Create clear documentation, reporting, and stakeholder-ready narratives that explain agent performance, risks, opportunities, launch readiness, and business impact to both technical and non-technical audiences.
* Contribute to program management best practices for compliance automation, including repeatable mechanisms for intake, prioritization, quality review, production readiness, operational support, and continuous improvement.

  
**Qualifications**

### **Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, Business, Program Management, Compliance, Risk Management, or a related field AND 4+ years of experience in technical program management, product/program management, compliance technology, automation, operations, or related work; OR equivalent experience.
* Experience managing cross-functional technical programs, including requirements definition, prioritization, execution planning, dependency management, risk management, and stakeholder communications.
* Experience using data, metrics, KPIs, dashboards, or telemetry to evaluate program or product performance and drive measurable improvements.
* Experience working with AI, automation, workflow tooling, compliance systems, governance processes, or technology-enabled operations.
* Ability to translate ambiguous inputs into clear business requirements, success criteria, experiments, and implementation plans.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to explain technical and compliance concepts clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.

### **Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with AI agents, machine learning evaluation, prompt or agent quality assessment, model performance monitoring, automated testing, or production readiness for AI-enabled solutions.
* Experience supporting compliance functions, governance, or risk management.
* Experience developing proof-of-concept or proof-case work and converting validated opportunities into production-ready solutions.
* Experience with reporting and workflow tools such as Power BI, Excel, Power Automate, Azure DevOps, or similar systems used to manage backlogs, metrics, and operational performance.
* Demonstrated ability to influence stakeholders, resolve ambiguity, manage tradeoffs, and drive alignment across engineering, operations, compliance, and business teams.

  
  

This position will be open for a minimum of 5 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled.

Microsoft is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, citizenship, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, immigration status, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran or military status, race, ethnicity, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable local laws, regulations and ordinances. If you need assistance with religious accommodations and/or a reasonable accommodation due to a disability during the application process**.**

63540869.title: Program Manager - Engineering & Automation Projects , GESI-IN
63540869.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

The Program Manager – Automation & Engineering Projects drives end-to-end project governance for automation, capacity, and Innovation Lab initiatives within the GESI-IN (PMO/Ops Eng/Automation) team. This role is responsible for managing the full lifecycle of approved OP1/OP2 intake requests, maintaining the India Product Development System (IPDS) master tracker, and ensuring project health through continuous risk analysis and timely escalation. The Program Manager owns launch readiness planning with backward-scheduled timelines, coordinates cross-functional stakeholders across Operations, RME, WHS, Finance, GPO and vendor partners, and delivers executive-level business review narratives (WBR, MBR, QBR). Additionally, the role produces monthly newsletters, event-driven flash reports, and leads weekly project reviews and gate-review logistics to maintain cadence and accountability across all active programs.  
  
Key job responsibilities  
1. Tracking all approved OP(OP1 & OP2) Intake requests (ATL/BTL Category) through Laminar intake flow on Capacity, automation initiatives, Innovation Lab, Study & assessment/any other category that requires GESI-IN (Ops Eng/Automation) team’s delivery.  
2. End to end monitor and control of project through continuous risk analysis at each phases by leveraging Source. Timely escalation of leadership support through proper technical write up & WP doc.
  
3. Own the Innovation lab’s master project tracker — India Product Development System (IPDS) phase, milestones, dev-cycle time, RAG status and payback for every active project. Keep it current and audit-ready.  
4. Create and maintain tracker of launch (ETA: Go-Live) backward updated status for timely actions/support.
  
5. Business Review Docs: Owning end to end details & quality of all automation/capacity/IL charters for narratives for all business review docs (WBR, MBR & QBR).
  
6. Monthly Innovation Lab Newsletter — project progress, wins, look ahead and team spotlights.  
7. Issue event-driven flash reports for gate outcomes, milestone hits and critical blockers for leadership attention.  
8. Coordinate across Operations, RME, WHS, Finance, GPO and vendor partners to keep cross-functional commitments on track.  
  
A day in the life  
A typical day begins with a standup reviewing project health dashboards on GES Source, flagging any RAG status shifts or emerging risks across active Engineering projects and automation charter. Mid-morning is spent updating tracker, aligning milestone timelines, and preparing concise escalation notes for leadership. After lunch, cross-functional syncs with Operations, RME, Finance, and vendor partners keep launch commitments on track. The afternoon wraps up drafting business review narratives or newsletter updates, followed by a gate-review prep session to finalize agendas and close out action items before end of day.  
  
About the team  
GESI-IN (Global Engineering Services & Innovation – India) is the team that delivers for Amazon's India network expansion and consolidation. The team partners with Operations, RME, WHS, Finance, GPO and all other cross functional teams to design, develop and deploy engineering solutions, capacity programs, and automation charters that improve safety, quality, and throughput at scale. The team takes ideas from concept through pilot to network-wide rollout. You will join a fast-paced, data-driven group that values deep-dive problem solving, cross-functional collaboration, and a bias for action to deliver measurable impact on the ground.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* Knowledge of MS Excel, Word, and Windows Operating Systems
* Bachelor's degree
* Experience in a fast-paced, automated, industrial, logistics, production or manufacturing environment

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience of automated equipment including packaging machinery, sortation and conveyor systems
* Experience in preventative maintenance systems

**Description**
Amazon, a Fortune 500 company based in Seattle, Washington, is the global leader in e-commerce. Since Amazon started in 1995, we have significantly expanded our product offerings, international sites, and worldwide network of fulfillment and customer service centers.
  
  
It’s no secret that Amazon relies on its technology to deliver millions of packages every day to its customers – on time, with low cost. We build the complex software solutions that work across our vendors, warehouses and carriers to optimize both the time and cost of getting packages delivered. Our products and services already handle thousands of requests per second, make business decisions impacting billions of dollars a year, integrate with a network of small and large carriers worldwide, manage business rules for millions of unique products, and improve the ordering and delivery experience for millions of online shoppers.
  
  
We are looking for a Principal Program Manager to join our growing team in Amazon Shipping (SWA) organization! This position requires influencing across multiple teams, businesses, and senior leaders. The role requires a deep understanding of customer needs and thinking big about how we can make SWA experience for our shippers seamless and delightful. The ideal candidate is excited by product innovation, technology led business excellence, passionate about learning and should view every customer interaction as an opportunity to create an exceptional experience. You will need to be entrepreneurial, and work in a highly collaborative environment.
  
  
You have a track record of exceptional performance and love working in a dynamic, ambiguous, fast-paced environment in which managing multiple projects and priorities is the norm. You have expertise in managing programs that span multiple VP organizations, operating independently in highly ambiguous environments where both the problem and the solution are undefined. You are a strategic thinker who connects technical improvements to business outcomes.
  
  
You dive deep and like the complexity of systems but drive simple, innovative solutions for customer-facing experiences. You have excellent judgment and high standards. You are an articulate, persuasive communicator and a good writer. People trust and respect you and they like to work with you. You are eager to pioneer new experiences, putting the customer first and challenging conventional wisdom.
  
  
Key job responsibilities

The Principal PM will operate with complete autonomy and will be in charge of handling all aspects of technical projects within the SWA organization such as Shipper support, Billing & Payment, Claims and Delivery experience domains.
  
  
As a Principal Program Manager, you will

An ability to take large, complex projects and break them down into manageable pieces, develop functional specifications, then deliver them in a successful and timely manner is expected. * Collaborate and influence team members, product, engineering leaders and work with development teams and other business groups, and presenting projects to senior leadership on a regular basis. This includes building relationships and identifying with stakeholders across the organization.
* Compile, manage, and report on project and portfolio level metrics, post launch adoption, and be responsible for leading many high profile meetings to align on project requirements
* This position requires the ability to operate in ambiguous situations and think outside the box when our customers’ problems may not always have clear solutions. It also requires backbone to lead upward as it will drive program adoption with senior leadership and customers while demonstrating empathy in responding to evolving customer needs.
* Build consensus across VP organizations through effective narratives and presentations, representing complex operational and technical trade-offs clearly
* Manage executive-level escalations with excellent judgment, balancing operational constraints with business priorities
* Establish and own success metrics that connect operational and technical improvements to business outcomes
* Create mechanisms for continuous visibility and proactive risk identification and represent team in Monthly, Quarterly business reviews to translate operational metrics into business impact for executive audiences
* Quantify the business impact of product features, technical improvements and communicate ROI to leadership
* Team Development & Community Building, Drive knowledge sharing, build knowledge artifacts
* Amplify impact by creating and optimizing critical mechanisms that enable teams to deliver independently
* Actively develop the program management community through mentoring, promotion assessments, and knowledge sharing
* Raise the bar for program management excellence across Amazon Shipping
* Streamline processes and drive adoption of best practices across multiple organizations
* Use Generative AI for data analysis, generating insights on technical and business metrics, risks, dependencies and program status management

**You'll Collaborate Closely With**

The right candidate will possess a strong product/program management background, will have demonstrated experience leading large programs for software product development, and will have a good technology exposure. You must be able to thrive and succeed in an entrepreneurial environment, and not be hindered by ambiguity or competing priorities. This means you are not only able to develop and drive high-level strategic initiatives, but can also roll up your sleeves, dig in and get the job done.

* Strong Embedded C expertise with hands-on experience in low-level software, peripheral drivers, memory management, interrupts, boot flows, and real-time constraints.

* Deep understanding of microcontroller and microprocessor architectures, including CPU cores, DSP/accelerators, caches, memory hierarchy, DMA, peripherals, and board-level integration.

* Strong knowledge of automotive communication technologies and protocol stacks including CAN, LIN, Ethernet, TCP/IP, UDS, and related diagnostic/communication concepts.

* Proven experience developing, integrating, and architecting software for automotive OEM, Tier-1, semiconductor, or embedded platform environments.

* Strong experience in MCU/MPU/SoC-based automotive applications, system-level integration, platform bring-up, and software-hardware interface debugging.

Through partnerships across 145 countries and more than 182 offices worldwide, we work with governments, private sector, development partners and other stakeholders to invest in people, strengthen markets, and deliver scalable, data-driven solutions that generate more and better jobs and improve lives. The Information and Technology Solutions (ITS) Vice Presidential Unit (VPU) enables the World Bank Group to achieve its mission of ending extreme poverty and boost shared prosperity on a livable planet by delivering transformative information and technologies to its staff working in over 150+ locations.  
For more information on ITS, see video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?reload=9&v=VTFGffa1Y7w  
  
**Unit Context:**  
  
The WBG Corporate Solutions Department (ITSCO) is focused on the digital transformation of essential corporate services to ensure WBG operations are seamless, resilient, and future ready. Uniting digitalization roadmaps, experience design, process optimization, application delivery, systems management, and technology modernization across 70+ products, the department links business ambition with operational excellence - from intuitive employee experiences and precision payroll to data-driven decision making, intelligent automation, and AI enablement. The unit will oversee vital corporate systems such as personnel administration, global payroll, benefits, tax, pension, budget and planning, cost and expense management, internal audit, ethics and justice processes, heath services, and other essential corporate services. These operations—and their supporting platforms—demand uncompromising accuracy, confidentiality, and resilience, operating in environments where reliability is non-negotiable.  
  
**Duties and Accountabilities:**  
  
The Associate Senior Solutions Architect leads the execution of strategic business requirements by designing integrated, AI-ready technology solutions and guiding their implementation across software, data, and cloud infrastructure. Operating with a high degree of autonomy, this role synthesizes business, information, and technical perspectives to create scalable architectures aligned with enterprise principles. By evaluating functionality, constraints, and compatibility across platforms, it ensures interoperability, stability, usability, and high availability in distributed environments, enabling corporate application teams to deliver with greater velocity, quality, and efficiency.  
  

* Translate budget policy changes and new WBP requirements into functional and technical specifications for planning models, allocation rules, workflows, and approval routing.

  

* Define integration patterns between the planning tools, SAP ERP/FM, HR position data, and the enterprise data platform, keeping one consistent version of budget and actuals.

* Partner with data engineering teams to integrate budget, actuals, and commitment data into the enterprise reporting tools such as Azure Databricks

  

* Deliver trusted budget-versus-actual, trajectory, and performance reporting for WBP, VPU budget teams, and senior management.

  

* Identify and shape AI-enabled opportunities, such as anomaly detection in budget submissions, forecasting support, and natural-language access to budget data, with responsible AI and human oversight built in.

**Selection Criteria**

* Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Finance, Engineering, or a related field with a minimum of 8 years of relevant experience; OR a Bachelor's degree with a minimum of 10 years of progressive experience in enterprise planning, budgeting systems, or SAP BI; or an equivalent combination of education and experience.

  

* Advanced expertise in areas – Data Analysis, Data Engineering, Reporting and Planning.

  

* Required Certifications: Scaled Agile certification (SAFe Architect, SAFe POPM, or SAFe Agilist); Any of the data technology such as Azure Synapse, Databricks or SAP BW/4HANA or SAP BW on HANA (or equivalent SAP BI/HANA certification); Any of the data engineering such as Databricks, Azure, GCP

  

* Recommended: Jedox Certified Modeler or Jedox Certified Consultant;

  

* Optional: TOGAF, or a public financial management credential (e.g., CIPFA, IPSAS certificate).

  

* Demonstrated experience leading the modernization of corporate budget and planning systems — including end to end implementation of planning applications across large, multi-stakeholder organizations with complex financial planning structures.

  

* Strong ability to translate organizational budget priorities and financial planning requirements into practical Jedox implementation strategies, phased rollout roadmaps, configuration decisions, and measurable planning outcomes

  

* Advanced expertise in at least two relevant disciplines, such as financial planning and analysis (FP&A), budget system architecture, Jedox model design, reporting, process redesign for planning cycles, organizational change management, or performance management frameworks.

  

* Proven systems-thinking skills applied to budget and planning environments, including the ability to identify cross-functional data dependencies, resolve model integrity issues, and address root causes of planning inefficiencies within Jedox or connected systems.

  

* Strong advisory and facilitation skills, with experience building trust among finance leads, budget owners, IT teams, and senior management to drive adoption of Jedox-based planning processes and data-driven decision-making

  

* Alongside planning expertise, a strong grasp of modern data technologies, including relational, columnar in-memory (e.g., SAP HANA), MPP warehouse, file-based (Parquet/Delta on cloud storage), and distributed processing platforms (e.g., Apache Spark, Databricks). Also hands-on experience with enterprise reporting tools such as Power BI, SAP BusinessObjects, and Analysis for Office.

  

* Understanding of AI-enabled forecasting, predictive analytics, and emerging automation capabilities within modern planning platforms – Planning and Reporting.

As the World Bank Group continues to evolve, we value candidates who:

* Demonstrate the ability to collaborate effectively across teams, disciplines, cultures, and institutional boundaries.
* Responsibly leverage digital and AI-enabled tools to enhance productivity, learning, and decision-making.
* Bring experience working in fragile, conflict-affected, and violent (FCV) contexts and are encouraged to highlight relevant experience in their application materials, where applicable.

**WBG Culture Attributes:**

3. Empowerment and accountability: Empower yourself and others to act and hold each other accountable for results.

3545fcce.description:
**About US:-**

  

We turn customer challenges into growth opportunities.

Material is a global strategy partner to the world’s most recognizable brands and innovative companies. Our people around the globe thrive by helping organizations design and deliver rewarding customer experiences.

We use deep human insights, design innovation and data to create experiences powered by modern technology. Our approaches speed engagement and growth for the companies we work with and transform relationships between businesses and the people they serve.

Srijan, a Material company, is a renowned global digital engineering firm with a reputation for solving complex technology problems using their deep technology expertise and leveraging strategic partnerships with top-tier technology partners. Be a part of an Awesome Tribe

**Job Description: Technical Architect**
----------------------------------------

**Experience:** 9+ Years  
**Role Type:** Individual Contributor + Team Leadership  
**Shift Timings:** 24×7 environment (General shift working hours)

### **Role Overview**

We are looking for an experienced **Technical Architect** with strong expertise in cloud-native architecture, containerized platforms, and enterprise-grade system design. The role requires hands-on technical leadership, stakeholder collaboration, and team management to deliver scalable, secure, and highly available solutions in a 24×7 production environment.

### **Key Responsibilities**

* Architect, design, and review **end-to-end technical solutions** aligned with business and non-functional requirements.
* Lead and mentor a **technical team**, providing architectural guidance, best practices, and technical direction.
* Collaborate closely with **stakeholders, product owners, and leadership** to translate business goals into technical architecture.
* Define and enforce **architecture standards**, patterns, and governance across platforms.
* Ensure **high availability, scalability, security, and performance** of applications deployed on cloud and container platforms.
* Drive **CI/CD strategy, automation, and DevOps best practices**.
* Support and troubleshoot **Linux-based systems** and production incidents when required.
* Design and operate solutions in **air-gapped / restricted network environments**.
* Review and guide **infrastructure as code (IaC)** implementations.
* Ensure adherence to **security, compliance, and quality standards** across the SDLC.
* Work closely with monitoring and SRE teams to ensure observability and proactive incident management.

### **Mandatory Skills & Experience**

### **Experience & Leadership**

* **9+ years** of overall IT experience.
* **3–4 years of experience as a Technical Architect**.
* Proven experience in **managing and mentoring technical teams**.
* Strong **stakeholder management** and communication skills.

### **Cloud & Platform**

* Strong expertise in **Microsoft Azure**, including:
  + Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS)
  + Cosmos DB
  + Azure Functions
  + Azure PostgreSQL
  + Azure Key Vault
  + Azure Storage Services
* Hands-on experience with **containerization and orchestration**:
  + Kubernetes
  + Docker

### **Operating Systems & Monitoring**

* Strong **Linux troubleshooting** skills.
* Experience with monitoring tools such as:
  + Dynatrace
  + Prometheus (or similar observability tools)

### **DevOps & Automation**

* Infrastructure as Code using **Terraform**.
* CI/CD tools and practices:
  + Azure DevOps
  + GitHub Actions
  + GitLab CI
  + ArgoCD

### **Security & Code Quality**

* Experience with **artifact management and code quality tools**:
  + JFrog
  + SonarQube
* Understanding of **secure SDLC and DevSecOps practices**.

### **Specialized Experience**

* Prior experience working in **air-gapped environments** or highly secured networks.

### **Good-to-Have Skills**

* Familiarity with **MLOps technologies and workflows** (a strong plus).

### **Soft Skills**

* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Excellent verbal and written communication.
* Ability to work independently and handle complexity in a fast-paced environment.
* Ownership mindset and strong accountability.

27c7a493.description:

Information Technology Group, Information Technology Group > IT Engineering

**General Summary:**

Cloud Implementation: Own & drive the deployment of platform solutions with a strong emphasis on AWS, Infrastructure as Code, and GitOps driven workflows.
  

* Kubernetes Platform Engineering (EKS): Provision, upgrade, and operate production EKS clusters and core platform services in multi-tenant environments, including autoscaling patterns using Karpenter.
* GitOps & CI/CD Enablement: Build and maintain GitOps workflows using Argo CD and CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions, enabling repeatable, audited delivery patterns.
* Optimization & Performance: Continuously evaluate and tune platform capabilities and services to improve reliability, performance, and cost efficiency for development teams.
* Observability: Build and maintain robust monitoring/alerting and recovery processes for platform services and components leveraging Datadog and Prometheus/Grafana.
* Security & Policy: Implement secure-by-default cluster and workload patterns, including network and policy controls (e.g., Cilium and Kyverno), RBAC, and least-privilege access.
* Design & Collaboration: Contribute to technical design docs and proposals; collaborate with Platform Architects for validation/approval and drive implementation through delivery.

* 3+ years hands-on experience operating Kubernetes in production environments; EKS strongly preferred
* 3+ years of leadership skills, with experience mentoring engineers, driving execution, and collaborating with cross‑functional stakeholders
* Strong hands-on experience with Terraform and Infrastructure as Code practices (modules, state management, environment promotion, CI integration)
* Strong hands-on experience with AWS, especially VPC/networking, IAM, and EKS-related services
* Strong understanding of GitOps and CI/CD concepts with practical experience using Argo CD and GitHub Actions
* Practical experience implementing and operating observability (metrics/logs/alerts) for platform services

  

Kubernetes certifications (CKA/CKAD; CKS a plus). Kubernetes certificates are highly desirable

* Experience with policy-as-code tooling such as Kyverno (writing/enforcing policies, exceptions, rollout strategy)
* Experience operating Datadog and Prometheus/Grafana at scale (dashboards, alert tuning, SLOs)

e74d0be7.description:
**Project Role :**
Business Architect
  
  
**Project Role Description :**
Identify opportunities to deliver tangible business value by assessing the current state, capturing high-level requirements, and defining business solutions. Translate business needs into technology-enabled solutions and operating models. Support transformation by developing business cases and guiding implementation of key initiatives.
  
  
**Must have skills :**
Oracle Transportation Management
  
  
**Good to have skills :**
NA
  
  
**Minimum 7.5 Year(s) Of Experience Is Required**
**Educational Qualification :**
15 years full time education
  
  
**Summary**
As an OTM Consultant, you will lead and deliver Oracle Transportation Management (OTM) solutions for global clients. This role demands strong functional and technical expertise in OTM, experience in end-to-end implementations, and the ability to work independently or as part of a team. You will collaborate with stakeholders to design optimized solutions, configure OTM modules, and ensure successful project delivery.
  
  
**Roles & Responsibilities**

* Lead or participate in full lifecycle OTM implementation projects, including requirement gathering, solution design, configuration, testing, and deployment.
* Configure OTM modules such as Order Management, Shipment Management, Execution & Visibility, Finance, and FTI.
* Develop and maintain automation agents, workflows, and custom events. Perform functional and technical analysis, troubleshoot issues, and optimize system performance.
* Support OTM Cloud implementations and on-premise to cloud migration activities.
* Manage integrations with ERP/WMS systems and external partners.
* Prepare functional documentation, process flows, and configuration guides.
* Act as a solution lead, guiding junior consultants and ensuring adherence to best practices. Collaborate in Agile/DevOps environments, contributing to CI/CD pipelines and version control processes.

**Professional & Technical Skills**

* 6–12 years of experience in Oracle Transportation Management (OTM), with at least 2–3 full lifecycle implementations.
* Strong knowledge of OTM functional configurations and technical architecture.
* Hands-on experience with SQL, PL/SQL, and OTM-related data structures.
* Expertise in OTM Cloud, automation agents, and customizations. Familiarity with integration frameworks, external distance/rate engines, and BI Publisher reporting.
* Strong understanding of logistics and supply chain processes. Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

**Additional Information**

* Good to have: Certifications in Oracle OTM or related SCM modules, experience in performance tuning and optimization of OTM configurations, exposure to 3PL/4PL logistics environments and freight forwarding business, knowledge of DevOps pipelines and Agile methodologies.
* The candidate should have 6-12 years of experience in Oracle SCM Transportation Management.
* This position is open at multiple Accenture locations.
* 15 years full time education is required.

Title
  
Solutions Consultant (Pre-Sales) - Enterprise SaaS Demos

Job ID
  
#JOL-SLE-IN-101326

Location
  
Chennai, Tamil Nadu, IN

**Summary**
  
Jolly Technologies is a Silicon Valley-based software company with more than 40,000 customers and millions of users, including many Fortune 500 companies and other world-renowned organizations.

Our products are B2B enterprise, multi-tenant, cloud-hosted SaaS platforms used by organizations with demanding business, security, and IT requirements across North America, Europe, Australia, and worldwide. Depending on business needs, you may work on one or more of our products.

We are looking for a technically fluent **Solutions Consultant** to conduct live product demonstrations for prospective customers in North America, Europe, Australia, and worldwide. You will run discovery with business stakeholders, tailor demos to their requirements, and confidently handle in-depth technical questions from their IT, security, and compliance teams across a wide range of enterprise topics.

**Working Hours (US Shift)**
  
Fully remote, work-from-home contract position. Our customer demos take place between 6:00 AM and 2:00 PM US Pacific Time. **You must be available approximately 7:30 PM - 3:30 AM IST on weekdays** (one hour earlier, 6:30 PM - 2:30 AM IST, during US daylight saving time).

**Responsibilities**
  

* Conduct live online demonstrations of our SaaS platforms for prospective enterprise customers
* Run discovery calls to understand business workflows, IT requirements, and decision criteria, and tailor each demo accordingly
* Answer in-depth technical questions from customer IT, security, and compliance teams on topics such as identity and access management (SSO, user provisioning, role-based access), APIs and webhooks, third-party integrations, data security and encryption, privacy and compliance frameworks (e.g., SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR), data residency and retention, hosting, availability, and disaster recovery, network and firewall requirements, mobile apps and device management, data import and export, audit logging, and multi-tenant architecture
* Assist with security questionnaires, RFPs, and technical requirement checklists
* Set up and configure trial accounts and proofs of concept to match customer scenarios
* Work with the sales team on deal strategy and next steps
* Share customer feedback, feature requests, and product gaps with the product and engineering teams
* Answer product questions from prospective and existing customers by email

**Requirements**
  

* Bachelor's degree, preferably in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field
* 3+ years in pre-sales, solutions consulting, sales engineering, implementation, or technical account management for B2B SaaS or enterprise software
* Proven experience giving live software demonstrations to both business and IT audiences, ideally to international customers
* Strong working knowledge of enterprise IT and cloud SaaS architecture, including identity and access management (e.g., SAML/OIDC, SCIM, Microsoft Entra ID, Okta), REST APIs and webhooks, integration patterns, data security and encryption, compliance frameworks, and cloud hosting concepts
* Able to quickly learn new technical areas and research accurate answers to questions you have not seen before
* Comfortable reading API documentation and working with tools such as Postman and JSON (writing production code is not required)
* Excellent spoken and written English
* Professional, organized, self-motivated, and customer-focused
* Strong references from previous managers

**Important**
  
This is a technical, customer-facing pre-sales role. You will not write code, but you must be comfortable leading technical conversations with enterprise IT teams. If your demo experience is mainly with consumer products or services, or your background is primarily in call-center or BPO work, this role is not a fit.

**Compensation**
  
₹22,00,000 - ₹32,00,000 per year (commensurate with experience)

**Application Process**
  

* Reply with your resume (PDF or Word) to **jobs.2026 @ jollytech.com** with subject “JOL-SLE-IN-101326”
* Include your desired salary
* Include 3-5 concise bullet points describing the software products you have demonstrated and to whom
* **Include a link to a 2-3 minute video** (Loom, unlisted YouTube, Google Drive, etc.) in which you explain an enterprise technical concept of your choice to a customer's IT manager (for example, how single sign-on works, how a REST API integration works, or how customer data is kept separate in a multi-tenant SaaS platform). Applications without a video will not be considered.

0be55365.title: Engagement Manager
0be55365.description:
Bit about us

At Progreva, our mission is to be a leading progressive, values-driven organization that transforms the employee experience, whether in the office, at home or wherever our people choose to work. Our employees’ and contractors’ well-being comes first.

We’re building a culture of camaraderie, work-life balance and empathy, where people feel comfortable, confident and empowered, with the ownership, space and autonomy to succeed.

We believe that when we take great care of our people, they take exceptional care of our clients. That’s why we work only with clients who share our employee-centric values. And yes, we also build breakthrough digital products for our global clients, and have fun along the way!

Job Overview

We are seeking an experienced
**Engagement Manager**
to lead Progreva’s engagement with a global energy-technology enterprise, delivered through our European delivery partner. The role has three parts:

·      a
**hands-on consultant**
embedded in the client’s IT organisation

·      a
**trusted advisor**
who helps application owners modernise their systems and grows the account

·      the
**people lead**
for the Progreva engineers on the programme

You will help the client’s application managers put their needs into words, show them what modern technology makes possible, and turn that into well-scoped work for our team. You will also build the same consultative, opportunity-spotting mindset in our engineers.

Responsibilities:

Client-facing Business Analysis

·      Work inside the client’s IT organisation as a
**billable business analyst / application consultant**
, first alongside an experienced Progreva consultant, then on your own.

·      Run
**requirement workshops**
with application managers and users, and turn their needs into user stories, acceptance criteria and prioritised backlogs.

·      Create and maintain
**application documentation**
: functional specs, process flows, architecture overviews, user guides and runbooks.

·      Find
**security and compliance gaps**
(penetration-test findings, access management, outdated components) and coordinate the fixes.

Account Growth & Solutioning

·      Map the client’s applications, understand each product’s users and roadmap, and spot pain points early.

·      Shape
**modernisation opportunities**
: .NET upgrades, cloud migration, UX redesign, test automation and QA, AI automation, data platforms, dashboards and analytics.

·      Turn opportunities into
**scoped proposals**
(problem, solution, estimate, business value), and work with Progreva leadership and our delivery partner to turn them into statements of work.

·      
**Coach engineers**
to spot improvement opportunities in their own products, run regular opportunity reviews, and collect each application’s annual roadmap.

·      Maintain the
**account opportunity pipeline**
and report growth progress to Progreva leadership.

Team Management

·      
**Set clear goals and expectations**
, track individual and team performance, and give regular feedback and support for career development.

·      
**Handle escalations**
as the first point of contact for delivery issues, and own
**account growth**
alongside Progreva leadership.

·      Support
**hiring, onboarding, documentation and knowledge transfer**
, so the team keeps the right skills and continuity across locations.

·      Coordinate plans, timelines, dependencies and status reporting so that commitments are
**delivered on time and to quality**
.

Stakeholder & Partner Management

·      Build long-term relationships with application managers, IT leadership and our delivery partner’s account team.

·      Run regular account and service reviews covering delivery, team health, risks and opportunities.

·      
**Travel to Europe**
when needed (up to 1 month per year) for workshops, planning and partner meetings.

An ideal candidate:

**Education:**
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering or IT. An MBA is a plus.

**Skills:**

·      
**6–10 years in IT services**
, including 3+ years in a client-facing BA, consultant, project manager or customer success role, and
**2+ years leading a small team**
.

·      A
**proven track record of growing an account**
by finding, scoping and winning follow-on work.

·      Enough
**technical grounding**
to talk credibly with engineers about software development, cloud, databases, APIs, data/BI and application security. No coding is expected.

·      Strong at
**requirements elicitation and documentation**
, using tools such as Jira/Azure DevOps and Confluence.

·      A
**consultative communicator**
with excellent English, comfortable advising senior business and technical stakeholders without overselling.

·      A natural
**people leader**
who sets clear expectations, gives honest feedback and keeps a distributed team motivated.

·      Familiar with Agile/Scrum. CBAP, SAFe PO/PM, PSM/CSM or PMP is a plus.

·      Experience with
**European clients**
, or in the
**energy, utilities, manufacturing or industrial**
domain, is a strong advantage.

·      Comfortable working
**CET hours**
.

What is in it for you?

·      Helping build an employee-centric, values-driven organization

·      Being part of a growing start-up that is setting new standards for employee well-being while delivering breakthrough digital products

·      Working in an international, distributed environment for industry-leading clients

·      A hybrid setup: 3 days a week at our Baner, Pune office and 2 days from home

·      Working as part of a large client organization, with interesting challenges every day, rather than in an “outsourced model”

·      A competitive salary, a performance-based incentive and a
**healthy work-life balance**

·      A
**visible leadership role**
with direct access to the founder and room to grow as the account grows

How to Apply:

Send your resume and a short cover letter explaining your interest in the
**Engagement Manager**
role to hr@progreva.com. During the interview process you’ll also speak with members of our team to learn about our culture and values. We’ll keep interviewing until we find the right person, so if you’ve read this far, we’d love to hear from you!

689dba8c.title: Technical Program Manager, Google TV
689dba8c.description:
### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in a technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 5 years of experience in program management.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* Experience managing software engineering/technical portfolios and delivering large-scale business/organizational transformations.
* Experience managing cross-functional or cross-team projects.
* Experience in leveraging AI tools and technology.
* Experience with dashboarding and scripting (SQL) to improve automation and processes.
* Ability to lead technical discussions with engineering leads to resolve complex issues and manage dependencies.
* Ability to navigate ambiguity with ease while introducing structure.

**About the job**
-----------------

A problem isn’t truly solved until it’s solved for all. That’s why Googlers build products that help create opportunities for everyone, whether down the street or across the globe. As a Technical Program Manager at Google, you’ll use your technical expertise to lead complex, multi-disciplinary projects from start to finish. You’ll work with stakeholders to plan requirements, identify risks, manage project schedules, and communicate clearly with cross-functional partners across the company. You're equally comfortable explaining your team's analyses and recommendations to executives as you are discussing the technical tradeoffs in product development with engineers.

Google TV is an intuitive interface with the ability to organize content across providers to help users find what they want to watch. It has redefined the TV experience to ensure the entire experience is built around users’ needs and what they love to watch, so they can discover the most interesting content to consume. These experiences are highly personalized, Google-smart, content and voice-forward and powered by AI/ML - helping users access the world’s media and knowledge.

Google TV is redefining the TV experience to make it highly personalized, Google-smart, and content-forward to help users access the world’s media. Through recent launches like Chromecast with Google TV, we bring together the best of Google. Google TV is focused on scaling across the OEM ecosystem; working closely with third-party streaming partners plus many teams across Google (for example: Ads, Play, and YouTube); and building a business on TV platforms, OTT devices, and mobile devices. With millions of active users of our products plus being amidst the quickly evolving media and entertainment industry, there are plenty of opportunities for the team and individuals in it.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Lead the planning, execution, and delivery of multiple medium-to-large software engineering programs, ensuring technical and operational improvements directly align with organizational OKRs.
* Drive complex technical projects from requirements to launch, managing schedules, resolving roadblocks, and proactively mitigating risks and dependencies.
* Partner closely with engineering, product management, UX, data science, and go-to-market teams to define, prioritize, and implement key features, infrastructure, and workflows.
* Collaborate with engineering directors, product leaders, and TPM groups to simplify execution, establish best practices, and transform the overall operational effectiveness of the organization.
* Foster shared understanding across teams and communicate program status, technical requirements, and strategic goals effectively to all levels of leadership.

Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form.

63c4037b.title: Technology Program Manager
63c4037b.description:
JLL supports the Whole You, personally and professionally.
  
  
Our people at JLL are shaping the future of real estate for a better world by combining world class services, advisory and technology to our clients. We are committed to hiring the best, most talented people in our industry; and we support them through professional growth, flexibility, and personalized benefits to manage life in and outside of work. Whether you’ve got deep experience in commercial real estate, skilled trades, and technology, or you’re looking to apply your relevant experience to a new industry, we empower you to shape a brighter way forward so you can thrive professionally and personally.
  
  
We have an immediate need for a seasoned Technical Program Manager in Bengaluru. The profile we’re seeking calls for 15–20 years of corporate experience, with proven leadership in technical program management within large-scale software engineering environments.
  
  
Below is a comprehensive job description outlining key requirements and expectations.
  
  
1. Strategic Program & Transformation Leadership
  
**Program Governance:** Establish and maintain organizational standards for program delivery, ensuring that technical excellence, security-by-design, and operational reliability are embedded in every project.
  
**Cloud-Native Evolution:** Lead the transition from legacy monolithic systems to modern, cloud-native architectures (Microservices, Serverless, Containerization). Oversee the end-to-end lifecycle of cloud migrations and optimizations.
  
**Data Transformation Initiatives:** Strategize and execute complex data engineering programs, including the implementation of real-time streaming pipelines, data lakehouse architectures, and large-scale data migrations to support AI/ML and analytics.
  
2. Engineering Operations & Governance
  
**Operating Mechanisms:** Establish and refine the "Rhythm of Business" (RoB) for the engineering organization, including monthly operational reviews, quarterly planning (OKRs), and executive status reporting.
  
**Resource & Capacity Modeling:** Lead complex capacity planning exercises to ensure engineering talent is aligned with the highest-priority strategic initiatives.
  
**Agile Maturity:** Acting as a "Coach of Coaches," elevating the maturity of Agile practices across distributed teams. Standardize Scrum frameworks while allowing for team-level autonomy.
  
**Ceremony Excellence:** Supporting high-stakes ceremonies, including multi-team Big Room Planning, Scrum-of-Scrums, and AI-augmented Backlog Refinement sessions to identify cross-program dependencies.
  
**Incident Governance:** Partner with SRE and DevOps teams to define and enforce Incident Management protocols. Oversee the lifecycle of critical (P0/P1) incidents, ensuring rapid restoration of services.
  
**Post-Mortem Culture:** Enabling a "blame-free" post-mortem culture. Ensure that Root Cause Analysis (RCA) leads to actionable backlog items that prevent recurrence and improve system hardening.
  
3. Cross-Functional Technical Orchestration
  
**Stakeholder Alignment:** Act as the primary liaison between Engineering, Data Science, Product Management, and Business Operations. Translate complex technical trade-offs into clear business risks and opportunities for executive leadership.
  
**Dependency Management:** Proactively identify and resolve "hidden" bottlenecks across distributed teams. Manage complex interdependencies in multi-cloud and hybrid environments to ensure seamless integration.
  
**Vendor & SaaS Integration:** Orchestrating the technical integration of third-party SaaS platforms and managed services, ensuring they meet internal security, performance, and data governance standards.
  
3. Technical Strategy & Architecture Alignment
  
**Systems Thinking:** Partner with Architects to ensure program milestones align with technical standards. Provide "architectural judgment" to prevent technical debt and ensure scalability.
  
4. Risk Management & Predictive Planning
  
**Advanced Risk Mitigation:** Overseeing proactive risk management framework for zero non-compliance and/or overdues.
  
  
Required Qualifications
  
**Education:** Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related technical field.
  
**Experience:** 15–20 years of progressive experience in Technical Program Management, with at least 5 years in a Principal or Lead capacity within a large-scale Software Engineering organization.
  
**Cross-Functional Leadership:** Exceptional ability to influence without authority and build consensus across diverse technical and non-technical stakeholder groups.
  
**Tooling:** Expert-level proficiency with JIRA, Confluence, and advanced roadmap visualization tools. Familiarity with AI-assisted project management tools is a plus.
  
**Soft Skills:** Superior communication, negotiation, and conflict-resolution skills. Ability to maintain clarity and direction in highly ambiguous, fast-paced environments.
  
  
If this job description resonates with you, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet all of the requirements below. We’re interested in getting to know you and what you bring to the table!
  
  
Personalized benefits that support personal well-being and growth:
  
  
JLL recognizes the impact that the workplace can have on your wellness, so we offer a supportive culture and comprehensive benefits package that prioritizes mental, physical and emotional health.
  
  
About JLL –
  
  
We’re JLL—a leading professional services and investment management firm specializing in real estate. We have operations in over 80 countries and a workforce of over 102,000 individuals around the world who help real estate owners, occupiers and investors achieve their business ambitions. As a global Fortune 500 company, we also have an inherent responsibility to drive sustainability and corporate social responsibility. That’s why we’re committed to our purpose to shape the future of real estate for a better world. We’re using the most advanced technology to create rewarding opportunities, amazing spaces and sustainable real estate solutions for our clients, our people, and our communities.
  
  
Our core values of teamwork, ethics and excellence are also fundamental to everything we do and we’re honored to be recognized with awards for our success by organizations both globally and locally.
  
  
Creating a diverse and inclusive culture where we all feel welcomed, valued and empowered to achieve our full potential is important to who we are today and where we’re headed in the future. And we know that unique backgrounds, experiences and perspectives help us think bigger, spark innovation and succeed together.

426ec4de.title: SoC Program Manager
426ec4de.description:
CScale is building the interconnect for gigawatt-scale AI. As AI scale-up moves toward deployments spanning thousands of accelerators and dozens of racks, the network needs to deliver high bandwidth, predictable low latency, and continuous communication. CScale is building integrated optical interconnect designed for this new scale, enabling accelerators to work together like a single, much larger computer. But at this scale, performance is only part of the challenge. Optical failures are inevitable, and the system needs to keep running. CScale is designing the interconnect for continuity.
**Lasers will fail. Compute shouldn’t.**
The ambition is simple:
**Build AI interconnect you can take for granted.**
CScale came out of stealth in September 2026 with $145 million in Series C funding, bringing total funding to $188 million.
  
  
**Role And Responsibilities**

* Be the primary point of contact for SoC program execution, and own the end-to-end plan from concept to release to manufacturing: architecture, IP, RTL, verification, physical design, DFT, tapeout, bring-up, validation, qualification and sampling.
* Build the integrated plan across SoC and chiplet/multi-die design, hardware, firmware, software, foundry, packaging, test and QA.
* Set milestones, phase gates and the critical path (spec freeze, RTL freeze, netlist and timing signoff, tapeout readiness) with engineering leads, and own the gate reviews.
* Front-end: Drive RTL milestones and the RTL change-control process, track lint/CDC/RDC and DFT closure, and own verification closure (coverage, regression health, bug burn-down).
* Physical design: Drive floorplan, bump map, timing and power convergence, IR/EM and signoff, and coordinate netlist, constraint, IP-view and package handoffs across FE, PD, analog and packaging.
* Emulation: Own the emulation and FPGA prototyping plan, and make sure results feed back into RTL and firmware before tapeout.
* SW interfacing: Keep hardware and software aligned on register map, memory map, boot flow and driver/firmware interfaces, and track SW readiness for bring-up.
* Dependencies: Maintain a cross-team dependency tracker with owners and dates, resolve blockers, and escalate with options and a recommendation.
* Manage IP vendors (SerDes, PCIe/Ethernet/UCIe, processor cores, PHYs), the foundry and OSAT partners, holding them to delivery and quality commitments.
* Manage scope, schedule, budget, MPW/mask and resource plans, and drive decisions when they change.
* Identify technical and schedule risks early (IP maturity, timing, power, area, package co-design, test coverage), drive mitigation, and escalate.
* Define program health metrics and build the executive dashboards (bug burn-down, coverage, timing and power convergence, bring-up status).
* Own sample readiness and release-to-manufacturing criteria with engineering and operations, including ATE test, yield and silicon characterization.
* Run the program cadence across global sites and establish program management processes and tools as CScale moves into production.

**Skills And Knowledge**

* Strong technical program management: integrated scheduling, critical path ownership, driving issues to closure.
* Working knowledge of the full SoC flow: architecture, IP integration, RTL, verification (UVM, formal, emulation), physical design, STA, DFT, tapeout, post-silicon validation and qualification.
* Enough technical depth to engage engineers on PPA, IP configuration, clocking/reset, power domains and package co-design tradeoffs.
* Familiarity with emulation platforms, firmware/software bring-up, and high-speed interfaces (PCIe, Ethernet, UCIe, SerDes).
* Leads matrixed teams through influence, decides well with incomplete information, and communicates clearly with engineers and executives.
* Proficient with scheduling and tracking tools (MS Project, Jira, Notion).
* Bonus: reliability qualification (JEDEC/AEC), production test, yield ramp.

**Required Experience**

* 12+ years in semiconductor product development, including 7+ years leading SoC/ASIC programs, with earlier hands-on engineering experience.
* Has driven multiple SoC programs from concept through tapeout and release to manufacturing, ideally on advanced nodes.
* Experience managing IP vendors, foundries and OSAT partners, and leading programs across global teams.
* Startup or first-generation product experience.
* B.Sc. or higher in EE, Computer Engineering, Physics or a related field.
* Bonus: chiplet/multi-die and advanced packaging (2.5D/3D), silicon photonics or optical engine programs, high-speed connectivity products.

83d65f01.title: Program Manager, Evaluation Board Programs
83d65f01.description:
Renesas is one of the top global semiconductor companies in the world. We strive to develop a safer, healthier, greener, and smarter world, and our goal is to make every endpoint intelligent by offering product solutions in the automotive, industrial, infrastructure and IoT markets. Our robust product portfolio includes world-leading MCUs, SoCs, Analog and Power products, plus winning combination solutions that curate these complementary products. We are a key supplier to the world’s leading manufacturers of electronics you rely on every day; you may not see our products, but they are all around you.
  
  
  
  
Renesas employs roughly 21,000 people in more than 30 countries worldwide. As a global team, our employees actively embody the Renesas Culture, our guiding principles based on five key elements: Transparent, Agile, Global, Innovative, and Entrepreneurial. Renesas believes in, and has a commitment to, diversity and inclusion, with initiatives and a leadership team dedicated to its resources and values. At Renesas, we want to build a sustainable future where technology helps make our lives easier. Join us and build your future by being part of what’s next in electronics and the world.

**Job Description**

The High Performance Compute (HPC) organization is seeking a detailed oriented Program Manager to lead and coordinate the global Evaluation Board (EVB) program portfolio supporting Renesas R-Car SoC products. This role is responsible for managing global demand, allocation, shipment, compliance, and operational execution of Evaluation Boards used by customers, partners, and internal engineering teams.

**Key Responsibilities**

• Own worldwide evaluation board demand forecasting, allocation, and inventory planning by balancing customer demand with inventory exposure and product lifecycle risks.
  
  
• Coordinate board supply, inventory, manufacturing and shipment activities.
  
  
• Coordinate post-delivery events such as repair, modification, and replacement.
  
  
• Support worldwide shipment execution and logistics tracking.
  
  
• Support compliance with export control, customs, and trade regulations.
  
  
• Support payment, invoicing, budgeting, and financial planning activities.
  
  
• Manage executive escalations for strategic and high-priority board requests.
  
  
• Produce regular executive status reports covering demand, supply, inventory, risks, and actions.
  
  
• Coordinate globally across engineering, operations, logistics, finance, sales, and compliance teams.
  
  
• Drive inventory strategies to minimize excess/obsolete inventory (ie: board revisions, component changes, SoC updates, or product transitions)
  
  
• Coordinate build quantities and manufacturing releases to support customer requirements while maintaining lean inventory with minimal financial risk

**Required Qualifications**

• Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Business, Supply Chain, Operations, or related discipline.
  
  
• 12+ years of program management, operations, supply chain, or customer program management experience.

5f9d7096.title: Principal Solutions Consultant
5f9d7096.description:
**Job Description**

**Role Overview**

Guidewire’s Go to Market organization is focused on scaling AI‑powered innovation, expanding into new markets and product categories, and ensuring every customer is successful and referenceable through structured, data‑driven execution and tight cross‑functional alignment.

As a Principal Solution Consultant, you sit at the intersection of this vision and our India growth strategy, serving as the senior field‑facing authority on how Guidewire’s platform, cloud services, and ecosystem can unlock value for Indian insurers.

Operating as a key member of the regional GTM leadership team, you will design and execute market‑entry and expansion plays for India, partnering closely with Sales, Professional Services, Product, and our partner ecosystem. You will champion local market needs back into our global roadmap while coaching and scaling an India‑based Solution Consulting team. This is a high‑impact, highly visible role for someone who is equally comfortable in the boardroom, on customer sites, and in the details of complex insurance workflows.

**Core Objectives:**

* Go-to-Market Strategy: Co-own and execution of the Indian GTM strategy.
* Strategic Deal Lead: Own the functional "Win Theme" for major prospects, moving beyond feature lists to business outcomes.
* Market Challenger: Effectively position Guidewire as the modern SaaS alternative to legacy incumbents.
* Executive Advisor: Have the gravitas to engage with C-suite stakeholders (CEO, CTO, Business Unit Leaders).
* Thought Leadership: Act as the voice of the Indian market, specifically regarding industry trends, to influence global product roadmaps.
* You’ll work closely with Indian customers, SI Partners, internal product and field teams, and cross-functional stakeholders to achieve the above objectives. You’ll also support the development of our local team and help scale our operation across the market.

**Key Responsibilities**

* GTM Strategy & Execution: Partner with Field Leadership to refine the India penetration plan. Identify high-propensity targets, define regional "Win Themes," and tailor the global sales playbook for the Indian context.
* Strategic Market Research: Conduct "boots-on-the-ground" discovery to identify unique Indian functional gaps (e.g., specific IRDAI compliance workflows, UPI-based real-time claims, or localized Health TPA models) vs Guidewire’s "Out-of-the-Box" (OOTB) features.
* Competitive Intelligence: Build a detailed "Battlecard" against local incumbents. Identify their architectural weaknesses in the Indian market and train the wider field team on how to exploit them.
* End-to-End Deal Ownership: Lead the functional sales cycle, from initial discovery and RFI/RFP management to final selection and contract alignment.
* Field Leadership Collaboration: Act as the primary technical/functional advisor to the Regional Sales Director and Managing Director. Provide the "solution air cover" needed to close the first wave of lighthouse customers.
* Consultative Discovery: Uncover the "pain behind the pain" in a prospect’s current operations (e.g., rigid legacy codebases, slow speed-to-market for new products).
* Solution Design: Partner with Account Executives to build a cohesive business case, ensuring all functional risks are mitigated.
* Product Localization Advocacy: Collate recurring requirements from Indian prospects and present a prioritized "India Roadmap" to Global Product Management.
* Team Leadership: Develop the India-based Solution Consulting team by coaching them on advanced storytelling, competitive positioning, and executive presence.
* Ecosystem Integration: Work with the Guidewire Marketplace and local partners to demonstrate a "frictionless" insurance experience (e.g., integrating with the India Stack, UPI, and AI-driven fraud detection).

**Product & Domain Expertise**

* India P&C Mastery: Deep expertise in the Indian General Insurance market.
* Competitive Displacement: Proven ability to position modern SaaS against legacy core insurance solutions. You must be able to articulate why a modern cloud platform beats a "One-Size-Fits-All" legacy suite.
* Digital Ecosystem (India Stack): Knowledge of how to leverage Aadhaar, UPI, and DigiLocker within the insurance lifecycle to create a frictionless, paperless customer journey.
* Guidewire Cloud Value: Ability to sell the "Evergreen" nature of SaaS—proving to Indian CIOs that they will never have to perform a painful 2-year legacy upgrade again.

**Preferred Skills & Experience**

**Professional Experience**

* 12+ Years in Enterprise Pre-Sales/Solution Consulting: A proven track record of leading functional sales cycles for complex, high-value SaaS or Core Systems (Policy, Billing, Claims).
* Market Entry Expertise: Experience working in a "pioneer" or "early-hire" capacity for a global technology firm entering the Indian market is highly desirable.
* Competitive Displacement: Demonstrated success in unseating legacy or entrenched incumbents (specifically TCS BaNCS, SAP, or Oracle) within the Indian Financial Services sector.

**Domain & Technical Mastery**

* Indian P&C Specialist: Deep functional expertise in general insurance. You should understand the nuances of the Indian "Grid" system, TPA integrations, and IRDAI product filing requirements.
* Cloud/SaaS Evangelist: While Guidewire experience is a plus, you must have a strong grasp of Cloud-native architectures (AWS/Azure) and the ability to sell the business value of "Evergreen" software over traditional on-premise and custom build models.
* Digital Ecosystem Knowledge: Familiarity with the India Stack (Aadhaar, UPI, eSign) and how these technologies are being leveraged to digitize the insurance value chain.

**Leadership & Strategic Skills**

* Field Partnership: Experience working as a "Strategic Right Hand" to Sales VPs or Managing Directors to build and execute a Go-to-Market (GTM) plan.
* Executive Presence: Exceptional "C-Suite" communication skills; the ability to challenge the thinking of a CEO/CIO and move them from a "safe" legacy choice to a transformative platform.
* Consultative Storytelling: Mastery of "The Challenger Sale" or similar methodologies—turning dry product features into a compelling business narrative that addresses specific Indian market pain points.

86aabaf8.title: Solution Architect
86aabaf8.description:
**About the Role**

Webnyay Private Limited is looking for an experienced Solution Architect to lead the architecture and technical design of a secure, scalable, on-premises enterprise platform for a public sector undertaking.

The ideal candidate will have extensive experience in enterprise architecture, BFSI or government projects, data centre and disaster recovery (DC/DR), high availability, cybersecurity, regulatory compliance, and enterprise integrations. The role requires close collaboration with development, AI/ML, infrastructure, security, and client teams to ensure successful implementation and production readiness.

Key Responsibilities

  

**Architecture and Technical Design**

* Own the High-Level Design (HLD), review all Low-Level Designs (LLDs), and drive bank sign-off within the first two weeks.
* Develop integration blueprints covering API contracts, authentication, data mapping, and error handling for all in-scope enterprise systems.
* Define infrastructure sizing and requirements for primary and disaster recovery data centres, including servers, operating systems, database licences, networking, SSL certificates, and firewall rules.
* Make and document key architectural decisions, including trade-offs involving security, scalability, performance, and delivery timelines.
* Establish architectural standards and ensure implementation aligns with approved designs.

  

**High Availability, Performance and Disaster Recovery**

* Design active-passive high availability across data centres and disaster recovery sites, including automated failover.
* Define and validate architecture against 99.95% uptime, RPO of 15 minutes, and RTO of 60 minutes.
* Lead quarterly disaster recovery drills and coordinate recovery planning with infrastructure and operations teams.
* Design for horizontal scaling, read replicas for reporting, asynchronous processing, and future-ready database sharding.
* Define observability standards, including health, latency and error dashboards, distributed tracing, and log forwarding to SIEM platforms using CEF/LEEF formats.

  

**Security, Compliance and Governance**

* Ensure architecture aligns with applicable bank security policies, including ISSP and DPSC, the DPDP Act 2023, relevant RBI IT outsourcing and IT governance directions, and the Information Technology Act, 2000.
* Define security controls covering AES-256 encryption at rest, TLS 1.2 or higher in transit, role-based access control (RBAC), maker-checker workflows, multi-factor authentication (MFA), PII masking, and privileged identity/access management (PIM/PAM).
* Design immutable audit trails and regulatory data-retention policies, typically supporting 710 years of retention.
* Lead technical coordination for vulnerability assessment and penetration testing (VAPT), third-party security reviews, information systems audits, and RBI examinations.
* Own Software Bill of Materials (SBOM) and Cryptographic Bill of Materials (CBOM) requirements.

  

**AI and Enterprise Integration Architecture**

* Collaborate with the AI Engineer to design secure, self-hosted AI/LLM deployment, model serving, scaling, versioning, and workload isolation.
* Ensure sensitive bank data remains within the bank-controlled environment.
* Design auditability for AI-generated outputs, human decisions, and associated actions.
* Implement architectural controls for category-wise AI enablement and switch-off.
* Define integration patterns for enterprise identity, SIEM, PIM/PAM, and other third-party systems.

  

**Required Skills and Qualifications**

* B.E./B.Tech/M.Tech in Computer Science or an equivalent qualification.
* 12+ years of experience in software engineering, including at least 4 years in a Solution Architect or Enterprise Architect role.
* Proven experience designing on-premises enterprise platforms for BFSI, banking, or government clients.
* Strong expertise in DC/DR architecture, high availability, automated failover, disaster recovery, and business continuity.
* Deep understanding of three-tier and service-based architectures, API gateways, message queues, caching, and distributed systems.
* Working knowledge of Python/Django, React, and PostgreSQL, including replication, backup, and failover.
* Experience integrating enterprise identity systems such as Active Directory, LDAP, SAML, and OIDC.
* Experience integrating SIEM and privileged identity/access management systems.
* Strong knowledge of application security, infrastructure security, encryption, access control, and audit requirements.
* Experience taking enterprise systems through VAPT, information systems audits, and security assessments.
* Working knowledge of Indian BFSI regulations, including applicable RBI IT outsourcing and governance directions and the DPDP Act 2023.
* Excellent technical documentation, presentation, and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to present and defend architecture decisions before bank IT, security, compliance, and audit teams.
* Willingness to work fully onsite in Pune during the 12-week implementation period and travel to Pune as required thereafter.
