At Alstom, we understand transport networks and what moves people. From high-speed trains, metros, monorails, and trams, to turnkey systems, services, infrastructure, signalling and digital mobility, we offer our diverse customers the broadest portfolio in the industry. Every day, 80,000 colleagues lead the way to greener and smarter mobility worldwide, connecting cities as we reduce carbon and replace cars.

  

Could you be the full-time IS&T Software Engineering Solutions Architect in our IS&T D&IS Software Engineering Solutions team we’re looking for?

**Your future role**

Take on a new challenge and apply your technical prowess in software development lifecycle. You’ll work alongside innovative, diligent, and supportive teammates.

You'll act as a control tower to ensure overall consistency in our application landscape. Day-to-day, you’ll work closely with teams across the business (architecture, design, implementation, and support), maintain technical solution documentation, and much more.

You’ll specifically take care of providing technical and domain expertise on complex topics, as well as leading technical design and architecture.

We’ll look to you for:

* Collect, challenge, clarify and manage demands from central Business and stakeholders
* Ensure alignment with Corporate Strategies & official Business Processes
* Participate to the Software Engineering roadmap and align it with the global Digital Transformation roadmap
* Prepare architecture recommendations and decision inputs for governance and Change Control Boards
* Model & maintain functional and technical architecture, solutions referential, standards and design documentation of the domain
* Promote Alstom Core Model by leading evolution and ensuring its consistency
* Contribute to all phases of applications lifecycle from definition, architecture, design trough implementation, debugging, testing and early support
* Contribute to Business Processes development and improvement through technology watch
* Provide technical and domain expertise on complex topics and lead technical proofs of concept
* Build best practices and continuous improvement on development activities
* Provide technical and domain expertise on complex topics and lead technical proofs of concept
* Analyse technology industry and business trends and determine their potential applicability at Alstom
* Guide responsible adoption of AI-assisted engineering across the SDLC, with appropriate quality, security, traceability and value controls

  

**All about you**

We value passion and attitude over experience. That’s why we don’t expect you to have every single skill. Instead, we’ve listed some that we think will help you succeed and grow in this role:

* A degree in Engineering or equivalent higher education, preferably in information technology, computer science or software engineering.
* Over all 9+years of Experience in in software or solution architecture covering various roles (business / functional architecture / development/customization, deployment, ownership in complex environments)
* Solid knowledge of software engineering processes: requirements, architecture, development, configuration management, build, release, verification, validation and support
* Deep knowledge of software version control and configuration management, CI/CD, build and release automation, artifact management, quality gates and DevSecOps practices
* Proven architecture skills covering functional and technical design, integration patterns, APIs, automation, scalability, resilience, observability and lifecycle management
* Background and appetite for responsible AI applied to the SDLC
* Strong development and scripting skills in several languages (Perl, Python, etc) with experience in bespoke application development
* General knowledge of IT infrastructure systems: Azure, Linux, Windows, virtualization, servers, databases, networks and storage
* Technical knowledge of IBM Jazz ELM, ClearCase, ClearQuest or Synergy administration, architecture and customization is considered a plus
* Ability to address application security vulnerabilities and apply secure-by-design principles
* Experience working for global companies as a service provider or customer, ideally in both roles
* Very strong technical leadership and business-value orientation
* Deep interest or knowledge on engineering solutions (especially in railway and safety context) regarding architecture and development/customization
* Good communication, efficiency and ability to execute. You are result oriented and show intellectual curiosity and creativity

  

**Things you’ll enjoy**

Join us on a life-long transformative journey – the rail industry is here to stay, so you can grow and develop new skills and experiences throughout your career. You’ll also:

* Enjoy stability, challenges and a long-term career free from boring daily routines
* Work with new security standards for rail signalling
* Collaborate with transverse teams and helpful colleagues
* Contribute to innovative projects
* Utilise our dynamic working environment
* Steer your career in whatever direction you choose across functions and countries
* Benefit from our investment in your development, through award-winning learning
* Progress towards senior technical and management roles
* Benefit from a fair and dynamic reward package that recognises your performance and potential, plus comprehensive and competitive social coverage (life, medical, pension)

  

You don’t need to be a train enthusiast to thrive with us. We guarantee that when you step onto one of our trains with your friends or family, you’ll be proud. If you’re up for the challenge, we’d love to hear from you!

703734b5.title: EY - GDS Consulting - AI And DATA - Databricks Architect - Senior Manager
703734b5.description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**EY-Consulting – Data and Analytics – Databricks Architect – Senior Manager**
EY's Consulting Services is a unique, industry-focused business unit that provides a broad range of integrated services that leverage deep industry experience with strong functional and technical capabilities and product knowledge. EY’s financial services practice provides integrated Consulting services to financial institutions and other capital markets participants, including commercial banks, retail banks, investment banks, broker-dealers & asset management firms, and insurance firms from leading Fortune 500 Companies. Within EY’s Consulting Practice, Data and Analytics team solves big, complex issues and capitalize on opportunities to deliver better working outcomes that help expand and safeguard the businesses, now and in the future. This way we help create a compelling business case for embedding the right analytical practice at the heart of client’s decision-making.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
The Senior Delivery Manager & Data Architect is a senior client-facing leader accountable for the end-to-end delivery and architectural integrity of complex data, analytics, cloud, and AI transformation programmes. The role combines delivery governance, commercial ownership, stakeholder leadership, and hands-on architecture oversight to translate business priorities into secure, scalable, reliable, and cost-effective data solutions.
  
  
The incumbent will act as the single point of accountability for delivery outcomes while defining target-state data architectures, engineering standards, governance controls, and transformation roadmaps. The role requires the ability to move confidently between executive discussions, programme governance, solution design, and technical assurance.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Own end-to-end delivery of large, multi-workstream data and analytics programmes from discovery and mobilisation through implementation, transition, and benefits realisation.
* Establish integrated plans, governance forums, delivery cadence, quality gates, dependency management, and executive reporting.
* Manage scope, schedule, budget, capacity, quality, risks, issues, assumptions, and change control; intervene early when delivery deviates from commitments.
* Drive Agile, Scrum, scaled Agile, or hybrid delivery practices appropriate to the client and programme context.
* Lead platform migrations, modernisation initiatives, releases, cutovers, hypercare, and transition to operations with clear readiness and acceptance criteria.
* Maintain delivery transparency using measurable outcomes, milestone health, financial performance, engineering metrics, and value-realisation indicators.
* Define enterprise data strategy, target-state architecture, reference architectures, transition states, and prioritised transformation roadmaps aligned to business and AI objectives.
* Architect modern cloud-native data platforms, including data lakes, lakehouses, warehouses, streaming solutions, data products, semantic layers, APIs, and analytical consumption patterns.
* Lead conceptual, logical, and physical data modelling using dimensional, relational, Data Vault, graph, ontology, and domain-oriented approaches as appropriate.
* Define integration and ingestion patterns for batch, near-real-time, event-driven, CDC, API, and file-based workloads.
* Evaluate platforms, products, and design alternatives; produce architecture decisions, solution blueprints, non-functional requirements, and implementation guardrails.
* Provide architecture assurance across the delivery lifecycle through design reviews, proofs of concept, engineering standards, performance reviews, and technical risk management.
* Ensure solutions meet requirements for scalability, resilience, availability, observability, interoperability, security, privacy, maintainability, and cost optimisation.
* Establish governance principles covering data ownership, stewardship, classification, lineage, metadata, master and reference data, retention, and policy enforcement.
* Embed data quality controls, reconciliation, auditability, privacy-by-design, role-based access, encryption, and regulatory compliance into solution architecture and delivery.
* Partner with cyber security, risk, legal, compliance, and operations teams to ensure controls are demonstrable and audit-ready.
* Build trusted relationships with C-suite sponsors, business leaders, product owners, technology executives, and delivery partners.
* Translate complex business needs into clear solution options, investment cases, roadmaps, and outcome-based delivery plans.
* Facilitate executive workshops, architecture forums, steering committees, and difficult decision-making conversations.
* Own or support proposals, solution shaping, estimates, statements of work, delivery models, contract assumptions, and commercial negotiations.
* Manage programme financials, forecasting, burn, margin, resourcing, vendors, and third-party commitments.
* Identify opportunities for account growth, reusable assets, accelerators, and follow-on transformation initiatives.
* Lead multidisciplinary teams of architects, data engineers, platform engineers, analysts, data scientists, DevOps specialists, quality engineers, and project managers.
* Set clear accountabilities, create a high-performance culture, mentor senior practitioners, and develop succession and capability plans.
* Promote engineering excellence, knowledge sharing, reusable patterns, continuous improvement, and responsible use of data and AI.
* Contribute to hiring, workforce planning, communities of practice, thought leadership, and organisational capability development.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Data Science, or a related discipline.
* Typically 15+ years of technology experience, including substantial experience delivering enterprise data programmes and operating in a lead data or solution architecture capacity.
* Demonstrable ownership of large, complex, multi-team programmes with responsibility for delivery governance, senior stakeholders, budgets, quality, and commercial outcomes.
* Strong experience designing and delivering cloud data platforms on Microsoft Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud; deep expertise in at least one ecosystem is essential.
* Proven experience with modern data platforms and technologies such as Microsoft Fabric, Azure Data Factory, Azure Databricks, Synapse Analytics, Snowflake, Databricks, Spark, Kafka, cloud object storage, and modern BI tools.
* Advanced knowledge of SQL and strong working understanding of Python or PySpark, data integration, distributed processing, DevOps, CI/CD, infrastructure automation, and observability.
* Solid command of data modelling, metadata management, data quality, master data management, governance, privacy, security, and lifecycle management.
* Experience architecting AI-ready data foundations and integrating machine learning, generative AI, vector, semantic, ontology, or knowledge graph capabilities is desirable.
* Excellent executive communication, consulting, negotiation, facilitation, decision-making, and conflict-resolution skills.

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

* Cloud architecture or data engineering certification in Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud.
* Microsoft Fabric, Databricks, or Snowflake certification.
* TOGAF, DAMA/CDMP, or an equivalent data or enterprise architecture credential.
* PMP, PRINCE2, SAFe, Scrum, or an equivalent programme or Agile delivery certification.
* ITIL certification is advantageous for roles with service transition or operational accountability.
* Delivery against agreed outcomes, milestones, budget, quality standards, and contractual commitments.
* Architecture compliance, reduction in technical debt, and adoption of reusable standards and patterns.
* Platform reliability, performance, security, data quality, observability, and unit-cost improvement.
* Stakeholder confidence, client satisfaction, benefits realisation, and successful adoption of delivered capabilities.
* Team engagement, capability growth, predictable staffing, and development of future technical and delivery leaders.
* Commercial performance, pipeline contribution, and expansion of trusted client relationships.

**What Working At EY Offers**
At EY, we’re dedicated to helping our clients, from start–ups to Fortune 500 companies — and the work we do with them is as varied as they are.
  
  
You get to work with inspiring and meaningful projects. Our focus is education and coaching alongside practical experience to ensure your personal development. We value our employees and you will be able to control your own development with an individual progression plan. You will quickly grow into a responsible role with challenging and stimulating assignments. Moreover, you will be part of an interdisciplinary environment that emphasizes high quality and knowledge exchange. Plus, we offer:
  
  

* Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
* Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
* The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

6dd3fb5a.description:
Azure Cloud Solution Architect & SQL DBA

**About the Role**

We are looking for an experienced Azure Cloud Solution Architect & SQL DBA to design, implement, and manage secure, scalable, highly available cloud infrastructure and database solutions.

**Responsibilities**

* Design end-to-end Azure cloud architectures, including HLDs, LLDs, and solution blueprints.
* Lead on-premises to Azure migrations for servers, databases, and applications.
* Design and manage Azure IaaS and PaaS solutions, including Virtual Machines, App Services, AKS, Azure SQL, and SQL Managed Instance.
* Implement Azure networking and security using VNets, VPN Gateway, ExpressRoute, Azure Firewall, NSGs, Application Gateway, and WAF.
* Manage identity and access using Microsoft Entra ID, RBAC, PIM, Key Vault, and Azure Policy.
* Drive cloud governance, cost optimization, resource right-sizing, and FinOps initiatives.
* Manage SQL Server and Azure SQL databases, including performance tuning, backup, recovery, and HA/DR.
* Configure and troubleshoot Always On Availability Groups, clustering, log shipping, replication, and CDC.
* Implement monitoring, alerting, patching, backup, and disaster recovery strategies.
* Lead technical discussions, customer workshops, incident management, and root cause analysis (RCA).
* Mentor engineering teams and ensure adherence to cloud security and architecture best practices.

**Qualifications**

* Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert (AZ-305)
* Azure Architect Technologies (AZ-303) or equivalent Azure architecture certification.

**Required Skills**

* Strong hands-on experience in Microsoft Azure architecture and cloud engineering.
* Expertise in Azure IaaS, PaaS, networking, security, and governance.
* Strong experience with Microsoft SQL Server, Azure SQL, and SQL database administration.
* Experience in cloud migration planning, architecture design, and application modernization.
* Knowledge of Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, Application Insights, and Azure Backup.
* Experience with cloud cost optimization, resource management, and infrastructure automation.
* Strong customer-facing communication, technical leadership, and troubleshooting skills.

**Preferred Skills**

* Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert (AZ-305)
* Azure Architect Technologies (AZ-303) or equivalent Azure architecture certification.

Job description:
  
  
Job Description

Job Description: IT Infra Service Delivery Manager

Location- Ahmedabad

Reporting To: Delivery Head / Account Delivery Head (ADH)
  
Role Purpose
  
Lead end-to-end IT Service Delivery for enterprise customers, owning service outcomes across towers (End User Services, Infrastructure, Applications, Network, Cloud). Ensure predictable delivery against SLAs/OLAs/Underpinning Contracts, drive continual improvement using ITIL® 4 practices, and orchestrate multi-vendor delivery to achieve contractual, financial, and customer experience goals. (Terminology aligned with ITIL 4 key concepts, guiding principles, governance, and continual improvement.)

Key Responsibilities
  
1) Run & Govern
  
•    Own service performance—publish MSR/QSR, executive summaries, risks, actions, and trend insights (ServiceNow Performance Analytics / Power BI).
  
•    Lead Operational/Service/Executive Reviews, aligning delivery towers, vendors, and customer stakeholders.
  
•    Ensure contractual compliance to SOW/MSA including service credits, waivers, and governance records—audit ready at all times. 
  
2) Stabilize & Improve
  
•    Drive MIM posture (readiness, drills, on call, comms), backlog hygiene, and automation/shift left to boost CSAT and reduce TCO.
  
•    Run RCA/CAPA programs; track benefits (repeat incident reduction, MTTR, change failure rate).
  
•    Lead CSI initiatives across process, tooling, and org—aligned to ITIL 4 guiding principles. 
  
3) Transition & Transformation
  
•    For new/changed services, define interim vs. steady state SLAs, baselines, staffing, and tooling readiness; execute cutover criteria and hypercare.
  
•    Align Service Delivery Plan with Wipro QMS (Veloci Q) requirements and customer specifics; maintain evidence of communications and approvals. 
  
4) Stakeholder Leadership
  
•    Act as single point of accountability for service outcomes; manage escalations through resolution; influence CXO/Director level stakeholders with data driven narratives.
  
•    Mentor leads/SMEs; build a high performing, ITIL mature delivery culture.
  
Must Have Skills & Experience
  
•    12–15 years in IT services with 6–8 years leading enterprise IT service delivery across multi tower and multi vendor environments.
  
•    Proven governance of SLAs/OLAs/UCs, penalty/earnback mechanisms, and audit expectations (ISO/ISMS/SOC). 
  
•    Strong command of ITIL 4 practices and value stream thinking; hands on with ServiceNow ITSM (SLA policies, business calendars, PA dashboards, reports).
  
•    Expertise in Major Incident, Problem/RCA, Change/CAB, Availability/Capacity, Knowledge, ITAM/CMDB, Service Catalog.
  
•    Advanced analytics & storytelling (Power BI/Excel), prioritization, and stakeholder management.
  
•    Excellent communication and customer facing leadership; experience in managed services contracts.
  
Preferred / Good to Have:
  
•    ITIL® 4 Strategist: Direct, Plan & Improve (DPI) or Leader: Digital & IT Strategy (DITS)
  
•    PMP® / PRINCE2® Practitioner, PSM I/II (or SAFe Agilist)
  
•    Cloud Associate/Architect (e.g., Microsoft Azure AZ 104 / AZ 305, AWS SysOps/Architect Associate)
  
•    DevOps/SRE Foundation, ISO/IEC 27001 Lead Auditor/Implementer

5cc55150.title: Enterprise Agentic Automation Developer/Solutions Architect
5cc55150.description:
**We Are**

Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI-powered products. We deliver industry-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow.

**You Are**

You have spent years building enterprise systems that actually solve business problems, not just demonstrate technical capability. You understand that the real challenge is not deploying an AI model, it is designing the solution architecture that makes it trustworthy, scalable, and maintainable across Finance, HR, Sales Operations, and Legal teams who need it to work every single day. You think in systems, not features. When someone describes a manual process, you are already mapping the integration points, data flows, governance requirements, and failure modes before they finish talking.

You are equally comfortable whiteboarding an agentic AI architecture with a VP of Finance and writing Python code to integrate Azure OpenAI with SAP. You have built enough automation solutions to know when a workflow needs intelligent document processing versus a simple API call, and you can explain that tradeoff clearly. You do not wait for perfect requirements. You ask the right questions, prototype quickly, and iterate with stakeholders who may not speak your technical language but absolutely know their business pain.

At Synopsys, you will architect AI and automation solutions that reduce manual work for 30,000 employees across critical business functions, and the platform you build will matter.

**What You'll Be Doing**

* Design and build enterprise AI solutions using Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Document Intelligence, Azure AI Search, and Copilot Studio that automate Finance, Sales Operations, HR, Order Management, and Legal processes
* Architect and develop agentic AI systems and intelligent automation workflows on UiPath, Power Automate, Azure Logic Apps, and Azure Functions that integrate with SAP, Salesforce, Oracle, SuccessFactors, and Workday
* Lead end-to-end solution delivery from requirements gathering and architecture design through development, testing, deployment, and production support
* Build reusable frameworks, integration patterns, and engineering standards for AI agent development that other developers can adopt across the enterprise automation portfolio
* Partner directly with business stakeholders in Finance, GTM, HR, and Operations to identify automation opportunities, assess feasibility, prioritize initiatives, and translate requirements into technical solutions
* Establish and enforce governance, security, Responsible AI practices, and DevOps standards using Azure DevOps or GitHub for CI/CD and source control
* Mentor developers on AI solution design, Azure architecture, integration patterns, and automation best practices

**The Impact You Will Have**

* Reduce manual effort across Finance, Sales Operations, HR, and Order Management by deploying AI-powered automation that handles document processing, data extraction, workflow orchestration, and decision support at scale
* Accelerate Synopsys' enterprise AI strategy by establishing reusable frameworks and patterns that enable faster, more consistent delivery of intelligent automation solutions across business functions
* Improve operational accuracy and compliance by building governed, auditable AI systems with proper security controls, error handling, and monitoring
* Enable business growth without proportional headcount increases by creating scalable automation platforms that handle increasing transaction volumes and process complexity
* Strengthen cross-functional collaboration by translating technical capabilities into business value that Finance, HR, and Operations leaders can understand and trust
* Build institutional knowledge and capability by mentoring developers and establishing engineering standards that raise the quality and maintainability of the entire automation portfolio
* Drive measurable ROI through solutions that demonstrably save time, reduce errors, and improve process efficiency in production environments

**What You'll Need**

* Bachelor's or Master's in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience
* 8-12+ years building enterprise applications, automation solutions, or integration platforms, with at least 3 years working directly with AI or Generative AI technologies in production environments
* Deep hands-on experience with Azure AI Services including Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Document Intelligence, and Azure AI Search, plus Azure Integration Services like Logic Apps, Functions, Service Bus, and API Management
* Proven ability to design and deploy intelligent automation using platforms like UiPath, Power Automate, Power Apps, Copilot Studio, and Dataverse
* Strong development skills in Python, C#, and JavaScript, with solid understanding of REST APIs, SOAP, webhooks, SQL, and data modeling
* Direct experience integrating enterprise applications such as SAP, Salesforce, Oracle, SuccessFactors, or Workday in complex business environments
* Working knowledge of AI governance, Responsible AI practices, cloud security, DevOps, CI/CD pipelines, and source control using Azure DevOps or GitHub, experience with JIRA for project management is a plus

**Who You Are**

* You can sit in a room with a Finance Director who describes a month-end close process and walk out with a solution architecture that addresses the real bottleneck, not just the symptom they mentioned
* You write code that other developers can actually maintain, you document your integration patterns, you build error handling that helps operations teams diagnose issues without calling you at midnight
* You push back when a stakeholder asks for an AI agent but the problem actually needs a well-designed workflow, and you can explain why in terms they understand and respect
* You have shipped enough production systems to know that governance, security, and supportability are not afterthoughts, they are design constraints you bake in from the start
* You mentor junior developers by showing them how you think through a problem, not just handing them the answer, and you genuinely care about raising the technical capability of the team
* You stay current with AI and automation technology not because it is trendy but because you know the difference between a useful new capability and vendor hype, and you can evaluate both critically

**The Team You'll Be Part Of**

You will join the Enterprise Agentic Process Automation team, which drives business transformation through AI, intelligent automation, process optimization, and enterprise integration. The team delivers capabilities across Finance, Sales Operations, Order Management, HR, Business Operations, and other functions, with emphasis on operational efficiency, scalability, governance, and innovation. Current initiatives include AI agents, document intelligence, finance automation, process orchestration, and enterprise platform integrations. The team operates in Bengaluru and collaborates closely with business stakeholders and IT teams across Synopsys globally.

**Rewards and Benefits**

We offer a comprehensive range of health, wellness, and financial benefits to cater to your needs. Our total rewards include both monetary and non-monetary offerings. Your recruiter will provide more details about the salary range and benefits during the hiring process.

57bf3fa3.title: IT Engineer II, ITSE Solutions
57bf3fa3.description:
At McCormick, we bring our passion for flavor to work each day. We encourage growth, respect everyone's contributions and do what's right for our business, our people, our communities and our planet. Join us on our quest to make every meal and moment better.
  
  
Founded in Baltimore, MD in 1889 in a room and a cellar by 25-year-old Willoughby McCormick with three employees, McCormick is a global leader in flavour. With over 14,000 employees around the world and more than $6 Billion in annual sales, the Company manufactures, markets, and distributes spices, seasoning mixes, condiments and other flavourful products to the entire food industry, retail outlets, food manufactures, food service businesses and consumers.
  
  
While our global headquarters are in the Baltimore, Maryland, USA area, McCormick operates and serves customers from nearly 60 locations in 25 countries and 170 markets in Asia-Pacific, China, Europe, Middle East and Africa, and the Americas, including North, South and Central America.
  
  
**Position Overview**
We are seeking a highly skilled ServiceNow ITSM Solution Engineer to serve as a critical bridge between business needs and technical implementation. In this role, you will partner closely with stakeholders, product teams, and service organizations to understand complex business challenges and translate them into scalable, cost-effective ServiceNow solutions. This position plays a key role in shaping solution design, ensuring alignment with ITSM product strategies, and delivering measurable value through a customer-centric approach.
  
  
The ideal candidate brings a strong blend of consulting mindset, technical expertise, and business acumen—capable of gathering and prioritizing requirements, architecting tailored solutions, and producing clear, actionable design documentation. You will be responsible for guiding solution delivery from concept through implementation, ensuring alignment with enterprise architecture, ITIL best practices, and platform capabilities.
  
  
As a trusted advisor, the ServiceNow Solution Engineer will collaborate across cross-functional teams to drive successful project outcomes, optimize IT service workflows, and enable digital transformation. This role requires the ability to communicate complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders, while maintaining a focus on delivering intuitive, high-quality user experiences that enhance operational efficiency and long-term platform scalability.
  
  
**Key Functions**

* Requirements Engineering: Actively listening to customers to uncover, analyze, and document technical needs and pain points.
* Solution Design: Creating customized technical blueprints, architectures, and integration plans.
* Technical Consulting: Evaluating feasibility, researching best practices, and proposing cost-effective solutions.
* Product Demonstration/POC: Developing proof-of-concept models to visualize value and reduce risk for buyers.
* Documentation: Creating detailed technical specifications, proposals, and project documentation.
* Communicate with internal and external stakeholders in an open and timely manner, providing all needed information and support.
* Demonstrations & Proof of Concepts (POCs) to Minimum Viable Product (MVP): Tailoring product demos and developing POCs to demonstrate how the solution solves the client's specific problems.
* Prepares and presents comprehensive technical and administrative solutions to interpret requirements, identify alternatives, and recommendations-based experience and other findings.
* Product Feedback Loop: Working with internal product and engineering teams to relay client requirements and influence product improvements.
* Performs other related duties as assigned.
* This position will collaborate with multiple internal teams to design integrations with interfacing processes, enabling automated capabilities with procurement, finance, and third parties.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Convert business requirements into technical solutions—covering data models, workflows, integrations, and security.
* Ensure platform scalability, resilience, and compliance with security and regulatory requirements.
* Design and develop and engineer robust ServiceNow architectures aligned with business objectives and IT strategies while adhering to the product line model and SAFe Agile controls/process.
* Communication with peers and upper management, as appropriate, relative to issues, problems, and general status
* Leverage insights to advise on actionable areas for improvement or other actions to ensure operational value is maintained

**Additional/Secondary Responsibilities**

* Contributing to the development and refinement of the ITSM product line roadmap, management policies and schedules as needed for future enhancements.
* Engaging with internal and external resources to ensure clarification, changes, resolution, are addressed.
* Resolve stakeholder related issues and escalate to manager or Director of Strategy and Value Optimization as appropriate.

**Required Qualifications:**
Bachelor’s degree in IT or business equivalent
  
  
**Technical Expertise**

* Strong background in software, hardware, or systems architecture.
* Must have worked in similar environments within the last two years

**Certifications**

* ITIL Foundation
* ITSM Foundation
* ServiceNow certifications CTA, CSA; other

**Experience**

* Three or more years of experience supporting development and management of IT services relative to similar roles.
* Demonstrated capabilities with ITSM, ITIL and SAFeAgile factory models.
* Demonstrated success in large scale capability development and deployment.
* Working knowledge of ITIL and ITSM principles
* Understanding of SAFe Agile methodologies and practices, specifically within ServiceNow SPM (Service Portfolio Management) in planning and execution.
* Ability to problem solve issues to resolution
* Strong attention to detail, accuracy and processes
* Highly flexible and adaptable to change
* Proficient in ITSM Foundation and experience with ServiceNow ITOM, ITSM, CMDB, KB etc.
* Microsoft Office and other productivity tools
* Global/international experience or exposure a plus

**Interpersonal Skills**

* Experience working with people and teams across various functions and regions.
* Demonstrated ability to create innovative solutions and think outside the box to solve complex and analytical problems.
* Demonstrated verbal, written and interpersonal communication skills
* Highly flexible and adaptable to change

McCormick & Company is an equal opportunity/affirmative action employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, color, religion, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, age, or any other characteristic protected by law.

7259b524.title: Technical Delivery Manager
7259b524.description:
**Aptagrim**
designs, engineers and deploys specialised enterprise AI products and intelligent workflow systems. Our systems are built around how a business actually works: its knowledge, its decisions and its day-to-day operations.

We are a growing team at an early stage. You will shape how we deliver, not just follow an existing playbook, and the AI systems you ship will run inside real enterprise operations.

**The role**

We're hiring a hands-on
**Technical Delivery Manager**
with deep Python and Django experience. You will own the delivery of enterprise applications and AI solutions, from discovery to production rollout.

This is a technical leadership role, not a task-tracking one. Expect to spend about 25–30% of your time hands-on: reviewing code, designing backend systems, unblocking engineers and building critical pieces or proofs of concept yourself. The rest goes to delivery ownership, client relationships, planning and team leadership.

**What you'll do**

**Delivery ownership**

* Own delivery end to end: lead discovery, scoping, estimation, planning, build, testing, client acceptance, deployment and handover to support.
* Plan realistically: set milestones, dependencies and acceptance criteria that account for technical uncertainty, data readiness and client inputs. Spot risks early and act on them.
* Control scope and economics: assess the effort, schedule and commercial impact of change requests. Track utilisation, budgets and project margins, and correct course when they drift.
* Run multiple engagements: balance engineering, QA, DevOps and business analysis capacity across projects, working with the Project Coordinator on tracking and reporting.

**Technical leadership**

* Lead backend engineering: guide the design of scalable, secure and maintainable systems in Python, Django and Django REST Framework, including APIs, data models, background processing and enterprise integrations.
* Stay hands-on: review code, debug hard production and performance issues, and build critical components or proofs of concept when the team needs it.
* Integrate AI into products: work with the Head of AI's team to bring LLM, retrieval and agent capabilities into production applications, with sound data flows, failure handling and monitoring.
* Set the quality bar: establish practical standards for testing, code review, documentation, security, observability and release readiness, and own production readiness: deployment, rollback, monitoring and incident response.

**Clients and team**

* Own client communication: run delivery reviews, explain technical trade-offs in plain language, set expectations (including around AI accuracy and iteration) and resolve escalations.
* Support pre-sales: turn business requirements into solution options, estimates, assumptions and statements of work.
* Grow the team: mentor engineers and tech leads, help hire, delegate well, and use retrospectives to make estimates and delivery steadily more predictable.

**What you'll bring**

* 7+ years in software engineering, including at least 3 years in technical leadership with ownership of client-facing delivery.
* Deep, recent, hands-on Python and Django: Django REST Framework, object-oriented design, application architecture and production troubleshooting. You still write and review code regularly.
* Strong backend fundamentals: REST API design, authentication and role-based access, PostgreSQL (schema design, ORM, indexing, query tuning, migrations), and async processing with task queues and caching (for example, Celery and Redis).
* Production engineering: testing, Git workflows, CI/CD, Docker, Linux and deployment on a major cloud, plus security, secrets management, logging, monitoring and incident investigation.
* A track record of delivering enterprise applications from requirements through deployment and client acceptance.
* Delivery and commercial skills: estimation, planning, risk and scope management, effort forecasting, and managing budgets and margins.
* Clear communication: you can explain technical problems to non-technical stakeholders and handle difficult client conversations calmly.
* Working knowledge of Agile delivery, applied pragmatically rather than by the book.

**Nice to have**

* Experience shipping LLM-based features to production, such as RAG pipelines, agent workflows, prompt and output evaluation, or LLM API integration
* Experience delivering projects where data quality, model accuracy or non-deterministic outputs shaped the plan
* Hands-on experience with AWS or Azure services beyond basic deployment

**Company:** Boutique Software Product Engineering Company (Bengaluru, est. 2014) **Location:** Bengaluru (Fully Remote - open to candidates across India)

**About the Company**

A boutique Bengaluru-based product engineering company that has built and managed 12+ high-performance engineering teams since 2014 across AI, Conversational AI, Tele-health, Healthcare, Logistics, and E-commerce. Since 2016, it has been a dedicated engineering partner for a leading global Conversational AI platform, collaborating alongside teams in Seattle, Mountain View, UK, Israel, and Germany.

**About the Role**

The Engagement Manager / Service Delivery Lead (SDL) owns predictable delivery across a portfolio of client engagements, connecting executive stakeholders, delivery teams, and internal leadership. This is a hybrid delivery role - managing a mix of concurrent smaller engagements and larger complex programs from kickoff through production launch, with full ownership of scope, governance, and commercial tracking.

**What You Will Do**

1. Establish delivery plans, governance cadences, milestones, decision forums, and escalation pathways

5. Track delivery economics, SOWs, change requests, utilization, margins, staffing needs, and forecasts
6. Drive go-live readiness reviews and secure stakeholder alignment for testing and operational transition
7. Directly manage 5+ team members with an indirect span of 15+ across business analysts, designers, developers, testers, and track leads

**What We're Looking For**

1. Bachelor's degree in Engineering, IT, Science, or another technical discipline
2. 7+ years in enterprise software implementation, technical program management, or consulting delivery
3. 5+ years of direct client-facing experience, specifically with US or UK clients, within a consulting or services organization

75752b64.title: Lead Technical Program Manager
75752b64.description:
**Our Purpose**

*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*

**Title and Summary**

Lead Technical Program ManagerWho is Mastercard? Mastercard is a global technology company in the payments industry. Our mission is to connect and power an inclusive, digital economy that benefits everyone, everywhere by making transactions safe, simple, smart, and accessible. Using secure data and networks, partnerships, and passion, our innovations and solutions help individuals, financial institutions, governments, and businesses realize their greatest potential. Our decency quotient, or DQ, drives our culture and everything we do inside and outside of our company. With connections across more than 210 countries and territories, we are building a sustainable world that unlocks priceless possibilities for all.
  
  
The Digital Solutions Engineering team is responsible for Mastercard’s electronic payment system as well as ensures payments are convenient and secure. The products are primarily focused on authentication, tokenization, fraud prevention, and risk mitigation across all payment channels as well as all stakeholders, issuers, acquirers, merchants, processors, and consumers. The key objectives of the solutions are to prove identity, reduce abandonments, reduce fraud, increase approval rates, and secure the payments ecosystem.  
  
We are hiring a Lead Technical Program Manager (TPM) as part of the Authentication Solutions platform. The core Authentication Solutions (3DS and Passkey based) teams use a mix of technologies as we work to revolutionize our technology offerings.  
  
Job Overview:  
Technical Program Managers at Mastercard collaborate to define the how and when of our strategic delivery goals. This role plays a pivotal role in driving complex, cross-functional projects and maintain alignment of our goals to organizational objectives. The responsibility of this teammate is to ensure technical solutions are delivered on time and meet the desired outcomes.  
We are seeking a Technical Program Manager to drive progress, manage complex projects, and ensure optimal delivery. This role requires a strategic thinker who excels in decision-making, problem decomposition, and effective communication, while maintaining a strong grasp of business context and technical details.  
  
Key Responsibilities:  

* Accelerate project progress by making crisp, timely decisions and clearing blockers.
* Navigate difficult situations to find viable paths forward and decompose problems into manageable units from ideation to execution.
* Organize work for optimal delivery, negotiating priorities, facilitating progress, and raising issues to management as needed.
* Maintain TPM artifacts, track SDLC milestones, and manage dependency target dates actively.
* Secure shared understanding and buy-in for solutions, clearly describing their impact on Mastercard and its customers.
* Use communication as a preventive control, ensuring meetings are effective, consensus is built, and decisions are well-documented.
* Optimize approaches, demonstrate improvements using data, and drive continuous improvements through retrospectives, staff meetings, and status updates.
* Proficiently manage scrum delivery, understand business context, customer use cases, and the functionality, architecture, and dependencies of involved systems.
* Represent team services to stakeholders and external partners, bringing developers or SMEs to meetings as necessary.
* Actively manage dependencies, influence vendors and partners, and ensure alignment with program goals.
* Deliver independently while occasionally seeking direction from peers and managers.

  
All About You:  

* Born simplifier.
* Proven experience in technical program management, with a strong ability to make timely decisions and manage complex projects.
* Proficiency in scrum delivery and a track record of optimizing processes and demonstrating improvements with data.
* Deep understanding of business context, customer use cases, system functionality, and industry technologies.
* Excellent communication skills with the ability to lead effective meetings, build consensus, and clearly articulate decisions.
* Experience in managing dependencies, influencing external partners, and representing team services to stakeholders.

**Corporate Security Responsibility**

All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

33695761.title: Program Manager, PE
33695761.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

At Amazon, we're working to be the most customer-centric company on earth. To get there, we need exceptionally talented, bright, and driven people. Amazon is one of the most recognizable brand names in the world and we distribute millions of products each year to our loyal customers. We recently launched our operations in India through Amazon.in, working tirelessly to bring the world’s most customer centric online shopping experience to the Indian consumer.  
  
Do you have an obsession for customers and a strong interest in building innovative solutions? Do you have proven analytical capabilities, exceptional communication, project management skills, ability to root cause and permanently eliminate defects, and possess the ability to multi-task and thrive in a fast-paced environment?  
  
We are seeking a senior leader to join our team responsible for managing ACES programs for our Fulfillment Centers in a fast-paced, dynamic work environment. ACES Leader leads a group of site managers focused on supporting Fulfillment Centers (FCs) improvements made on behalf of Amazon customers, to drive standardization efforts, act as liaisons with other departments, provide process skills to the FCs, support FC launches, support FC Kaizen Events in their areas of expertise, and to run and coordinate cross-functional projects for successful implementation across the FCs.  
  
The ACES Leader's mission is to help FCs succeed in scaling operations whilst meeting performance commitments through working hard and smart to strengthen standardization, by developing process improvement leaders with dive-deep process skills, by running and coordinating the top business efforts/projects and by supporting mechanisms generating a daily Kaizen culture of continuous root cause elimination, such as implementing improvements resulting from abnormalities identified in standard work initiatives. The successful candidate:  
  
Is smart, hard-working and creative person who loves business, loves solving difficult problems and loves ‘getting it done’  
Can think big and develop new ideas, simultaneously good at nurturing new ideas and applying high standards to weed out those that are least valuable.  
Is comfortable collaborating and influencing team members, working with development teams and other business groups, and presenting projects to senior leadership on a regular basis.  
Has the ability to partner to build and execute on new initiatives and roadmaps each year.  
Will compile, manage and report on weekly project metrics and be responsible for leading many high profile meetings to align on project requirements.  
Build relationships and identify with stakeholders across the organization.  
Has the technical aptitude to quickly grasp complex technical issues and communicate directly with technical teams.  
Possesses or can quickly learn fulfillment center operational skills to identify and implement solutions that scale with our scale.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* Bachelor's degree in Operations, Supply Chain Management, Engineering, or another technical field
* Experience working with cross-functional teams
* Experience providing and effectively communicating strategic and tactical recommendations based on data
* 4+ years of project management and implementation experience, or Six Sigma Green Belt
* Self directed travel as necessary, up to 50%

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience in program or project management

f68a988d.title: Technical Customer Solutions Manager, India CSM Team
f68a988d.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Sales, Marketing and Global Services (SMGS)  
AWS Sales, Marketing, and Global Services (SMGS) is responsible for driving revenue, adoption, and growth from the largest and fastest growing small- and mid-market accounts to enterprise-level customers including public sector.
  
  
As a Customer Solution Manager you will work with the largest and most complex enterprises in the world, to enable their multi-year journey to the cloud. In this new, highly visible, role you will ensure that all AWS teams work together effectively and efficiently to deliver migration, modernization and GenAI outcomes for the customer in relation to Amazon Web Services (AWS) Cloud.
  
  
Key job responsibilities  
You will be a trusted advisor to the customer. You will leverage your complex program management, technical, organizational, and transformation expertise to understand customer's business and strategic goals, translate them into an executable plan, and drive the implementation to success by working with the customer, AWS, and our partners. You will understand your customers' biggest IT challenges and provide prescriptive guidance, based on AWS best practices, to guide them through their migration and modernization journey to AWS at scale.  
  
You will take end-to-end ownership of multiple migration, modernization and GenAI projects within a single enterprise or across several enterprises, utilizing your communication skills to interface with and influence a broad range of multi-disciplinary teams (Business development, solutions architecture, support, product, professional services, and partners). The Customer Solution Manager role is responsible for cloud migration and modernization programs (incl. technical, operational, organizational, and education) that span across traditional IT teams and business units.  
  
Engaging from the inception stage onwards, you will have a deep understanding of your customer's business vision, culture, and processes, you will be your customer's voice within AWS, ensuring that their needs are accurately communicated to AWS leadership, product, and engineering teams. Engaging during the latter stages of the business cycle you will be responsible for ensuring consistent best-practices are applied, including: (1) ensuring Migration Readiness Assessment (MRA) is conducted and bringing in SMEs to deliver the migration foundations (e.g. landing zone build, security controls, operating model, training etc.), (2) Migration kick off workshops are conducted (including stakeholder alignment), and (3) Executive Steering Committees and reporting are established, including customer, partner, and AWS Cloud exec sponsors and ensure mechanisms are in place to identify and mitigate any identified risks. You should be passionate about delivering a great customer experience by delivering successful IT transformation programs. You will ensure that the customer IT and business stakeholders are aligned, to ensure broad adoption of the migration and modernization across the customer organization. You will use AWS mechanisms to inform the customer migration journey. Where required, you will lead the interaction with specialist teams, ProServ and Partners for handoffs, especially with respect to migreation, modernization and GenAI implementation.  
  
In addition to your customer facing responsibilities, you will help shape the rapidly growing Customer Solution Management function, where your passion to define and implement standard processes, methodologies, and tools will be highly valued. Passionate about customer value creation, you will be adept at measuring and quantifying customer value realization and ensuring it stays on path. Successful candidates will have a technical program management background, technology foundation and consultative mindset, be detail driven, and have experience in managing teams to deliver complex programs. You will be a passionate and proven leader with the ability to gain stakeholder buy-in, communicate confidently at both the executive and project team level, and collaborate with a wide range of technical and non-technical teams, regardless of geographical or organizational boundaries to ensure compliance with AWS Standards, policies and best practices. You will be comfortable in working with diverse teams to ensure appropriate partners are on-boarded and involved in the migration as required. Be an active participant of steering committees and governance structures regardless of who is leading the migration and modernization and act as the point of contact for escalations if the migration and modernization hits barriers. You will be proactive in assessing Migration and modernization progress and design and implement plans to mitigate any risks or delays. Along with project management cadence, you will support the people and process pillars of migration including CCOE design and be the overall owner of reporting and system updates related to the health of migration. You will be a natural problem solver with a cool head that can deal with ambiguity, work autonomously to drive the deliver results for your customer, build IP, and share best practice across geographies.  
  
#aws-ags-india  
  
About the team  
About AWS  
  
Diverse Experiences  
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.  
  
Why AWS  
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.  
  
Work/Life Balance  
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.  
  
Inclusive Team Culture  
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.  
  
Mentorship and Career Growth  
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 5+ years of leading large-scale, technical or engineering programs with a proven record of thought leadership, business case development, realizing customer benefits, and successful program completion experience
* Bachelor's degree in Science, Technology, Engineering, Math, or a related field
* Experience in customer-facing roles
* Experience implementing cloud services including migrations and modernization projects or equivalent

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* AWS or other cloud certification
* Knowledge of the software development/engineering lifecycle from conception to delivery or IT lifecycle
* Experience coordinating between project teams and customers to meet unique customer requirements

  
Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. 4a401d99.description:

Your role is vital, owning technical projects from initiation through delivery using your expertise in planning, directing, and monitoring schedules and budget.

2673a1ca.title: Senior Program Manager (Platform)
2673a1ca.description:
**Company overview:**
TraceLink is the world’s largest Agentic Business Network, enabling life sciences and healthcare companies to build and manage a scalable digital workforce of governed, no-code AI agents that execute and coordinate mission-critical supply chain operations alongside human teams. Powered by the Integrate-Once™ OPUS platform, TraceLink links more than 300,000 network participants, enabling multi-enterprise processes at global scale.
  
  
Founded in 2009 with the simple mission of protecting patients, today Tracelink has 5 global offices, over 800 employees and more than 1700 customers in over 60 countries around the world. Our expanding product suite continues to protect patients and now also enhances multi-enterprise collaboration through innovative new applications such as MINT.
  
  
Tracelink is recognized as an industry leader by Gartner and IDC, and for having a great company culture by Comparably.
  
  
**Senior Program Manager**
**What will you be doing?**

* Prepare project plans and collaborate with highly technical stakeholders (Engineering, Product Management, Architecture, Security, Cloud Operations, etc.)
* Monitor the progress of projects and report status, plans, and issues to executive management
* Operate cross-functionally in an agile environment to support the delivery of comprehensive, on-time, high-quality products, and solutions
* Hands-on release coordination, ensuring predictability and quality of application, solution, and platform deployments
* Work with other members of the product management organization to ensure new functionality and fixes are being evaluated and prioritized in a timely manner
* Develop and implement strategies to minimize schedule and technical risk
* Document processes and procedures for use and educate team members to ensure consistency across the team members
* Engage internal stakeholders across multiple organizations to identify opportunities to improve processes/productivity, drive improvements, and increase awareness

**In this role, you will:**

* Manage Risks, Timelines, Schedules, Resource Availability, Dependencies, Delivery Dates and Communication.
* Partner with executive decision-makers and stakeholders to deliver success and help our customers achieve the desired business value
* Partner with internal teams (Product Management, User Experience, Technical Communications, Services, Support, Engineering, and Executive Sponsors) to ensure coordination and alignment, leveraging all necessary parties to ensure our success
* Apply TraceLink product, business process, methodology & ecosystem knowledge to drive effective projects
* Proactively build and expand business relationships that enable better product quality, time to delivery, and customer satisfaction

**What we’re looking for:**

* BS degree or higher in Project Management, Computer Science, Engineering, IT, Management of Information Systems or equivalent
* 10+ years of technical program management experience
* Solid understanding of software development life cycle (SDLC) models as well as knowledge of both Agile and traditional project management principles and practices and the ability to blend them together in the right proportions to fit a project and business environment
* Knowledge in delivering high-quality software solutions using a predictable delivery process
* Strong cross-functional, technical project management experience, including planning, scheduling, monitoring, risk management, and stakeholder reporting
* Demonstrated experience in leading key projects, including strategic customer programs from inception to successful roll-out and beyond
* Strong documentation and presentation skills, including creative thinking and willingness to work hands-on to deliver impactful outcomes
* Ability to balance structure, process, risk management, and time-to-market factors
* Individuals who can work independently with cross-functional stakeholders and quickly adjust to changing priorities

**EXECUTION**

* Strong project management experience.
* Supports the team to drive through risk and ambiguity with a strong bias towards actionand delivery while incentivizing the team to follow best practices and SOPs.
* Proactively identifies and removes project obstacles or barriers on behalf of the team.
* Functions effectively under pressure, with deadlines, and on high-visibility projects.
* Maintains excitement for a process and drives to new directions of meeting the goal in the face of unfavorable odds and setbacks.
* Track record of setting targets, executing a plan, and delivering results against aggressive timelines.
* Ability to plan and provide structure and organization in a fast-paced, changing environment.
* Evaluates products and & processes to ensure compliance where relevant.
* Participate in and lead team discussions relative to current projects.
* Contribute to the larger TraceLink community (e.g., Services, Business Management, Marketing, Customers, and Engineering).

**EMOTIONAL INTELLIGENCE**

* Engage with a world-class team of project managers.
* Supports a high-functioning team environment where people are motivated and supported to share more, feel more engaged, and ultimately perform better.
* Effective team and group leader who recognizes and shapes group dynamic, energy, progress, and unproductive/disruptive behavior toward desired session goals of the session.
* Conflict Resolution skills, resolving issues and conflicts allowing team members to move forward and remain motivated.
* Excellent communication skills and the ability to interface with senior leadership with confidence and clarity. Ability to interact at all levels of the organization and with other TraceLink businesses and partners.
* Demonstrated experience leading and influencing across a complex, global matrix undefined
* Maintains commitment, perseverance, empathy, and passion as a team member.
* Influences and energizes others toward the common vision and goal.
* Communicate effectively both within the immediate team and Product Management leadership.
* Strong presenter
* Ensure the team receives consistent messages and has a clear understanding ofbusiness direction, strategy, and results.

**CRITICAL THINKING**

* Uses critical thinking skills and disciplined approaches to help leaders and teams evaluate and resolve issues by defining solutions.
* Acts and decides appropriately when all available information may not be possible to obtain. Uses root cause analysis to identify, correct, and/or eliminate the causes of problems as well as the problem itself.
* Systems thinker; who can see patterns and relationships, similarities between programs and projects. Plans and scopes programs that improve processes at scale.
* Helps assemble the larger 360 views of goals and supporting programs to reach those goals and effectively communicates that picture to others.

**What will help you in this role:**

* Agile Certification or working knowledge
* Working technical knowledge of software platforms
* Working knowledge of GXP for the life sciences industry
* Working knowledge of agile software development lifecycle
* Working knowledge of Atlassian software (Jira, Confluence)

**What We Expect Of You**
We are all different, yet we all use our unique contributions to serve patients. The program-management people leader we seek is a collaborative, strategic, and outcomes-focused professional with these qualifications.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* Master's degree or Bachelor's degree and 13+ years, of program, project, portfolio, product, business systems, or platform management experience.

* Demonstrated experience directly managing and developing Program Managers, Project Managers, Product Managers, or comparable professional teams.

**What You Can Expect Of Us**
As we work to develop treatments that take care of others, we also work to care for your professional and personal growth and well-being. From our competitive benefits to our collaborative culture, we will support your journey every step of the way.

Amgen is an Equal Opportunity employer. We make all employment decisions without regard to any characteristic protected by applicable law.
  
  
We provide reasonable accommodations to applicants and employees with disabilities, consistent with legal requirements.

cc3fedeb.title: Lead Technical Program Manager
cc3fedeb.description:
**Our Purpose**
*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*
**Title And Summary**
Lead Technical Program Manager
  
  
Who is Mastercard? Mastercard is a global technology company in the payments industry. Our mission is to connect and power an inclusive, digital economy that benefits everyone, everywhere by making transactions safe, simple, smart, and accessible. Using secure data and networks, partnerships, and passion, our innovations and solutions help individuals, financial institutions, governments, and businesses realize their greatest potential. Our decency quotient, or DQ, drives our culture and everything we do inside and outside of our company. With connections across more than 210 countries and territories, we are building a sustainable world that unlocks priceless possibilities for all.
  
  
The Digital Solutions Engineering team is responsible for Mastercard’s electronic payment system as well as ensures payments are convenient and secure. The products are primarily focused on authentication, tokenization, fraud prevention, and risk mitigation across all payment channels as well as all stakeholders, issuers, acquirers, merchants, processors, and consumers. The key objectives of the solutions are to prove identity, reduce abandonments, reduce fraud, increase approval rates, and secure the payments ecosystem.
  
  
We are hiring a Lead Technical Program Manager (TPM) as part of the Authentication Solutions platform. The core Authentication Solutions (3DS and Passkey based) teams use a mix of technologies as we work to revolutionize our technology offerings.
  
  
**Job Overview**
Technical Program Managers at Mastercard collaborate to define the how and when of our strategic delivery goals. This role plays a pivotal role in driving complex, cross-functional projects and maintain alignment of our goals to organizational objectives. The responsibility of this teammate is to ensure technical solutions are delivered on time and meet the desired outcomes.
  
  
We are seeking a Technical Program Manager to drive progress, manage complex projects, and ensure optimal delivery. This role requires a strategic thinker who excels in decision-making, problem decomposition, and effective communication, while maintaining a strong grasp of business context and technical details.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Accelerate project progress by making crisp, timely decisions and clearing blockers.
* Navigate difficult situations to find viable paths forward and decompose problems into manageable units from ideation to execution.
* Organize work for optimal delivery, negotiating priorities, facilitating progress, and raising issues to management as needed.
* Maintain TPM artifacts, track SDLC milestones, and manage dependency target dates actively.
* Secure shared understanding and buy-in for solutions, clearly describing their impact on Mastercard and its customers.
* Use communication as a preventive control, ensuring meetings are effective, consensus is built, and decisions are well-documented.
* Optimize approaches, demonstrate improvements using data, and drive continuous improvements through retrospectives, staff meetings, and status updates.
* Proficiently manage scrum delivery, understand business context, customer use cases, and the functionality, architecture, and dependencies of involved systems.
* Represent team services to stakeholders and external partners, bringing developers or SMEs to meetings as necessary.
* Actively manage dependencies, influence vendors and partners, and ensure alignment with program goals.
* Deliver independently while occasionally seeking direction from peers and managers.

**All About You**

* Born simplifier.
* Proven experience in technical program management, with a strong ability to make timely decisions and manage complex projects.
* Proficiency in scrum delivery and a track record of optimizing processes and demonstrating improvements with data.
* Deep understanding of business context, customer use cases, system functionality, and industry technologies.
* Excellent communication skills with the ability to lead effective meetings, build consensus, and clearly articulate decisions.
* Experience in managing dependencies, influencing external partners, and representing team services to stakeholders.

**Corporate Security Responsibility**
All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
  
  

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

**What Will Make You Stand Out (Preferred Qualifications)**

c597f2ad.title: GCP Data Architect
c597f2ad.description:
The Data Architect will be responsible for designing end-to-end cloud-native data architectures on GCP, aligned to business strategy and scalability requirements. They will lead large-scale data modernization programs, including migration from on-premise or traditional platforms (such as Teradata, Oracle, Hadoop, or legacy data warehouses) to GCP services like BigQuery, Dataflow, and Pub/Sub.

The role requires close collaboration with Google account managers to leverage platform capabilities, credits, and joint go-to-market opportunities. The architect will engage regularly with senior client and internal stakeholders to translate complex technical architectures into clear business outcomes and investment decisions.

They will define data governance frameworks, data modelling standards, and best practices for cloud data platforms, and will guide and mentor engineering teams through implementation. The candidate will also be expected to contribute to pre-sales and solutioning discussions, including effort estimation and architecture proposals.

**Key Skills & Knowledge Required**

**Cloud & Platform Expertise** The candidate must have deep, hands-on expertise with GCP data services including BigQuery, Cloud Dataflow, Cloud Dataproc, Pub/Sub, Cloud Composer (Airflow), Cloud Storage, and Looker. Experience with GCP networking, IAM, and security controls relevant to data platforms is essential.

**Data Modernization** Proven track record of leading at least one large-scale modernization program migrating from traditional platforms such as Teradata, Oracle Exadata, Hadoop/HDFS, or on-premise data warehouses to GCP. Experience in data migration strategy, schema conversion, ETL/ELT re-platforming, and cutover planning is critical.

**Data Architecture & Modelling** Strong command of data warehouse design (Kimball, Inmon, Data Vault), data lake and lakehouse architectures, and modern data mesh principles. Ability to design for performance, cost efficiency, and long-term scalability.

**Data Engineering** Working knowledge of data pipeline design using tools such as Apache Beam, Spark, dbt, or Dataflow. Familiarity with streaming and batch processing patterns.

**Stakeholder & Client Engagement** Demonstrated ability to engage with C-suite and senior stakeholders translating architectural decisions into business value, managing expectations, and presenting confidently in governance forums and executive reviews.

**Google Ecosystem Collaboration** Prior experience working alongside Google account managers, solution engineers, or in a Google partner ecosystem is highly desirable. Ability to leverage Google's resources, best practices, and support structures as part of delivery.

**Governance & Compliance** Knowledge of data governance frameworks, metadata management, data lineage, and compliance requirements (GDPR, HIPAA, or relevant regional standards).

**Soft Skills** Strong communication and storytelling ability, executive presence, comfort with ambiguity in complex programs, and the ability to lead cross-functional teams across geographies.

**Qualifications**

A bachelor's or master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field is preferred. Google Professional Data Engineer or Cloud Architect certification is strongly preferred. 15+ years of overall experience in data roles, with at least 4–5 years in cloud data architecture on GCP.
