30b4bcca.title: Engineering Manager, AI & Cloud Solutions
30b4bcca.description:
**About Vanguard** Founded in 1975, Vanguard is one of the world's leading investment management companies. The firm offers investments, advice, and retirement services to tens of millions of individual investors around the globe-directly, through workplace plans, and through financial intermediaries.

**Vanguard India**

Vanguard's office in India is a significant milestone in our global expansion. We are committed to establishing an enduring technology center in Hyderabad, Telangana and are excited to be adding talent who will focus on Artificial Intelligence (AI), mobile, and cloud-based technologies that drive our business outcomes and deliver a world-class experience for our clients.

**Role Summary**

The Engineering Manager is responsible for leading and developing a team of engineers delivering cloud-native and AI-enabled solutions. This role combines people leadership with technical oversight and hands-on implementation, providing guidance, coaching, and support to engineering teams while fostering a culture of innovation, collaboration, and continuous improvement. The manager partners closely with stakeholders to ensure successful delivery of technology solutions, supports technical decision-making, and helps teams navigate complex and evolving business challenges. **Responsibilities**

* Hires, evaluates, and supervises crew. Provides guidance and training as necessary to develop crew. Sets performance standards, reviews performance, and makes informed compensation decisions in accordance with all applicable Human Resources policies and procedures.
* Responsible for delivering software releases relating to the product for the business units. Works with business clients to determine scope, and develops environmental requirements for each project.
* Provide day-to-day leadership, coaching, mentoring, and career development support for engineers and technical team members.
* Partner with engineering teams to guide technical decisions, remove delivery obstacles, and ensure alignment with established engineering standards and best practices.
* Support the successful delivery of cloud-native applications, AI-enabled solutions, APIs, and technology platforms.
* Contribute to implementation as needed, including writing and reviewing code, building prototypes and proofs of concept, and resolving complex technical issues alongside the team.
* Collaborate with business and technology stakeholders to understand priorities, align resources, and drive execution against strategic goals.
* Foster a culture of innovation, knowledge sharing, accountability, and continuous learning across the team.
* Help teams manage competing priorities and make timely, effective decisions in a fast-paced and evolving environment.
* Monitor team health, delivery progress, operational performance, and key outcomes, identifying opportunities for improvement.
* Support workforce planning, resource allocation, hiring, onboarding, and succession planning activities.
* Ensure adherence to security, risk management, compliance, and technology governance standards.
* Encourage adoption of modern engineering practices, automation, cloud technologies, and AI-driven solutions where appropriate.
* Build strong partnerships across technical and non-technical stakeholder groups and effectively communicate team priorities, progress, and outcomes.
* Participate in strategic initiatives and other leadership responsibilities as assigned.

**Qualifications & Skills**

* Minimum 8 years of experience in IT project management, software development, or IT service delivery. Previous leadership experience required.
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field. PMP, ITIL, or Agile certifications preferred.
* Proven experience leading and developing engineering teams in a technology-driven environment.
* Strong understanding of modern software engineering practices, cloud-native application development, and technology delivery.
* Working knowledge of AWS cloud technologies, AI/LLM-powered solutions, APIs, and modern application architectures.
* Hands-on proficiency in Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, GitHub, deployment pipelines, and Agile development practices.
* Experience supporting technical decision-making, solution delivery, and engineering execution across multiple initiatives.
* Strong stakeholder management skills with the ability to communicate effectively across technical and non-technical audiences.
* Demonstrated ability to coach, mentor, and develop engineers while fostering a positive and inclusive team culture.
* Experience operating in ambiguous environments and helping teams navigate change, uncertainty, and evolving priorities.
* Strong problem-solving, decision-making, and organizational skills.
* Commitment to continuous improvement, innovation, and operational excellence.

**Desired Candidate Profile**

* Technical leader with a strong engineering foundation and a passion for developing people.
* Comfortable guiding teams through complex technical and business challenges and contributing directly to implementation when needed.
* Demonstrates intellectual curiosity, learning agility, and a growth mindset.
* Encourages innovation and experimentation while maintaining focus on business outcomes.
* Thrives in fast-paced environments and brings a proactive, ownership-driven approach to leadership.
* Builds trust, develops talent, and creates an environment where teams can perform at their best.

**Location**

This role is based in Hyderabad, Telangana at Vanguard India. Only qualified external applicants will be considered.

**Our mission**

Vanguard adheres to a simple purpose: To take a stand for all investors, to treat them fairly, and to give them the best chance for investment success.

**Our commitment to you**

Vanguard takes the same long-term view of your success-at work and in life-with Benefits and Rewards packages that reflect what you care about, throughout all the phases and stages of your life. Our Total Rewards programs provide you and your loved ones with wellness support for key areas in your life:

**Financial wellness**  We're committed to enabling your financial success and provide competitive offers and programs.

**Physical wellness** We're committed to providing benefits that support your physical health and wellness.

**Personal wellness**  We're committed to providing resources that help support the full scope of your life.

**How we work**

Vanguard has implemented a hybrid working model for most of our employees (crew members), designed to capture the benefits of enhanced flexibility while enabling in-person learning, collaboration, and connection. We believe our mission-driven and highly collaborative culture is a critical enabler to support long-term client outcomes and enrich the employee experience.

afac32f0.title: Technical Customer Solutions Manager, India CSM Team
afac32f0.description:
**Description**
Sales, Marketing and Global Services (SMGS)
  
  
AWS Sales, Marketing, and Global Services (SMGS) is responsible for driving revenue, adoption, and growth from the largest and fastest growing small- and mid-market accounts to enterprise-level customers including public sector.
  
  
As a Customer Solution Manager you will work with the largest and most complex enterprises in the world, to enable their multi-year journey to the cloud. In this new, highly visible, role you will ensure that all AWS teams work together effectively and efficiently to deliver migration, modernization and GenAI outcomes for the customer in relation to Amazon Web Services (AWS) Cloud.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
You will be a trusted advisor to the customer. You will leverage your complex program management, technical, organizational, and transformation expertise to understand customer's business and strategic goals, translate them into an executable plan, and drive the implementation to success by working with the customer, AWS, and our partners. You will understand your customers' biggest IT challenges and provide prescriptive guidance, based on AWS best practices, to guide them through their migration and modernization journey to AWS at scale.
  
  
You will take end-to-end ownership of multiple migration, modernization and GenAI projects within a single enterprise or across several enterprises, utilizing your communication skills to interface with and influence a broad range of multi-disciplinary teams (Business development, solutions architecture, support, product, professional services, and partners). The Customer Solution Manager role is responsible for cloud migration and modernization programs (incl. technical, operational, organizational, and education) that span across traditional IT teams and business units.
  
  
Engaging from the inception stage onwards, you will have a deep understanding of your customer's business vision, culture, and processes, you will be your customer's voice within AWS, ensuring that their needs are accurately communicated to AWS leadership, product, and engineering teams. Engaging during the latter stages of the business cycle you will be responsible for ensuring consistent best-practices are applied, including: (1) ensuring Migration Readiness Assessment (MRA) is conducted and bringing in SMEs to deliver the migration foundations (e.g. landing zone build, security controls, operating model, training etc.), (2) Migration kick off workshops are conducted (including stakeholder alignment), and (3) Executive Steering Committees and reporting are established, including customer, partner, and AWS Cloud exec sponsors and ensure mechanisms are in place to identify and mitigate any identified risks. You should be passionate about delivering a great customer experience by delivering successful IT transformation programs. You will ensure that the customer IT and business stakeholders are aligned, to ensure broad adoption of the migration and modernization across the customer organization. You will use AWS mechanisms to inform the customer migration journey. Where required, you will lead the interaction with specialist teams, ProServ and Partners for handoffs, especially with respect to migreation, modernization and GenAI implementation.
  
  
In addition to your customer facing responsibilities, you will help shape the rapidly growing Customer Solution Management function, where your passion to define and implement standard processes, methodologies, and tools will be highly valued. Passionate about customer value creation, you will be adept at measuring and quantifying customer value realization and ensuring it stays on path. Successful candidates will have a technical program management background, technology foundation and consultative mindset, be detail driven, and have experience in managing teams to deliver complex programs. You will be a passionate and proven leader with the ability to gain stakeholder buy-in, communicate confidently at both the executive and project team level, and collaborate with a wide range of technical and non-technical teams, regardless of geographical or organizational boundaries to ensure compliance with AWS Standards, policies and best practices. You will be comfortable in working with diverse teams to ensure appropriate partners are on-boarded and involved in the migration as required. Be an active participant of steering committees and governance structures regardless of who is leading the migration and modernization and act as the point of contact for escalations if the migration and modernization hits barriers. You will be proactive in assessing Migration and modernization progress and design and implement plans to mitigate any risks or delays. Along with project management cadence, you will support the people and process pillars of migration including CCOE design and be the overall owner of reporting and system updates related to the health of migration. You will be a natural problem solver with a cool head that can deal with ambiguity, work autonomously to drive the deliver results for your customer, build IP, and share best practice across geographies.

You will understand your customers' biggest IT challenges and provide prescriptive guidance, based on AWS best practices, to guide them through their migration and modernization journey to AWS at scale.
  
  
You will take end-to-end ownership of multiple migration, modernization and GenAI projects within a single enterprise or across several enterprises, utilizing your communication skills to interface with and influence a broad range of multi-disciplinary teams (Business development, solutions architecture, support, product, professional services, and partners). The Customer Solution Manager role is responsible for cloud migration and modernization programs (incl. technical, operational, organizational, and education) that span across traditional IT teams and business units.
  
  
Engaging from the inception stage onwards, you will have a deep understanding of your customer's business vision, culture, and processes, you will be your customer's voice within AWS, ensuring that their needs are accurately communicated to AWS leadership, product, and engineering teams. Engaging during the latter stages of the business cycle you will be responsible for ensuring consistent best-practices are applied, including: (1) ensuring Migration Readiness Assessment (MRA) is conducted and bringing in SMEs to deliver the migration foundations (e.g. landing zone build, security controls, operating model, training etc.), (2) Migration kick off workshops are conducted (including stakeholder alignment), and (3) Executive Steering Committees and reporting are established, including customer, partner, and AWS Cloud exec sponsors and ensure mechanisms are in place to identify and mitigate any identified risks. You should be passionate about delivering a great customer experience by delivering successful IT transformation programs. You will ensure that the customer IT and business stakeholders are aligned, to ensure broad adoption of the migration and modernization across the customer organization. You will use AWS mechanisms to inform the customer migration journey. Where required, you will lead the interaction with specialist teams, ProServ and Partners for handoffs, especially with respect to migreation, modernization and GenAI implementation.
  
  
In addition to your customer facing responsibilities, you will help shape the rapidly growing Customer Solution Management function, where your passion to define and implement standard processes, methodologies, and tools will be highly valued. Passionate about customer value creation, you will be adept at measuring and quantifying customer value realization and ensuring it stays on path. Successful candidates will have a technical program management background, technology foundation and consultative mindset, be detail driven, and have experience in managing teams to deliver complex programs. You will be a passionate and proven leader with the ability to gain stakeholder buy-in, communicate confidently at both the executive and project team level, and collaborate with a wide range of technical and non-technical teams, regardless of geographical or organizational boundaries to ensure compliance with AWS Standards, policies and best practices. You will be comfortable in working with diverse teams to ensure appropriate partners are on-boarded and involved in the migration as required. Be an active participant of steering committees and governance structures regardless of who is leading the migration and modernization and act as the point of contact for escalations if the migration and modernization hits barriers. You will be proactive in assessing Migration and modernization progress and design and implement plans to mitigate any risks or delays. Along with project management cadence, you will support the people and process pillars of migration including CCOE design and be the overall owner of reporting and system updates related to the health of migration. You will be a natural problem solver with a cool head that can deal with ambiguity, work autonomously to drive the deliver results for your customer, build IP, and share best practice across geographies.

78981689.title: AVP - Delivery Manager
78981689.description:
**About M&G India**
We are M&G India, the strategic innovation and digital hub for M&G. Established in 2003, we have offices in Mumbai and Pune.
  
  
Our teams work closely with colleagues across the Group worldwide to drive transformation, build digital capability, and support sustainable growth. By leveraging technology, AI, automation, and process excellence, we bring new ways of thinking to improve outcomes for both customers and colleagues.
  
  
Grounded in a vibrant culture with strong foundations, we are central to how M&G is transforming as a business.
  
  
**About M&G**
Our purpose is to give everyone real confidence to put their money to work. With a heritage dating back more than 175 years, we have a long history of innovation in savings and investments, combining asset management and insurance expertise to offer a wide range of solutions.
  
  
Our two distinct operating segments, Asset Management and Life, work together to provide access to balanced, long-term investment and savings solutions.
  
  
Through telling it like it is, owning it now, and moving it forward together with care and integrity; we are creating an exceptional place to work for exceptional talent.
  
  

* To work collaboratively with colleagues and take personal accountability to maintain and enhance controls you are responsible for to support improvement of the overall control environment, customers outcomes and a reduction in M&G plc's operational risk.
* Own end-to-end delivery across assigned squad(s) or workstreams, from demand and initiation through planning, execution, release and closure, with clear accountability for delivery confidence, delivery health and outcome achievement.
* Partner with Product Owners and business stakeholders to clarify outcomes, success measures, priorities, scope boundaries and acceptance expectations.
* Build and maintain integrated delivery plans, release forecasts and milestones; communicate confidence, assumptions, options and trade-offs in business language, including the impact of delivery choices on cost, capacity, scope, risk and timelines.
* Manage Scrum events including Sprint Planning, Daily Scrum, Backlog Refinement, Sprint Review and Retrospective; ensure each sprint has a clear goal, realistic commitment and actionable improvement outcomes.
* Coach teams in Scrum and Lean practices as appropriate, while protecting team self-organisation and avoiding command-and-control task allocation.
* Ensure backlogs and work items meet the agreed Definition of Ready and Definition of Done, and that Jira data provides reliable traceability and delivery insight.
* Actively manage RAID, cross-team dependencies, decisions, blockers, resource constraints and third-party commitments; escalate early with clear impact and recovery options.
* Orchestrate delivery across squads, platforms and workstreams by managing decision flow, cross-squad dependencies, sequencing constraints and delivery assurance activities.
* Use evidence and metrics such as predictability, throughput, cycle time, ageing work, escaped defects, release outcomes and team improvement trends to guide decisions.
* Track delivery against intended benefits, measurable value, business outcomes and agreed success criteria, ensuring progress is visible beyond activity completion.
* Coordinate release readiness across testing, architecture, security, risk, change, service management and application support, including operational handover, runbooks, monitoring, support contacts and known issues.
* Maintain transparent stakeholder communication through concise status reporting, governance updates, demonstrations and decision forums, ensuring no surprises; own delivery input into senior governance forums, steering updates, escalation discussions and leadership reporting where required.
* Promote quality, resilience, security, regulatory compliance and control adherence throughout the delivery lifecycle, including ownership of change-control readiness, audit evidence and regulatory delivery obligations where applicable.
* Facilitate/participate in Scrum of Scrums or equivalent dependency forums where required and contribute to delivery standards, templates, communities of practice and continuous improvement, with focus on portfolio/workstream alignment, delivery risk visibility and consistent delivery assurance practices.
* Create an inclusive, psychologically safe and accountable team environment where constructive challenge, learning and feedback are encouraged.
* Mentor less experienced Scrum Masters and delivery colleagues and share reusable practices across the delivery community.

We have a diverse workforce and an inclusive culture at M&G Global Services, regardless of gender, ethnicity, age, sexual orientation, nationality, disability or long term condition, we are looking to attract, promote and retain exceptional people. We also welcome those who take part in military service and those returning from career breaks.

**Overview**

We are the Windows Servicing and Delivery (WSD) organization, dedicated to keeping over 1.8 billion Windows devices secure and productive by delivering timely updates and innovations to all versions of Windows. Our work helps to protect users and their mission critical infrastructure in a fast-changing security landscape. We create and support new business opportunities across Microsoft, especially with the large and growing Windows installation base. We build delightful experiences for our customers and build products and solutions to empower our commercial and enterprise customers to keep their devices secure, compliant and up to date with latest innovations in Windows.

We are looking for a **Principal Technical Program Manager** to lead a team of TPMs and Product Managers across Windows Server and Networking, two foundational areas that power enterprise workloads and experiences across the Windows ecosystem. You will work closely with engineering, product, security, servicing, and customer-facing teams to identify the highest-impact customer problems, translate them into clear priorities, and drive programs from strategy through execution and customer impact.

This role requires a leader who is equally comfortable going deep into complex technical problems and stepping back to understand the broader product, customer, and business context. You will help your team navigate ambiguity, make the right technical and product tradeoffs, use data and customer signals to drive decisions, and influence teams across organizational boundaries. You will lead and grow a high-performing team of PMs, creating clarity and accountability while developing their technical depth, product judgment, and leadership capabilities. You will attract, develop, and retain outstanding talent and build an inclusive environment where people can do their best work.

As an AI-First leader, you will incorporate and coach your team on the responsible and effective use of AI across product management and engineering execution. You will also help identify opportunities where AI can fundamentally improve how we understand customer problems, diagnose and manage Windows systems, and deliver secure and reliable experiences at scale.

We value passion, creativity, drive, agility, accountability, technical curiosity, and a desire to continuously learn. Our customers are at the heart of everything we do, and delivering exceptional Windows experiences is our top priority. If you're excited about leading and developing a solid PM organization, shaping critical Windows Server and Networking investments, solving difficult technical and customer problems, and creating impact at Windows scale, we would love to hear from you.

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. * Use data to influence & drive decisions.

  + OR equivalent experience.

* Ability to build trust with internal and external partners through quality delivery and integrity.

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 5 years of experience leading technical program management initiatives and delivering infrastructure solutions.

**Preferred qualifications:**

* Master’s degree in Computer Science or a related technical discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
* 8 years of dedicated experience in a technical program manager role.
* Deep domain expertise in backend infrastructure, distributed systems, evaluation systems, or testing frameworks.
* Experience or strong interest in leveraging modern AI/ML capabilities, Large Language Models (LLMs), and agentic workflows to modernize Technical Program Manager (TPM) functions (e.g., automated dependency tracking, predictive risk modeling, and operational streamlining).
* Proven track record of driving cross-functional alignment, managing distributed teams across multiple time zones, and prioritizing complex workstreams amidst ambiguity.

**About The Job**
A problem isn’t truly solved until it’s solved for all. That’s why Googlers build products that help create opportunities for everyone, whether down the street or across the globe. As a Technical Program Manager at Google, you’ll use your technical expertise to lead complex, multi-disciplinary projects from start to finish. You’ll work with stakeholders to plan requirements, identify risks, manage project schedules, and communicate clearly with cross-functional partners across the company. You're equally comfortable explaining your team's analyses and recommendations to executives as you are discussing the technical tradeoffs in product development with engineers.
  
  
The Search Serving Infrastructure (SSI) team is at the heart of Google Search. Our mission is to provide a reliable, highly efficient, and performant serving framework that powers the Search ecosystem handling billions of queries a day. We address massive-scale engineering challenges, from reducing latency and CPU/TPU capacity footprints to driving large-scale architectural simplification efforts (like deprecating legacy monolithic servers in favor of modern, scalable services).
  
  
In Google Search, we're reimagining what it means to search for information – any way and anywhere. To do that, we need to solve complex engineering challenges and expand our infrastructure, while maintaining a universally accessible and useful experience that people around the world rely on. In joining the Search team, you'll have an opportunity to make an impact on billions of people globally.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Scope, shape, and lead large-scale programs spanning multiple engineering tracks. Co-develop strategies, goals, and success metrics for the broader organization.
* Perform technical assessments to evaluate engineering scope, establish milestones, define timeframes, and assess resourcing needs. Demonstrate technical judgment equivalent to a practicing Software Engineer in the infrastructure domain.
* Identify, anticipate, and manage risks, deliverables, and interdependencies across different Search Platforms and partner teams. Build mechanisms to optimize governance and information flow.
* Drive continuous optimizations in operational cadence, tooling, and communication, minimizing process friction while fostering development velocity and quality.
* Advocate alignment across disparate teams with differing objectives. Guide and influence cross-functional peers, driving consensus for technical directions and prioritizing features against constraints.

Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form .

7117f35e.title: Senior Program Manager - Employee Relations
7117f35e.description:
**Role Summary for Senior Program Manager - Employee Relations (Individual contributor role)**

The incumbent will serve as a pivotal individual contributor responsible for driving high-impact Employee Relations and HR governance outcomes across R1 locations. The role will require end-to-end ownership of employee matters, grievances, disciplinary processes, performance-related interventions and sensitive workplace concerns while ensuring that all actions are handled with objectivity, consistency, confidentiality, and strong documentation discipline. In addition to managing day-to-day ER service delivery, the incumbent must bring strong knowledge of HR compliances, statutory requirements, labor codes, employment regulations, and policy governance to proactively identify risks, strengthen compliance controls, and support legally sound decision-making. The role is also expected to drive strategic HR and ER initiatives that improve workplace experience, reduce organizational risk, and enable consistent people practices across sites.

  

**Roles and Responsibilities:**

* **Grievance and Inquiry Resolution:** Proactively manage and resolve employee grievances and inquiries, ensuring that all issues are addressed promptly and effectively. This involves working closely with employees and management to facilitate open communication and resolution.
* **Collaboration on Performance Improvement:** Work in tandem with business leaders to address performance improvement issues. This involves collecting relevant information, participating in the review of performance improvement documents, and offering strategic recommendations to enhance employee performance.
* **HR Compliance, Labor Code Governance & Risk Mitigation:** Own and support HR-related statutory compliances, labor code readiness, employment law requirements, and internal governance obligations to ensure adherence with applicable legal and organizational standards. Proactively identify compliance gaps, assess people-risk exposure, recommend mitigation plans, partner with Legal/Compliance teams where required, and ensure timely reporting for internal governance and audit readiness.
* **Strategic Initiative Design and Execution:** Lead the design, planning, and execution of structured ER and HR initiatives, including labor code implementation, policy revisions, grievance framework improvements, workplace risk controls, associate engagement interventions, and process standardization. Translate insights from cases, compliance reviews, and business needs into scalable initiatives that strengthen governance and improve employee experience.
* **ER Service Delivery Management:** Oversee the delivery of ER services across R1 locations, utilizing platforms like Service Now for query management, tiering support, and other communication channels. This includes ensuring timely and effective responses to employee inquiries and concerns.
* **ER Case Management and Advisory:** Independently manage and advise on complex ER cases, including disciplinary matters, grievances, involuntary exits, leaves of absence, performance-related concerns, workplace conduct issues, and other sensitive or high-risk matters. Ensure each case is assessed through a fair, consistent, legally informed, and well-documented approach, with appropriate stakeholder alignment and timely closure.
* **Consistency and Documentation:** Guarantee consistency in the approach and resolution of employee concerns. This includes meticulous preparation of documentation and reports to ensure high-quality records are maintained.
* **Monthly Reporting:** Conduct monthly reporting of ER cases via the internal tracking log for the site. This involves compiling data, analyzing trends, and presenting findings to relevant stakeholders.
* **Data Insights and Trend Analysis:** Share data insights at the site level, derived from trends observed through various focus groups, listening posts, industry trends and ER case logs. Use this data to inform strategic decisions and enhance employee engagement.
* **Liaison with Stakeholders:** Act as a liaison with Business Leaders, HR Business Partners, Legal Compliance and other ER Advisors to keep them aligned and informed of the progress of employee relations matters on-site. This ensures alignment and continuity in HR practices across the organization.
* **Policy Review, Governance and Implementation:** Play an active role in reviewing, strengthening, implementing, and communicating ER/HR policies, procedures, and programs. Ensure policies remain aligned with business needs, statutory expectations, labor code requirements, internal governance standards, and associate-facing clarity. Partner with relevant stakeholders to drive adoption, ensure consistency, and maintain robust policy governance.
* **HR Project and Transformation Engagement:** Lead or contribute to cross-functional HR projects and transformation initiatives requiring ER expertise, compliance understanding, business partnering, stakeholder management, and structured execution. Bring a strategic mindset to design practical solutions that improve governance, reduce risk, and enhance organizational effectiveness.

**Key Competencies:**

* **Strong ER, HR Compliance and Legal Acumen:** Demonstrated experience in Employee Relations and/or HR Business Partnering, with strong working knowledge of HR compliances, labor codes, employment law principles, statutory obligations, policy governance, and employee engagement practices. Ability to apply this knowledge in practical business situations while balancing associate experience, compliance requirements, and organizational risk.
* **Experience Requirement:** A preferred 10-12 years of relevant work experience, demonstrating a track record of success in HR and Employee Relations roles.

959d2917.title: Technical Presales
959d2917.description:
We're Hiring: Technical Presales Lead (SaaS / Enterprise Technology)

**Company:**
Preta Systems

**Location:**
Vadodara, Gujarat / Hybrid

**Employment Type:**
Full-time

**Experience:**
5 - 10 years

**Industry:**
Enterprise SaaS | Digital Experience Infrastructure | Runtime Technology

About Preta Systems

www.pretasystems.com

Preta is building the
**control layer for digital experiences**
— a SaaS platform that enables businesses to configure, deploy, manage, and govern interactive UI experiences across live digital products without repeatedly modifying application code.

We're entering our go-to-market phase and looking for a technically strong, customer-facing professional who can bridge the gap between our product, engineering team, and enterprise customers.

The Role

We're hiring a
**Technical Presales Lead**
who can take ownership of technical product demonstrations, customer discussions, solution presentations, and technical evaluations.

You will work directly with the founder, business development team, and product engineers to help customers understand, evaluate, integrate, and adopt Preta.

This is a hands-on role for someone who understands modern web technologies and can confidently engage with CTOs, engineering leaders, product managers, and enterprise technology teams.

Key Responsibilities

**1. Technical Presales & Product Demonstrations**

* Lead live product demonstrations and technical presentations for prospective customers.
* Explain Preta's architecture, capabilities, integrations, and business value.
* Conduct technical discovery sessions to understand customer requirements and use cases.
* Respond to technical questions, objections, and integration-related concerns.

**2. Solution Architecture & Technical Consulting**

* Understand customer application architectures and recommend appropriate Preta integration approaches.
* Discuss JavaScript SDK integration, APIs, browser environments, security, and performance.
* Translate business requirements into technical solutions.
* Work closely with internal developers to validate solution feasibility.

**3. Proof of Concept (PoC) & Customer Onboarding**

* Lead technical evaluations, PoCs, and pilot implementations.
* Support customers during SDK integration and initial deployments.
* Troubleshoot integration challenges in coordination with the engineering team.
* Help establish repeatable technical onboarding processes.

**4. Sales & Engineering Collaboration**

* Partner with business development to progress qualified opportunities toward commercial conversion.
* Create technical presentations, demo environments, architecture diagrams, and integration documentation.
* Communicate customer feedback and technical requirements to the product team.
* Contribute to technical proposals, solution documentation, and enterprise evaluations.

Required Skills & Experience

* 5 - 10 years of experience in technical presales, solutions engineering, solution architecture, or customer-facing software engineering.
* Strong understanding of
  **JavaScript, TypeScript, HTML, CSS, DOM, browser architecture, and modern web applications**
  .
* Familiarity with REST APIs, SDK integrations, cloud infrastructure, and SaaS platforms.
* Understanding of enterprise security concepts, authentication, performance, and application integration.
* Experience delivering technical product demonstrations and presentations.
* Ability to communicate complex technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Strong problem-solving, presentation, and customer engagement skills.
* Comfortable working in a fast-moving startup environment.

Good to Have

* Experience with B2B SaaS, developer tools, MarTech, AdTech, or digital experience platforms.
* Knowledge of browser SDKs, JavaScript injection, Shadow DOM, and single-page applications.
* Experience with enterprise PoCs, technical RFPs, and security questionnaires.
* Understanding of cloud platforms such as AWS or Cloudflare.
* Previous experience working with international enterprise customers.

What Makes This Role Interesting?

* Work directly with the founder on taking a new SaaS infrastructure product to market.
* Play a key role in shaping Preta's technical sales and customer adoption strategy.
* Engage with product leaders, CTOs, and engineering teams across industries.
* Influence product development through direct customer interaction.
* Opportunity to grow into a leadership role as the company scales internationally.

Who Should Apply?

We're looking for someone who is
**technically hands-on, commercially aware, and an excellent communicator**
.

You should be equally comfortable explaining browser architecture to a CTO, conducting a live product demonstration, and working with developers to resolve an integration challenge.

**This is not a conventional software development role. It's a technical leadership opportunity at the intersection of product, technology, and business growth.**

c3ddbea5.title: Solutions Engineer (Mumbai or Noida or Bengaluru)
c3ddbea5.description:
At F5, we strive to bring a better digital world to life. Our teams empower organizations across the globe to create, secure, and run applications that enhance how we experience our evolving digital world. We are passionate about cybersecurity, from protecting consumers from fraud to enabling companies to focus on innovation.
  
  
Everything we do centers around people. That means we obsess over how to make the lives of our customers, and their customers, better. And it means we prioritize a diverse F5 community where each individual can thrive.
  
  
**Job Description**
F5 gives the world’s largest businesses, service providers, governments, and consumer brands the ability to securely deliver every app, anywhere—with confidence. We do this by working collaboratively in an innovative environment, helping each other succeed. We take great pride in being trusted advisers to our customers, offering the best solutions for their interests. If our mission and culture excite you, we would love to talk to you!
  
  
**The SE Job Overview:**
The Solutions Engineer (SE) is a sales and technical role with focus on customer/partners and is part of the sales organization. The SE’s primary responsibility is to support the sales team with technical skills and provide technical knowledge around F5 solutions to our customers. To be effective, an SE needs to have excellent technical skills and knowledge on both F5 products and the “eco-system” that we work in. Fear not, we do provide training and certification to keep abreast with these critical skills!
  
  
The high-level objective is to achieve the allocated sales target and selling relevant F5 solutions and products to our customers business needs, in partnership with the Sales Account Manager. From our customer(s) perspective, the SE is a trusted adviser who proactively learns and understands their technical and business challenges and is able to propose effective solutions to mitigate their concerns/offer gainful solutions. The F5 SE not only presents the technical features but also business benefits in the Technical Value Proposition.
  
  
Sounds interesting? Read on!
  
  
**What you’ll do:**

* Articulate the F5 product strategy, messaging and positioning F5’s value proposition and solutions for customer business objectives
* Provide technical expertise through sales presentations, solution designs, solution demonstrations, proof of concepts by various mediums – in-person/virtual presentations, white boards etc
* Determine viability of opportunity and map out organizational structure.
* Drive the sales process in partnership with the Account Manager, by identifying the Technical Decision Maker, getting their technical validation, support, and sponsorship.
* Consistently provide world-class customer service through the customer life cycle
* Work collaboratively with internal technical and sales resources, share best practices, updates, offer and seek expertise as the need arises in various opportunities.

**How you’ll do it:**

* Experience in secure Cloud architectures, Security product like WAF, ZTNA, Firewall, SSL VPN
* Experience with public/private cloud vendors and automation toolsets, basic CI/CD understanding.
* Experience with SaaS vendor and able to articulate SaaS benefits
* Experience with container orchestration solutions (eg: OpenShift, Kubernetes)
* Proficient in one or more programming languages will be added advantage, good understanding of routing, switching, virtualization

**What you’ll bring:**

* 10+ years of related industry experience with FSI & Enterprise background
* 6+ years of experience in a similar customer facing technical role
* Familiarity/experience with F5 or similar industry solution deployment a plus
* Relevant certifications a plus

The Job Description is intended to be a general representation of the responsibilities and requirements of the job. However, the description may not be all-inclusive, and responsibilities and requirements are subject to change.
  
  
**Please note that F5 only contacts candidates through F5 email address (ending with @f5.com) or auto email notification from Workday (ending with f5.com or**
**@myworkday.com)**
**.**
**Equal Employment Opportunity**
It is the policy of F5 to provide equal employment opportunities to all employees and employment applicants without regard to unlawful considerations of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, sensory, physical, or mental disability, marital status, veteran or military status, genetic information, or any other classification protected by applicable local, state, or federal laws. This policy applies to all aspects of employment, including, but not limited to, hiring, job assignment, compensation, promotion, benefits, training, discipline, and termination. F5 offers a variety of reasonable accommodations for candidates. Requesting an accommodation is completely voluntary. F5 will assess the need for accommodations in the application process separately from those that may be needed to perform the job. Request by contacting accommodations@f5.com.

a6a95cff.title: Senior o9 Modeler / o9 Solution Consultant
a6a95cff.description:
**Senior o9 Modeler / o9 Solution Consultant**

**Location:** Remote, India  
 **Start:** Immediate Joiners Only  
 **Shift:** Significant EST overlap required, with some flexibility  
 **Communication:** Strong English required

**Project Overview**

Charter is building an innovation-driven operating model on the **o9 platform** to modernize planning, forecasting, and supply chain decision-making.

The program is replacing spreadsheet-based planning processes with scalable o9 solutions focused on predictive analytics, scenario modeling, optimization, improved forecast accuracy, and inventory efficiency.

We are looking for a **hands-on o9 Modeler** who can work directly within the o9 platform to design, configure, build, test, and enhance planning solutions. This is **not a project management role**. The consultant needs strong hands-on o9 modeling experience and should be comfortable owning technical/functional solution development.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Hands-on design, configuration, and development of solutions within the **o9 platform**.
* Build and enhance **o9 models** supporting supply chain planning, forecasting, inventory, and related planning processes.
* Translate business planning requirements into scalable o9 models and solutions.
* Configure business rules, planning logic, calculations, workflows, and solution functionality within o9.
* Work with data structures, hierarchies, master data, measures, and planning-related configurations.
* Develop and support scenario modeling, forecasting, optimization, and what-if planning capabilities.
* Troubleshoot model, configuration, data, and performance issues within the o9 environment.
* Understand data dependencies and work with integration teams to ensure data is properly consumed by o9 models.
* Perform unit testing and support system, integration, and user acceptance testing.
* Support deployments and movement of o9 enhancements across Dev, Test, and Production environments.
* Work directly with U.S.-based o9 leads, business stakeholders, engineering teams, and QA.
* Participate in solution design discussions and recommend practical o9 solutions based on business requirements.

**Required Experience**

* Strong **hands-on o9 Solutions modeling and configuration experience**.
* Proven experience actually **building and modifying models within o9**, not only managing o9 implementations.
* Experience developing o9 solutions for supply chain planning, demand planning, supply planning, forecasting, inventory, or similar use cases.
* Strong understanding of o9 data models, planning models, hierarchies, measures, calculations, and business rules.
* Experience with scenario modeling and planning/forecasting solutions.
* Ability to troubleshoot o9 models, data issues, configurations, and solution behavior.
* Understanding of integrations and upstream/downstream data dependencies within an o9 environment.
* Experience taking o9 enhancements through requirements, design, build, testing, and deployment.
* Ability to work independently in a fast-moving Agile environment.
* **Strong spoken and written English** with the ability to work directly with U.S.-based stakeholders.
* **Must be available to start immediately or with very minimal notice.**
* **Must be comfortable working significant overlap with EST hours.**

**Preferred Experience**

* Experience with **SAP IBP, Kinaxis, or other supply chain planning platforms** is a plus.
* Experience working in global delivery teams across the U.S., India, and/or LATAM.
* Experience with Jira or Azure DevOps.

87a50f79.title: Solution Architect
87a50f79.description:
The Solution Architect is responsible for the design, integrity and quality of the SAP solution and of associated IS services delivered to Business, Support Functions and IS Technology domains as the case may be. Responsible that the SAP solution/service provides the required functionality and meets the requirement of business. Collaborates with and contributes to project set-up and delivery as well as to service operations optimization.
  
  
The Solution Architect is accountable for managing workstream interdependencies mainly but not restricted to the specific End-to-End Stream.
  
  
**How You’ll Make An Impact**

* Defines the technical SAP solution/ E- Invoicing and ensures alignment with other modules and surrounding IS applications through cooperation and collaboration across solution architects.
* Supports validation and prioritization of incoming business demand in collaboration with Project owners, business function and unit as well with the relevant IS Business Analyst, IS Service Manager, IS Application Manager and/or Global IS Domain Architect.
* Be responsible for translating the functional design into functional and technical specifications, review and sign off the functional and technical use case specifications.
* Communicate the technical specifications to the developers. Joining unit testing and support on UAT testing and defect resolution. Managing the transport request and it's status update until release to Production system.
* Formulate rules, principles and guidelines to guide the development of the technical solutions. Determine non-functional requirements and ensure service/ solution operation standards are considered accordingly. Keeps knowledge up to date regarding new and emerging IS technology and IS industry practices, bringing learning into HE; all within in the scope of the relevant IS solutions.
* Collaborates with users in projects and problem management to maintain, develop and deploy the best feasible and most- cost efficient IS solutions/services for the business. Ensures solution documentation and training material are well maintained and created.
* Consults, gives advice and supports the installation of new E - Invoicing solutions/services, or the changing of existing solutions/services. Consults the users to identify and learn about current procedures and to clarify further requirements.
* Supports the installation, management, maintenance, and optimization of all E- Invoicing processes related to the area of responsibility. Provides guidance to IS project management and IS delivery unit team in how to utilize IS application/solution standards (e.g. SAP) effectively.
* Commits and contributes to common result oriented collaboration with the various business processes IS architectural domains as well as the various enterprise technology IS architecture domains. For assigned tasks, executes all actions in IS processes according to agreed RACIS specification.
* In concert with the Global IS Domain Architect ensures that IS solution/service-related standards are considered accordingly. Provides support to temporary work teams, guiding and monitoring task completion, sharing expert knowledge and advice with/without carrying line responsibility.
* Responsible to ensure compliance with applicable external and internal regulations, procedures, and guidelines.
* Living Hitachi Energy’s core values of safety and integrity, which means taking responsibility for your own actions while caring for your colleagues and the business.

**Your Background**

* Bachelor’s Degree or Master’s degree in Engineering in Computer science (preferred) or related discipline.
* 5+ years of experience within Information Technology industry with solution architecture experience across various IT areas with focus in the areas of S/4 HANA system with E - Invoicing
* Practical implementation experience with integration software/tools: BizTalk and/or MuleSoft.
* International work experience in different countries/ cultures.
* Proven experience implementing SAP best practices, especially for smooth transition for carving out a business division from current SAP landscape to a different one.
* Highly adept at bridging, translating and integrating business with IT, and converting business requirements into IT solutions. Ability to provide leadership to ensure effective solutions that drive business value are created and implemented, in an environment of virtual teams.
* Awareness of latest technology, developments and offerings from SAP and their future direction. Able to sort through complex issues and make timely decisions. Ability to generate new ideas, challenge status quo, take risks, support change and foster innovation.
* Demonstrates effective use of AI and digital tools to enhance problem-solving, decision-making, and productivity, while applying sound judgment, ensuring accuracy and compliance, and maintaining accountability for outcomes
* Proficiency in both spoken & written English language is required.

* Excellent presentation skills

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* Proven hands-on expertise with SharePoint Framework (SPFx), Power Apps, and Power Automate for building modern, extensible business solutions

* Solid experience with PowerShell and PnP for automation, provisioning, and enterprise governance

Whenever you join, however long you stay, the exceptional EY experience lasts a lifetime. And with a commitment to hiring and developing the most passionate people, we’ll make our ambition to be the best employer by 2020 a reality.

* Ensure adherence to security standards, data privacy requirements, and regulatory compliance.

**Key Requirements:**

* 8+ years of experience in solution or system architecture within complex IT environments
* Experience in DTC, eCommerce, retail, or omnichannel environments
* Strong understanding of integration architectures and modern engineering practices
* Experience working in global matrix organizations
* Strong communicator bridging business and engineering teams
* Structured, pragmatic, decision-oriented, and governance-aware working style

Strong understanding of:
  
  

* Microservices and distributed systems
* Digital channels (web, app, commerce capabilities)
* Retail and store systems (POS, omnichannel integrations)
* Core platforms (order management, payments, CRM, data platforms)
* Integration layer (APIs, event-driven architectures, middleware)
* Cloud infrastructure, DevOps, CI/CD, and release management
* Observability and operational architecture principles
* Security concepts (OAuth2, SSO, CIAM).

PUMA provides equal opportunities for all job applicants, regardless of race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, or disability. Equality for all is one of the core principles at PUMA and we do not tolerate any form of harassment or discrimination.
  
  
At PUMA, every application is reviewed by real people who are committed to fairness, transparency, and equal opportunity - no matter your background, identity, or experience. To ensure our process stays true to these values, no automated systems or AI tools are used to make hiring decisions. Every decision is made by real people -with real judgment and accountability. We may use functions supported by Artificial Intelligence (AI) to carry out isolated organizational steps, such as scheduling interviews. These functions have no influence on decisions in the application process. We believe in creating spaces where everyone is welcome, celebrated, and empowered to contribute authentically. Because at PUMA, whoever wants to play, can play.
  
  
PUMA is a global sports brand creating footwear, apparel, and accessories that inspire athletes and everyday movers. The PUMA Group owns PUMA, Cobra Golf, and stichd, operates in 120+ countries, and has around 22,000 employees worldwide.

**ABOUT LEGION**
Join Legion's mission to turn hourly jobs into good jobs. We're a mission-driven team seeking exceptional talent to propel this vision. Embrace a culture that's collaborative, fast-paced, and entrepreneurial. With us, you'll grow your skills, work closely with experienced executives, and contribute significantly to our mission.

If you're ready to make an impact and grow your career, Legion is where you belong. Join us in making hourly work rewarding and fulfilling.
  
  
**BACKGROUND AND OPPORTUNITY**
There are almost 75 million hourly workers in the United States, representing more than half of the entire workforce. Historically, managing hourly employees has been difficult due to high attrition (average of 60%) and high replacement costs (average of $3,200 per employee in retail). The ongoing labor shortage and competition from the gig economy, make it more difficult to attract and retain hourly employees. 41956cb3.title: Senior Technical Program Manager
41956cb3.description:
**Our Purpose**
*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*
**Title And Summary**
Senior Technical Program Manager
  
  
**Overview**
Foundational Data & Model Services sits in Data & AI Foundations, inside Business & Market Insights. We own the data that B&MI's analytics and insights products are built on: the pipelines that bring it in, the data models that shape it, and the standards that keep it consistent for everyone downstream. When a product team needs transaction data modelled a particular way, or a new source onboarded, or a definition that means the same thing in two products, that is us.
  
  
About half the estate is Hadoop and Hive with on-prem ETL that has been running for years and still serves live products. The other half is Databricks, and we are moving the rest across. The work is two things at once: keeping the old platform reliable while it is still load-bearing, and rebuilding the data models properly on the new one rather than lifting and shifting what is already there.
  
  
The team itself is new, brought together from teams that used to sit apart, and the roadmap is still being written. Plenty is undecided. If that reads as an opportunity rather than a risk, you will enjoy this.
  
  
Role
  
  
You Will Own The Delivery Plan Across The Squads Doing This Work, And Manage The Dependencies Between Them, The Platform Teams We Rely On, And The Product Teams Waiting On Us. Specifically, You Will
  
  
Own delivery of the shared data models and pipelines that several product teams depend on, where success is adoption rather than features shipped.
  
  
Run the migration off Hadoop and on-prem ETL onto Databricks: sequencing, cutover, and actually switching the old thing off.
  
  
Keep the legacy platform's operational commitments visible in the plan, so migration work does not quietly starve the systems still in production.
  
  
Broker the dependencies we do not control, working with central platform, cloud operations and data governance teams.
  
  
Run vendor and partner engagement: roadmap alignment, milestone tracking, performance against commitments.
  
  
Bring enough technical depth to challenge decisions on data modelling, pipeline design and data quality, and to explain the trade-offs to business stakeholders without flattening them.
  
  
Set how a new team plans and reports: intake, prioritization, cadence, and what leadership sees each month.
  
  
**All About You**
We do not expect any one person to bring all of this, so apply if most of it fits.
  
  
Experience running technical programs in data engineering, data platforms or analytics infrastructure.
  
  
Working knowledge of the stack on both sides of the migration: Hadoop, Hive and traditional ETL on one side, Databricks, Spark and orchestration tooling such as Airflow on the other. Strong SQL throughout. Enough to scope work and spot risk without an engineer translating every conversation.
  
  
Experience of platform migrations where the old system stays live throughout and the decommissioning is the hard part.
  
  
Understanding of data modelling and why it matters: schemas, lineage, common definitions, and what breaks downstream when they drift.
  
  
Understanding of data governance, access control and handling customer data in a regulated business.
  
  
A track record of getting internal teams to adopt shared platforms, which comes down to persuasion, evidence and follow-through rather than mandate.
  
  
Comfortable with ambiguity: able to build a credible plan before every input is settled, and to change it without treating that as a failure.
  
  
**Corporate Security Responsibility**
All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
  
  

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

**Electronic Design Automation (EDA) software development**

* Proven track record managing complex, multi-team programs in a technical or software development environment.

c686670e.title: Software Architect
c686670e.description:
At Verint, we believe customer engagement is the core of every global brand. Our mission is to help organizations elevate Customer Experience (CX) and increase workforce productivity by delivering CX Automation. We hire innovators with passion, creativity, and drive to answer constantly shifting market challenges and deliver impactful results for our customers. Our commitment to attracting and retaining a talented, diverse, and engaged team creates a collaborative environment that openly celebrates all cultures and affords personal and professional growth opportunities. Learn more at www.verint.com .

**Overview of Job Function:**

As a Software Architect for the WFM/PM platform in India, you will define the technical blueprint for how Verint's engineering team builds, scales, and evolves its Java-based product suite. You will own system-level design decisions, establish cross-cutting architectural standards, and ensure the platform is secure, observable, performant, and maintainable at enterprise scale. You will apply proven software craftsmanship principles — including 12-Factor App methodology, SOLID principles, and design patterns — to guide the team toward a high-quality, long-lived codebase. You will work at the intersection of hands-on technical depth and strategic engineering leadership.

  

**Principal Duties and Essential Responsibilities:**

**1. Architecture and System Design**

* Define and own the technical architecture for WFM, PM, and Platform product areas - spanning Java backend services, frontend systems, APIs, database design, and cloud/on-premises infrastructure.
* Create, maintain, and communicate Architecture Decision Records (ADRs) and system design documentation.
* Lead system-level design reviews; enforce architectural governance and review gates for new features and initiatives.
* Apply and enforce 12-Factor App methodology, SOLID principles, and established design patterns across the codebase.
* Design enterprise-grade RESTful API contracts, versioning policies, backward compatibility strategies, and service boundary definitions.
* Architect solutions for both Cloud (AWS/Azure) and On-Premises deployment environments, ensuring consistency and portability.

**2. Java Backend Engineering Excellence**

* Own architectural implementation of Java and Spring Boot microservices, including Spring MVC, JPA/Hibernate, and integration patterns.
* Define and govern database architecture across PostgreSQL, MS SQL, and other relational stores; own schema design, query optimization, stored procedure standards, and indexing strategy.
* Establish standards for unit and integration testing using PowerMock, Mockito, and JUnit; define test coverage thresholds and enforcement mechanisms.
* Evaluate and govern usage of build tools including Gradle, Maven, and npm; define dependency management and versioning standards.
* Champion secure-by-design practices aligned with OWASP Top 10 and enterprise customer security requirements.

**3. Frontend and Full-Stack Oversight**

* Define frontend architecture standards for ReactJS-based applications, including component design, state management, and performance optimization.
* Govern integration patterns between backend Java services and frontend applications, including API design, authentication (OAuth 2.0/JWT), and error handling.
* Provide architectural guidance on NodeJS services where applicable, including integration with Java backend systems.
* Ensure accessibility, internationalisation (i18n), and cross-browser compatibility are considered in frontend architecture decisions.

**4. DevOps, CI/CD, and Operational Excellence**

* Define CI/CD pipeline architecture using Jenkins and other DevOps tooling; establish standards for automated build, test, and deployment workflows.
* Own deployment architecture for application server environments including Tomcat, JBoss, and Oracle WebLogic Server (14+).
* Establish observability architecture: logging, metrics, distributed tracing, and alerting standards for both cloud and on-premises deployments.
* Define SLOs, SLIs, and error budgets; lead post-incident architecture reviews and drive systemic reliability improvements.

**5. Technical Standards, Governance, and Mentorship**

* Define and own engineering standards: coding guidelines, testing strategy, performance benchmarks, scripting conventions (Python, Shell, Batch), and security requirements.
* Establish and maintain the technology radar; govern adoption of third-party libraries, frameworks, and tools.
* Own the technical debt roadmap; prioritize and sequence refactoring and modernization initiatives.
* Serve as the architectural mentor for Senior and Lead engineers; enable the team to make sound design decisions independently.
* Facilitate architecture guilds, design sprints, and tech talks to elevate team-wide architectural thinking.

**6. Cross-Functional and Global Collaboration**

* Partner with global R&D leadership, Product, and Engineering leaders in UK and the US to align architecture with product strategy.
* Provide architectural input into roadmap planning, make-vs-buy evaluations, and platform investment decisions.
* Communicate complex technical concepts clearly to non-technical stakeholders including Product, Customer Success, and executive audiences.
* Engage directly with customers and enterprise stakeholders on production issues requiring architectural-level analysis and resolution.

  

**Required Qualifications:**
----------------------------

* 12+ years of professional software engineering with 3+ years in a dedicated architecture, principal engineer, or technical lead role.
* B.E. / B.Tech. / M.Tech. / M.Sc. in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a closely related STEM field.
* Equivalent exceptional practical experience with a demonstrable architectural portfolio will be considered.
* Demonstrable record of architecting large-scale, multi-tenant enterprise Java applications serving enterprise customers.
* Experience driving architecture across distributed, cross-timezone engineering organizations.

  **Technical Skills:**
* Back-End: Expert-level Java and Spring Boot (Spring MVC, JPA/Hibernate, Spring Security). Deep expertise in RESTful API design, microservices architecture, and enterprise integration patterns.
* Frontend: Strong architectural knowledge of ReactJS. Familiarity with Angular and NodeJS.
* Databases: Expert-level PostgreSQL and MS SQL relational database architecture. Deep SQL query optimization, stored procedure design, schema migration, and indexing strategy.
* Application Servers: Oracle WebLogic Server (14+), Tomcat, and JBoss/WildFly.
* Build and Tooling: Gradle, Maven, npm. IDE expertise with IntelliJ IDEA and Eclipse.
* Testing: Expert-level JUnit, Mockito, PowerMock, and integration testing strategy.
* Scripting: Python, Shell Script, and Batch Script for automation and operational tooling.
* Cloud and Infrastructure: AWS or Azure architecture. Docker and Kubernetes. IaC fundamentals (Terraform or CloudFormation).
* CI/CD: Jenkins pipeline architecture and CI/CD platform design.

  **Preferred / Nice-to-Have Qualifications:**
* Experience in WFM, PM, or enterprise analytics SaaS domains.
* Familiarity with Verint WFO, PM product architecture.
* AWS Solutions Architect Professional or Azure Solutions Architect Expert certification.
* Experience with TOGAF, C4 model, or equivalent architectural frameworks.
* Contributions to open-source projects or published technical content.
* Knowledge of regulatory compliance architecture (GDPR, SOC 2, ISO 27001).

7d668c4f.title: Enterprise Agentic Automation Developer/Solutions Architect
7d668c4f.description:
**Date posted** 10/14/2026

### **Category** **Information Technology****Hire Type** **Employee****Job ID** **18884****Remote Eligible** **No****Date Posted** **10/14/2026**

**We Are**

Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI-powered products. We deliver industry-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow.

**You Are**

You have spent years building enterprise systems that actually solve business problems, not just demonstrate technical capability. You understand that the real challenge is not deploying an AI model, it is designing the solution architecture that makes it trustworthy, scalable, and maintainable across Finance, HR, Sales Operations, and Legal teams who need it to work every single day. You think in systems, not features. When someone describes a manual process, you are already mapping the integration points, data flows, governance requirements, and failure modes before they finish talking.

You are equally comfortable whiteboarding an agentic AI architecture with a VP of Finance and writing Python code to integrate Azure OpenAI with SAP. You have built enough automation solutions to know when a workflow needs intelligent document processing versus a simple API call, and you can explain that tradeoff clearly. You do not wait for perfect requirements. You ask the right questions, prototype quickly, and iterate with stakeholders who may not speak your technical language but absolutely know their business pain.

At Synopsys, you will architect AI and automation solutions that reduce manual work for 30,000 employees across critical business functions, and the platform you build will matter.

**What You'll Be Doing**

* Design and build enterprise AI solutions using Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Document Intelligence, Azure AI Search, and Copilot Studio that automate Finance, Sales Operations, HR, Order Management, and Legal processes
* Architect and develop agentic AI systems and intelligent automation workflows on UiPath, Power Automate, Azure Logic Apps, and Azure Functions that integrate with SAP, Salesforce, Oracle, SuccessFactors, and Workday
* Lead end-to-end solution delivery from requirements gathering and architecture design through development, testing, deployment, and production support
* Build reusable frameworks, integration patterns, and engineering standards for AI agent development that other developers can adopt across the enterprise automation portfolio
* Partner directly with business stakeholders in Finance, GTM, HR, and Operations to identify automation opportunities, assess feasibility, prioritize initiatives, and translate requirements into technical solutions
* Establish and enforce governance, security, Responsible AI practices, and DevOps standards using Azure DevOps or GitHub for CI/CD and source control
* Mentor developers on AI solution design, Azure architecture, integration patterns, and automation best practices

**The Impact You Will Have**

* Reduce manual effort across Finance, Sales Operations, HR, and Order Management by deploying AI-powered automation that handles document processing, data extraction, workflow orchestration, and decision support at scale
* Accelerate Synopsys' enterprise AI strategy by establishing reusable frameworks and patterns that enable faster, more consistent delivery of intelligent automation solutions across business functions
* Improve operational accuracy and compliance by building governed, auditable AI systems with proper security controls, error handling, and monitoring
* Enable business growth without proportional headcount increases by creating scalable automation platforms that handle increasing transaction volumes and process complexity
* Strengthen cross-functional collaboration by translating technical capabilities into business value that Finance, HR, and Operations leaders can understand and trust
* Build institutional knowledge and capability by mentoring developers and establishing engineering standards that raise the quality and maintainability of the entire automation portfolio
Drive measurable ROI through solutions that demonstrably* time, reduce errors, and improve process efficiency in production environments

**What You'll Need**

* Bachelor's or Master's in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience
* 8-12+ years building enterprise applications, automation solutions, or integration platforms, with at least 3 years working directly with AI or Generative AI technologies in production environments
* Deep hands-on experience with Azure AI Services including Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Document Intelligence, and Azure AI Search, plus Azure Integration Services like Logic Apps, Functions, Service Bus, and API Management
* Proven ability to design and deploy intelligent automation using platforms like UiPath, Power Automate, Power Apps, Copilot Studio, and Dataverse
* Strong development skills in Python, C#, and JavaScript, with solid understanding of REST APIs, SOAP, webhooks, SQL, and data modeling
* Direct experience integrating enterprise applications such as SAP, Salesforce, Oracle, SuccessFactors, or Workday in complex business environments
* Working knowledge of AI governance, Responsible AI practices, cloud security, DevOps, CI/CD pipelines, and source control using Azure DevOps or GitHub, experience with JIRA for project management is a plus

**Who You Are**

* You can sit in a room with a Finance Director who describes a month-end close process and walk out with a solution architecture that addresses the real bottleneck, not just the symptom they mentioned
* You write code that other developers can actually maintain, you document your integration patterns, you build error handling that helps operations teams diagnose issues without calling you at midnight
* You push back when a stakeholder asks for an AI agent but the problem actually needs a well-designed workflow, and you can explain why in terms they understand and respect
* You have shipped enough production systems to know that governance, security, and supportability are not afterthoughts, they are design constraints you bake in from the start
* You mentor junior developers by showing them how you think through a problem, not just handing them the answer, and you genuinely care about raising the technical capability of the team
* You stay current with AI and automation technology not because it is trendy but because you know the difference between a useful new capability and vendor hype, and you can evaluate both critically

**The Team You'll Be Part Of**

You will join the Enterprise Agentic Process Automation team, which drives business transformation through AI, intelligent automation, process optimization, and enterprise integration. The team delivers capabilities across Finance, Sales Operations, Order Management, HR, Business Operations, and other functions, with emphasis on operational efficiency, scalability, governance, and innovation. Current initiatives include AI agents, document intelligence, finance automation, process orchestration, and enterprise platform integrations. The team operates in Bengaluru and collaborates closely with business stakeholders and IT teams across Synopsys globally.

**Rewards and Benefits**

We offer a comprehensive range of health, wellness, and financial benefits to cater to your needs. Our total rewards include both monetary and non-monetary offerings. Your recruiter will provide more details about the salary range and benefits during the hiring process.

  
  

At Synopsys, we want talented people of every background to feel valued and supported to do their best work. Synopsys considers all applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, military veteran status, or disability.

Our two distinct operating segments, Asset Management and Life, work together to provide access to balanced, long-term investment and savings solutions.

• To work collaboratively with colleagues and take personal accountability to maintain and enhance controls you are responsible for to support improvement of the overall control environment, customers outcomes and a reduction in M&G plc's operational risk. • Own end-to-end delivery across assigned squad(s) or workstreams, from demand and initiation through planning, execution, release and closure, with clear accountability for delivery confidence, delivery health and outcome achievement. • Partner with Product Owners and business stakeholders to clarify outcomes, success measures, priorities, scope boundaries and acceptance expectations. • Build and maintain integrated delivery plans, release forecasts and milestones; communicate confidence, assumptions, options and trade-offs in business language, including the impact of delivery choices on cost, capacity, scope, risk and timelines. • Manage Scrum events including Sprint Planning, Daily Scrum, Backlog Refinement, Sprint Review and Retrospective;
